war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Halipotay na la nga panahon an pag-upod ha iyo han kapawa. Pagpadayon ha iyo dalan samtang aada pa ha iyo an kapawa, basi diri kamo abotan han kasisidman; kay an naglalakat ha kasisidman diri maaram kon tipakain hiya.

en: As long as you have the light, believe in the light so that you might become people whose lives are determined by the light. ” After Jesus said these things, he went away and hid from them.
war: Sanglit too kamo han kapawa, samtang aada pa ha iyo ini, basi mahimo kamo nga mga anak han kapawa.” Katapos ni Jesus magsiring hini, linmakat hiya ngan tinmago.

en: Jesus had done many miraculous signs before the people, but they didn’t believe in him.
war: Bisan kon ginbuhat niya ini ngatanan nga mga urosahon ha atubangan nira, waray gihapon hira tumoo ha iya,

en: This was to fulfill the word of the prophet Isaiah: Lord, who has believed through our message? To whom is the arm of the Lord fully revealed?
war: basi matuman an iginsiring ni Isaias nga manaragna: “Ginoo, hin-o in tinmuod han iginsumat namon nga mensahe? Hin-o an ginpakita han Ginoo han iya gahom?”

en: Isaiah explains why they couldn’t believe:
war: Tungod hini waray hira makatoo, kay nagsiring liwat hi Isaias:

en: He made their eyes blind and closed their minds so that they might not see with their eyes, understand with their minds, and turn their lives around— and I would heal them.
war: “Ginbuta han Dyos an ira mga mata, ngan ginsadhan an ira mga hunahuna, basi diri kumita an ira mga mata, ngan diri makasantop an ira mga hunahuna, ngan diri hira dumanggop ha akon, nasiring an Dyos, basi tambalon ko hira.”

en: Isaiah said these things because he saw Jesus’ glory; he spoke about Jesus.
war: Ginsiring ini ni Isaias kay hinkit-an niya an gahom ni Jesus, ngan nagyakan hiya mahitungod ha iya.

en: Even so, many leaders believed in him, but they wouldn’t acknowledge their faith because they feared that the Pharisees would expel them from the synagogue.
war: Bisan pa ngani, damo gihapon nga mga punoan nga Judiyo in tinmoo kan Jesus; kundi tungod han mga Parisiyo, waray hira magpadayag hin paghimangraw ha kadam-an, basi diri hira pagawason ha sinagoga.

en: They believed, but they loved human praise more than God’s glory.
war: Ginpalabi nira an pagdayaw ha ira han mga tawo kay han pagdayaw ha ira han Dyos.

en: Jesus shouted, “ Whoever believes in me doesn’t believe in me but in the one who sent me.
war: Namulong hi Jesus hin dako nga tingog, “An bisan hin-o nga natoo ha akon; natoo diri la ha akon kundi ha iya liwat nga nagpadara ha akon.

en: Whoever sees me sees the one who sent me.
war: An bisan hin-o nga nakakakita ha akon nakakakita liwat ha iya nga nagpadara ha akon.

en: I have come as a light into the world so that everyone who believes in me won’t live in darkness.
war: Kinmanhi ako usa nga kapawa han kalibutan, basi diri na magpabilin ha kasisidman an ngatanan nga natoo ha akon.

en: If people hear my words and don’t keep them, I don’t judge them. I didn’t come to judge the world but to save it.
war: Diri ko paghuhukman bisan adton namamati han akon pulong ngan diri nagtutuman hito. Kinmanhi ako pagtalwas, diri paghukom han kalibutan.

en: Whoever rejects me and doesn’t receive my words will be judged at the last day by the word I have spoken.
war: May-ada maghuhukom hadton nasalikway ha akon ngan diri nakarawat han akon mensahe. An pulong nga akon iginyakan amo an maghuhukom ha iya ha kataposan nga adlaw!

en: I don’t speak on my own, but the Father who sent me commanded me regarding what I should speak and say.
war: Tinuod ito, kay waray ako magyakan ha akon la kalugaringon, kundi an Amay nga nagpadara ha akon amo an nagsugo ha akon kon ano an akon igsisiring ngan igyayakan.

en: I know that his commandment is eternal life. Therefore, whatever I say is just as the Father has said to me. ”
war: Ngan maaram ako nga nahatag han dayon nga kinabuhi an iya sugo. Sanglit kon ano an akon igsisiring, amo man ito an pinapagyakan ha akon han Amay.”

en: Before the Festival of Passover, Jesus knew that his time had come to leave this world and go to the Father. Having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them fully.
war: Bisperas na adto han Pyesta han Paglabay. Maaram na hi Jesus nga inmabot na an iya takna hin pagbaya hini nga kalibutan ngan hin pagkadto han Amay. Dayuday ginhigugma niya an iya mga sakop dinhe ha kalibutan, ngan ginhigugma niya hira tubtob gud ha kataposan.

en: Jesus and his disciples were sharing the evening meal. The devil had already provoked Judas, Simon Iscariot’s son, to betray Jesus.
war: Tarangka ha panihapon hi Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an. Ginlarang na han Yawa nga maglilingo kan Jesus hi Judas nga anak ni Simon Iscariote.

en: Jesus knew the Father had given everything into his hands and that he had come from God and was returning to God.
war: Maaram hi Jesus nga itinubyan ha iya han Amay an bug-os nga gahom, ngan maaram hiya nga tikang hiya ha Dyos, ngan tikadto na hiya sa Dyos.

en: So he got up from the table and took off his robes. Picking up a linen towel, he tied it around his waist.
war: Sanglit binmuhat hi Jesus ngan maglubas han iya bawbaw nga bado, ngan magbagkos hin twalya.

en: Then he poured water into a washbasin and began to wash the disciples’ feet, drying them with the towel he was wearing.
war: Inmipis hiya hin tubig ngada ha palanggana ngan nagtikang hin panmusa han mga tiil han mga tinun-an, ngan ginpahiran han twalya nga iya iginbagkos.

en: When Jesus came to Simon Peter, Peter said to him, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”
war: Hinmarani kan Simon Pedro nga nagsiring ha iya, “Ginoo, mamumusa ka ba han akon mga tiil?”

en: Jesus replied, “ You don’t understand what I’m doing now, but you will understand later. ”
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Diri ka pa maaram yana kon ano an akon ginbubuhat, kundi hibabaroan mo ini onina.”

en: “No!” Peter said. “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus replied, “ Unless I wash you, you won’t have a place with me. ”
war: Nagsiring hi Pedro, “Diri gud ako matugot nga mamusa ka han akon mga tiil!” Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Kon diri ako mamusa han imo mga tiil, diri ka na magigin tinun-an ko.”

en: Simon Peter said, “Lord, not only my feet but also my hands and my head!”
war: Nagbaton hi Simon Pedro, “Kon amo man ini, Ginoo, diri la an akon mga tiil, kundi ilakip liwat hin paghugas an akon mga kamot ngan ulo!”

en: Jesus responded, “ Those who have bathed need only to have their feet washed, because they are completely clean. You disciples are clean, but not every one of you. ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “An human na kumarigos, malinis na an iya bug-os nga lawas, sanglit diri na kinahanglan maghugas pa ha iya ngahaw, kundi an iya mga tiil na la. Malinis na kamo kundi diri ngatanan.” (

en: He knew who would betray him. That’s why he said, “ Not every one of you is clean. ”
war: Maaram na hi Jesus kon hin-o an maglilingo ha iya, sanglit nagsiring hiya, “Malinis na kamo kundi diri ngatanan.”)

en: After he washed the disciples’ feet, he put on his robes and returned to his place at the table. He said to them, “Do you know what I’ve done for you?
war: Katapos niya pamusa han ira mga tiil, nagsul-ot na liwat hi Jesus han iya bawbaw nga bado, ngan binmalik ha iya lingkoran ha lamesa. Nagpakiana hiya, “Nasayod ba kamo han ginbuhat ko ha iyo?

en: You call me ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord,’ and you speak correctly, because I am.
war: Natawag kamo ha akon nga magturutdo ngan Ginoo, ngan may kamatuoran, kay amo gud ito ako.

en: If I, your Lord and teacher, have washed your feet, you too must wash each other’s feet.
war: Sanglit kon ako nga iyo Ginoo ngan Magturutdo namusa han iyo mga tiil, angay man liwat kamo maggiparupamusa han iyo mga tiil.

en: I have given you an example: Just as I have done, you also must do.
war: Gintagan ko kamo hin susbaranan, basi sugaron niyo hin pagbuhat han ginbuhat ko ha iyo.

en: I assure you, servants aren’t greater than their master, nor are those who are sent greater than the one who sent them.
war: Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: waray oripon nga labaw han iya agaron; waray sinugo nga labaw han nagsugo ha iya.

en: Since you know these things, you will be happy if you do them.
war: Yana maaram na kamo hini nga kamatuoran; palaran kamo kon buhaton ini niyo!

en: I’m not speaking about all of you. I know those whom I’ve chosen. But this is to fulfill the scripture, The one who eats my bread has turned against me.
war: “Diri ako naghihimangraw mahitungod ha iyo ngatanan; nakilala ako han akon mga ginpili. Kundi kinahanglan matuman an kasuratan nga nasiring, ‘Kinmontra ha akon an tawo nga sinmaro ha akon.’

en: “ I’m telling you this now, before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe that I Am.
war: Ginsusumat ko ini ha iyo yana, nga diri pa ini nahinanabo, basi kon mahinabo na ini, tumoo kamo nga hi ‘Ako Amo Ako.’

en: I assure you that whoever receives someone I send receives me, and whoever receives me receives the one who sent me. ”
war: Nagsusumat ako ha iyo hin tinuod: an bisan hin-o nga nakarawat han akon sinusugo, nakarawat man ha akon; ngan an nakarawat ha akon, nakarawat man han nagsugo ha akon.”

en: After he said these things, Jesus was deeply disturbed and testified, “ I assure you, one of you will betray me. ”
war: Katapos ni Jesus magsiring hini, inalpan hiya hin dako nga kabido, ngan nagsiring hin dayag, “Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: maglilingo ha akon in usa ha iyo.”

en: His disciples looked at each other, confused about which of them he was talking about.
war: Naggipasirosiplat hira nga nanhiburong kon hin-o gud an iya karuyag sidngon.

en: One of the disciples, the one whom Jesus loved, was at Jesus’ side.
war: Nalingkod sapit ni Jesus an hinigugma niya nga tinun-an.

en: Simon Peter nodded at him to get him to ask Jesus who he was talking about.
war: Nagsenyas hi Simon Pedro ha iya ngan nagsiring, “Pakianhi daw hiya kon hin-o an iya hinnanabihan.”

en: Leaning back toward Jesus, this disciple asked, “Lord, who is it?”
war: Sanglit sinmiring kan Jesus adto nga tinun-an ngan nagpakiana, “Hin-o man hiya, Ginoo?”

en: Jesus answered, “ It’s the one to whom I will give this piece of bread once I have dipped into the bowl. ” Then he dipped the piece of bread and gave it to Judas, Simon Iscariot’s son.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Itutunlob ko an tinapay ngan ihahatag ko ini ha iya; amo hiya an tawo.” Sanglit kinmuha hiya hin pinit nga tinapay, iya ini gintunlob, ngan iginhatag kan Judas nga anak ni Simon Iscariote.

en: After Judas took the bread, Satan entered into him. Jesus told him, “ What you are about to do, do quickly. ”
war: Han pakakarawat gud la ni Judas han tinapay, sinmulod dayon ha iya hi Satanas. Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Dagmit ngan tumana an kinahanglan mo buhaton!”

en: No one sitting at the table understood why Jesus said this to him.
war: Waray nakasabot han mga nakada ha lamesa kay ano nga ginsiring ini ni Jesus ha iya.

en: Some thought that, since Judas kept the money bag, Jesus told him, “Go, buy what we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.
war: Tungod nga hi Judas man an tinaporan han supot han kwarta, nakahunahuna an iba nga mga tinun-an nga ginsugo hiya ni Jesus hin pagpalit han ira kinahanglanon para han pyesta, o bangin ginsugo hiya paghatag ngadto han mga kablas.

en: So when Judas took the bread, he left immediately. And it was night.
war: Ginkarawat ni Judas an tinapay ngan ginmawas hiya dayon. Gab-i adto.

en: When Judas was gone, Jesus said, “Now the Human One has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
war: Han paggawas na ni Judas, nagsiring hi Jesus, “Iginpapakita na yana an himaya han Anak han Tawo, ngan pinaagi ha iya, ginpapakita liwat an himaya han Dyos.

en: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify the Human One in himself and will glorify him immediately.
war: Kon iginpapakita an himaya han Dyos pinaagi ha iya, magpapakita man an Dyos han himaya han Anak han Tawo ha iya ngahaw, ngan bubuhaton ito niya dayon.

en: Little children, I’m with you for a little while longer. You will look for me—but, just as I told the Jewish leaders, I also tell you now—‘Where I’m going, you can’t come.’
war: Mga anak ko, gutiay na la nga panahon an akon pakig-urosa ha iyo. Mamimiling kamo ha akon; kundi susumatan ko kamo yana han akon iginsiring ngadto han mga Judiyo, ‘Diri kamo makakadto han akon kakadtoan.’

en: “ I give you a new commandment: Love each other. Just as I have loved you, so you also must love each other.
war: Ihinahatag ko ha iyo in bag-o nga sugo: magsihigugmaay kamo. Kinahanglan magsihigugmaay kamo sugad han akon paghigugma ha iyo.

en: This is how everyone will know that you are my disciples, when you love each other. ”
war: Kon magsihigugmaay kamo, mahibabaro an ngatanan nga akon kamo mga tinun-an.”

en: Simon Peter said to Jesus, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “ Where I am going, you can’t follow me now, but you will follow later. ”
war: Nagpakiana ha iya hi Simon Pedro, “Ngain ka man kakadto, Ginoo ?” Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Diri ka pa yana makakasunod ngadto han akon kakadtoan, kundi masunod ka ha akon onina.”

en: Peter asked, “ Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I’ll give up my life for you. ”
war: Nagpakiana hi Pedro, “Ginoo, kay ano hin diri ko pakasunod ha imo yana? Andam man ako pagpakamatay tungod ha imo!”

en: Jesus replied, “Will you give up your life for me? I assure you that you will deny me three times before the rooster crows.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Ungod ba nga andam ka pagpakamatay tungod ha akon? Susumatan ko ikaw hin tinuod: diri pa matugaok an manok, iglilirong mo na akon hin makatulo.”

en: “ Don’t be troubled. Trust in God. Trust also in me.
war: Nagsiring ha ira hi Jesus, “Ayaw kamo kabaraka ngan kagupong. Too kamo han Dyos ngan too man kamo ha akon.

en: My Father’s house has room to spare. If that weren’t the case, would I have told you that I’m going to prepare a place for you?
war: Damo in mga kwarto didto han balay han akon Amay, ngan makadto ako hin pag-andam hin dapit para ha iyo. Diri ako magsusumat hini ha iyo kon diri pa ini tinuod.

en: When I go to prepare a place for you, I will return and take you to be with me so that where I am you will be too.
war: Ngan katapos ko kadto ngan pag-andam hin dapit para ha iyo, mabalik ako ngan pauupdon ko kamo ha akon, basi kon hain ako aadto man liwat kamo.

en: You know the way to the place I’m going. ”
war: Maaram na kamo kon uunanhon niyo pagsangpot ngadto han akon kakadtoan.”

en: Thomas asked, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Tomas, “Ginoo, diri kami maaram kon tikain ka; uunanhon man namon paghibaro han dalan nga tipakadto?”

en: Jesus answered, “ I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.
war: Nagbaton ha iya hi Jesus, “Amo ako an dalan, an kamatuoran, ngan an kinabuhi; waray makakadto han Amay kon diri pinaagi ha akon.”

en: If you have really known me, you will also know the Father. From now on you know him and have seen him. ”
war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Yana nga nakakilala na kamo ha akon, makilala man kamo han akon Amay; ngan tikang yana nakilala na kamo ha iya, ngan hinkit-an na hiya niyo.”

en: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father; that will be enough for us.”
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Felipe, “Ginoo, ipakita ha amon an Amay ngan igo na ito para ha amon.”

en: Jesus replied, “Don’t you know me, Philip, even after I have been with you all this time? Whoever has seen me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Kamaiha na nga kaupod-upod ako niyo ngatanan; diri ka pa gihapon nakilala ha akon, Felipe? Nakakita na han Amay an bisan hin-o nga nakakita ha akon. Sanglit kay ano nga nasiring ka, ‘Ipakita ha amon an Amay’?

en: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? The words I have spoken to you I don’t speak on my own. The Father who dwells in me does his works.
war: Diri ka ba natoo, Felipe, nga aada ako han Amay ngan an Amay aadi ha akon?” Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Diri natikang ha akon an mga pulong nga iginhimangraw ko ha iyo. Nagbubuhat an Amay nga aadi ha akon han iya kalugaringon nga mga buruhaton.

en: Trust me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me, or at least believe on account of the works themselves.
war: Tuohi niyo nga aada ako han Amay ngan an Amay aadi ha akon; kon diri man, tuohi ako niyo tungod hini nga mga buhat.

en: I assure you that whoever believes in me will do the works that I do. They will do even greater works than these because I am going to the Father.
war: Susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: magbubuhat man han mga buruhaton nga akon ginbubuhat an bisan hin-o nga natoo ha akon—tinuod, magbubuhat hiya hin larolabaw pa, kay makadto ako han Amay.

en: I will do whatever you ask for in my name, so that the Father can be glorified in the Son.
war: Ngan bubuhaton ko an bisan ano nga iyo pangaroon ha akon ngaran, basi pagdayawon an Amay pinaagi han Anak.

en: When you ask me for anything in my name, I will do it.
war: Bubuhaton ko an bisan ano nga pangaroon niyo ha akon ngaran.

en: “If you love me, you will keep my commandments.
war: “Kon nahigugma kamo ha akon, magtutuman kamo han akon mga sugo.

en: I will ask the Father, and he will send another Companion, who will be with you forever.
war: Pangangaroon ko han Amay, ngan tatagan kamo niya hin lain nga Parabulig, an Espiritu han kamatuoran, nga magpapabilin ha iyo ha kadayonan.

en: This Companion is the Spirit of Truth, whom the world can’t receive because it neither sees him nor recognizes him. You know him, because he lives with you and will be with you.
war: Diri makarawat ha iya an kalibutan, kay diri nakita o nakilala an kalibutan ha iya. Kundi nakilala kamo ha iya, kay nagpapabilin nga nag-uokoy hiya dida ha iyo.

en: “ I won’t leave you as orphans. I will come to you.
war: “Diri ko kamo babayaan nga mag-uusaan; mabalik ako ngada ha iyo.

en: Soon the world will no longer see me, but you will see me. Because I live, you will live too.
war: Ha diri maiha diri na makita ha akon an kalibutan, kundi makita kamo ha akon; ngan mabubuhi kamo kay buhi man ako.

en: On that day you will know that I am in my Father, you are in me, and I am in you.
war: Kon umabot na ito nga adlaw, hibabaroan niyo nga aada ako han akon Amay, ngan aadi kamo ha akon, sugad nga aada ako ha iyo.

en: Whoever has my commandments and keeps them loves me. Whoever loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love them and reveal myself to them. ”
war: “Nahigugma ha akon an bisan hin-o nga makarawat ngan magtuman han akon mga sugo. Hihigugmaon han akon Amay adton nahigugma ha akon; hihigugmaon ko man hiya ngan magpapakilala ako ha iya.”

en: Judas (not Judas Iscariot) asked, “Lord, why are you about to reveal yourself to us and not to the world?”
war: Nagpakiana hi Judas (diri hi Judas Iscariote), “Ginoo, uunanhon hin pagpakilala mo han imo kalugaringon ha amon, ngan diri ngadto ha kalibutan?”

en: Jesus answered, “Whoever loves me will keep my word. My Father will love them, and we will come to them and make our home with them.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Magtutuman han akon mensahe an bisan hin-o nga nahigugma ha akon. Hihigugmaon hiya han akon Amay, ngan makada kami ha iya, ngan mag-uokoy kami dida ha iya.

en: Whoever doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word that you hear isn’t mine. It is the word of the Father who sent me.
war: Diri nagtutuman han akon mga pulong an bisan hin-o nga diri nahigugma ha akon. Diri akon an mensahe nga hinbatian niyo, kundi natikang han Amay nga nagsugo ha akon.

en: “I have spoken these things to you while I am with you.
war: “Iginsumat ko ini ha iyo samtang upod pa ako niyo.

en: The Companion, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you everything and will remind you of everything I told you.
war: Kundi an Parabulig, an Espiritu Santo, nga susugoon han Amay ha akon ngaran, amo an magtututdo ha iyo han ngatanan nga mga butang, ngan magpapahinumdom ha iyo han ngatanan nga akon iginsumat ha iyo.

en: “Peace I leave with you. My peace I give you. I give to you not as the world gives. Don’t be troubled or afraid.
war: “Ibibilin ko ha iyo an kalinaw; ihahatag ko ha iyo an akon kalinaw. Ihahatag ko ini ha iyo diri sugad han paghatag han kalibutan. Ayaw kamo kabaraka ngan kalisang; ayaw kamo kahadlok.

en: You have heard me tell you, ‘I’m going away and returning to you.’ If you loved me, you would be happy that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than me.
war: Hinbatian ako niyo nga nasiring ha iyo, ‘Mabaya ako, kundi mabalik ako ha iyo.’ Kon nahigugma kamo ha akon, maglilipay unta kamo nga makadto ako han Amay, kay larolabaw hiya ha akon.

en: I have told you before it happens so that when it happens you will believe.
war: Iginsusumat ko ini ha iyo yana, nga diri pa ini nahinanabo, basi kon mahinabo na ini, tumoo kamo.

en: I won’t say much more to you because this world’s ruler is coming. He has nothing on me.
war: Diri na ako maghihimangraw ha iyo hin maiha, kay maabot na an punoan hini nga kalibutan. Waray hiya gahom ha akon,

en: Rather, he comes so that the world will know that I love the Father and do just as the Father has commanded me. Get up. We’re leaving this place.
war: kundi kinahanglan mahibaro an kalibutan nga nahigugma ako han Amay; sanglit ginbubuhat ko an ngatanan nga iginsugo niya ha akon. “Tana, kalakat kita.

en: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the vineyard keeper.
war: “Amo ako an tinuod nga balagon, ngan an akon Amay an magmarangno.

en: He removes any of my branches that don’t produce fruit, and he trims any branch that produces fruit so that it will produce even more fruit.
war: Binabanggi niya an ngatanan nga sanga nga diri nabunga. Tinatag-an niya hin paghawan an kada sanga nga nabunga, basi mamunga hin darodamo.

en: You are already trimmed because of the word I have spoken to you.
war: Nalinisan na kamo pinaagi han mensahe nga akon iginhimangraw ha iyo.

en: Remain in me, and I will remain in you. A branch can’t produce fruit by itself, but must remain in the vine. Likewise, you can’t produce fruit unless you remain in me.
war: Pabilin kamo didi ha akon, ngan magpapabilin man ako dida ha iyo. Diri makakabunga in sanga ha iya la kalugaringon; mahihimo la ini kon sumpay han puno an sanga. Ha sugad nga kaagi, diri kamo makakabunga, labot kon magpabilin kamo didi ha akon.

en: I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, then you will produce much fruit. Without me, you can’t do anything.
war: “Ako an balagon ngan kamo an mga sanga. Mabunga hin damo an bisan hin-o nga magpabilin didi ha akon, ngan ako dida ha iya, kay waray niyo mahihimo kon bulag kamo ha akon.

en: If you don’t remain in me, you will be like a branch that is thrown out and dries up. Those branches are gathered up, thrown into a fire, and burned.
war: Ilinalabog ha gawas an bisan hin-o nga diri nagpapabilin ha akon, ngan nauuga sugad hin sanga; gintitirok in sugad nga mga sanga, ngan ilinalabog ha kalayo, ngan sunogon.

en: If you remain in me and my words remain in you, ask for whatever you want and it will be done for you.
war: Kon magpabilin kamo didi ha akon, ngan magpabilin an akon mga pulong dida ha iyo, mangangaro kamo hin bisan ano nga inuungara niyo, ngan katutumanan kamo.

en: My Father is glorified when you produce much fruit and in this way prove that you are my disciples.
war: Ginhihimaya an akon Amay tungod han iyo pamunga hin damo; ngan pinaagi hini, nagigin mga tinun-an ko kamo.

en: “As the Father loved me, I too have loved you. Remain in my love.
war: Hinihigugma ko kamo sugad gud han paghigugma ha akon han Amay; pagpabilin kamo didi han akon gugma.

en: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, just as I kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.
war: Kon tumanon niyo an akon mga sugo, magpapabilin kamo ha akon gugma, sugad gud han pagtuman ko han mga sugo han akon Amay ngan nagpapabilin ako dida han iya gugma.

en: I have said these things to you so that my joy will be in you and your joy will be complete.
war: “Iginsumat ko ini ha iyo basi mahingada ha iyo an akon kalipay, ngan basi mahingpit an iyo kalipay.

en: This is my commandment: love each other just as I have loved you.
war: Amo ini an akon sugo: pagsihigugmaay kamo, sugad han paghigugma ko ha iyo.

en: No one has greater love than to give up one’s life for one’s friends.
war: An gidadakoi nga gugma nga maaangkon hin usa ka tawo tungod han iya kasangkayan, amo an pagtubyan han iya kinabuhi para ha ira.

en: You are my friends if you do what I command you.
war: Ngan kasangkayan ko kamo, kon buhaton niyo an akon iginsusugo ha iyo.

en: I don’t call you servants any longer, because servants don’t know what their master is doing. Instead, I call you friends, because everything I heard from my Father I have made known to you.
war: Diri ko na kamo tatawgon nga mga surugoon, kay diri maaram an surugoon han ginbubuhat han iya agaron. Lugod, tatawagon ko kamo nga mga sangkay, kay iginsumat ko ha iyo an ngatanan nga hinbatian ko tikang han akon Amay.

en: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you so that you could go and produce fruit and so that your fruit could last. As a result, whatever you ask the Father in my name, he will give you.
war: Waray kamo magpili ha akon; ako an nagpili ha iyo, ngan nagtudlok ha iyo nga magkalakat kamo ngan mamunga hin damo, mga bunga nga nagpapadayon. Sanglit ihahatag ha iyo han Amay an bisan ano nga iyo pangaroon ha iya, ha akon ngaran.

en: I give you these commandments so that you can love each other.
war: Sanglit amo ini an igsusugo ko ha iyo: paggihigugmaay kamo.”

en: “If the world hates you, know that it hated me first.
war: “Kon magdumot ha iyo an kalibutan, kinahanglan hisabotan niyo nga una ako pagdumtan han kalibutan.

en: If you belonged to the world, the world would love you as its own. However, I have chosen you out of the world, and you don’t belong to the world. This is why the world hates you.
war: Kon kanan kalibutan pa kamo, mahigugma unta ha iyo an kalibutan sugad nga iya kalugaringon. Kundi ginpili ko kamo tikang hini nga kalibutan, ngan diri na kamo sakop han kalibutan; sanglit magdudumot ha iyo an kalibutan.

en: Remember what I told you, ‘Servants aren’t greater than their master.’ If the world harassed me, it will harass you too. If it kept my word, it will also keep yours.
war: Hinumdomi an iginsiring ko ha iyo: ‘Waray oripon nga labaw han iya agaron.’ Kon ginpakurian ako nira, pagpapakurian man liwat kamo nira; kon gintuman nira an akon mensahe, pagtutumanon man liwat nira an iyo mensahe.

en: The world will do all these things to you on account of my name, because it doesn’t know the one who sent me.
war: Kundi bubuhaton nira ini ngatanan ha iyo, kay akon man kamo sakop; kay diri hira nakilala han nagsugo ha akon.

en: “If I hadn’t come and spoken to the people of this world, they wouldn’t be sinners. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
war: Diri unta hira salaan kon waray pa ako kumanhi ngan maghimangraw ha ira; kundi yana, waray na hira baribad han ira sala.

en: Whoever hates me also hates the Father.
war: An bisan hin-o nga nagdudumot ha akon, nagdudumot man han akon Amay.

en: If I hadn’t done works among them that no one else had done, they wouldn’t be sinners. But now they have seen and hated both me and my Father.
war: Diri unta hira salaan kon waray ko pa buhata ha butnga nira an mga buhat nga waray pagbuhata hin bisan hin-o; kundi yana, hinkit-an na nira an akon ginbuhat, ngan gindudumtan nira ako ngan an akon Amay.

en: This fulfills the word written in their Law, They hated me without a reason.
war: Kundi kinahanglan mahinabo ini, basi matuman an iginsurat dida han ira Balaod: ‘Gindumtan ako nira hin waray la hinungdan.’

en: “When the Companion comes, whom I will send from the Father—the Spirit of Truth who proceeds from the Father—he will testify about me.
war: “Maabot an Parabulig, an Espiritu han kamatuoran, nga natikang han Amay. Susugoon ko hiya nganhi ha iyo tikang han Amay, ngan magpapamatuod hiya mahitungod ha akon.

en: You will testify too, because you have been with me from the beginning.
war: Ngan magpapamatuod liwat kamo mahitungod ha akon, kay nagin kaupod ko man kamo tikang pa gud ha tinikangan.

en: I have said these things to you so that you won’t fall away.
war: “Iginsumat ko ini ha iyo basi diri lumuya an iyo pagtoo ha akon.

en: They will expel you from the synagogue. The time is coming when those who kill you will think that they are doing a service to God.
war: Paiiwason kamo nira ha ira mga sinagoga. Maabot an panahon nga an magpapatay ha iyo makakahunahuna nga nag-aalagad hiya han Dyos.

en: They will do these things because they don’t know the Father or me.
war: Bubuhaton nira ha iyo ini nga mga butang, kay waray hira makakilala han Amay o ha akon.

en: But I have said these things to you so that when their time comes, you will remember that I told you about them. “I didn’t say these things to you from the beginning, because I was with you.
war: Kundi iginsumat ko ini ha iyo, basi kon buhaton na nira ini, mahinunumdom kamo nga iginsumat ko ini ha iyo. “Waray ko igsumat ha iyo ini nga mga butang ha tinikangan, kay kaupod pa man ako niyo.

en: But now I go away to the one who sent me. None of you ask me, ‘Where are you going?’
war: Kundi yana, makadto na ako han nagsugo ha akon; kundi waray ha iyo napakiana ha akon, ‘Tikain ka?’

en: Yet because I have said these things to you, you are filled with sorrow.
war: Ngan yana nga ginsumatan ko na kamo, nagmamabidoon kamo.

en: I assure you that it is better for you that I go away. If I don’t go away, the Companion won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
war: Kundi susumatan ko kamo hin tinuod: mauruupay para ha iyo nga malakat ako, kay kon diri ako lumakat, diri makanhi ha iyo an Parabulig. Kundi kon lumakat ako, ipadadara ko hiya nganhi ha iyo.

en: When he comes, he will show the world it was wrong about sin, righteousness, and judgment.
war: Ngan kon umabot na hiya, magpapamatuod hiya ha mga tawo han kalibutan nga mga sayop hira mahitungod han sala, mahitungod han pagkamatadong, ngan mahitungod han paghukom han Dyos.

en: He will show the world it was wrong about sin because they don’t believe in me.
war: Sayop hira mahitungod han sala, kay diri hira natoo ha akon;

en: He will show the world it was wrong about righteousness because I’m going to the Father and you won’t see me anymore.
war: mahitungod han pagkamatadong, kay makadto ako han Amay ngan diri na kamo makita ha akon;

en: He will show the world it was wrong about judgment because this world’s ruler stands condemned.
war: mahitungod han paghukom, kay ginhukman na an punoan hini nga kalibutan.

en: “ I have much more to say to you, but you can’t handle it now.
war: “Damo pa gad an akon igsurumat ha iyo, kundi diri pa ini niyo maaakos yana.

en: However, when the Spirit of Truth comes, he will guide you in all truth. He won’t speak on his own, but will say whatever he hears and will proclaim to you what is to come.
war: Kundi kon umabot na an Espiritu han kamatuoran, igtututdo kamo niya ngadto han ngatanan nga kamatuoran. Diri hiya maghihimangraw ha iya la kalugaringon, kundi maghihimangraw hiya han hinbabatian, ngan magsusumat han mga butang nga tiarabot.

en: He will glorify me, because he will take what is mine and proclaim it to you.
war: Paghihimayaon ako niya, kay natikang ha akon an igsusumat niya ha iyo.

en: Everything that the Father has is mine. That’s why I said that the Spirit takes what is mine and will proclaim it to you.
war: Akon an ngatanan nga kanan Amay; sanglit nagsiring ako nga natikang ha akon an igsusumat ha iyo han Espiritu.

en: Soon you won’t be able to see me; soon after that, you will see me. ”
war: “Ha diri maiha, diri na kamo makita ha akon; ngan ha diri liwat maiha makita na liwat kamo ha akon.”

en: Some of Jesus’ disciples said to each other, “What does he mean: ‘Soon you won’t see me, and soon after that you will see me’ and ‘Because I’m going to the Father’?
war: Nagsiring ngadto han iba an pira han iya mga tinun-an: “Ano ba an kahulogan hini nga iya siring, ‘Ha diri maiha, diri na kamo makita ha akon, ngan diri maiha makita na liwat kamo ha akon’; ngan nasiring liwat hiya, ‘Kay makadto ako han Amay.’”

en: What does he mean by ‘soon’? We don’t understand what he’s talking about.”
war: Nagpakiana pa hira, “Ano an buot niya sidngon han ‘diri maiha’? Diri kita nasabot han iya ginyiyinakan!”

en: Jesus knew they wanted to ask him, so he said, “Are you trying to find out from each other what I meant when I said, ‘Soon you won’t see me, and soon after that you will see me’?
war: Nahibaro hi Jesus nga karuyag hira pumakiana ha iya, sanglit nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Nagsiring ako, ‘Ha diri maiha diri na kamo makita ha akon, ngan diri maiha makita na liwat kamo ha akon.’ Amo ba ini an iyo ginpaparopakiana?

en: I assure you that you will cry and lament, and the world will be happy. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will turn into joy.
war: Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: magtatangis ngan magngunguyngoy kamo, kundi maglilipay an kalibutan; magmamabidoon kamo, kundi magigin kalipayan an iyo kabidoan.

en: When a woman gives birth, she has pain because her time has come. But when the child is born, she no longer remembers her distress because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.
war: Mabidoon in babaye kon tipagaranak pa la hiya, kay inmabot na an takna han iya pag-antos; kundi kon natatawo na an bata, hinngangalimtan niya an iya gin-antos, kay malipayon na hiya nga may natawo nga bata nganhi ha kalibutan.

en: In the same way, you have sorrow now; but I will see you again, and you will be overjoyed. No one takes away your joy.
war: Amo man ini dida ha iyo: mabidoon kamo yana, kundi makikigkita liwat ako ha iyo, ngan magmamalipayon gud kamo hin kalipay nga waray makakaagaw ha iyo.

en: In that day, you won’t ask me anything. I assure you that the Father will give you whatever you ask in my name.
war: “Kon umabot na adto nga adlaw diri na kamo mangangaro ha akon hin bisan ano. Susumatan ta kamo hin tinuod: ihahatag ha iyo han Amay an bisan ano nga iyo pangaroon ha iya ha akon ngaran.

en: Up to now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask and you will receive so that your joy will be complete.
war: Ngada yana waray pa kamo mangaro hin bisan ano ha akon ngaran; pangaro ngan makarawat kamo, basi mahingpit an iyo kalipay.

en: “ I’ve been using figures of speech with you. The time is coming when I will no longer speak to you in such analogies. Instead, I will tell you plainly about the Father.
war: “Iginsumat ko ha iyo ini nga mga butang pinaagi hin mga pananglitan. Kundi maabot in panahon nga diri na ako magamit hin mga pananglitan, kundi magyayakan ako ha iyo hin yano nga mga pulong mahitungod han Amay.

en: In that day you will ask in my name. I’m not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.
war: Kon umabot na adto nga adlaw mangangaro kamo ha iya ha akon ngaran; ngan diri ako nasiring nga mangangaro ako ha iya para ha iyo,

en: The Father himself loves you, because you have loved me and believed that I came from God.
war: kay nahigugma ha iyo an Amay ngahaw. Nahigugma hiya ha iyo kay nahigugma man kamo ha akon ngan tinmoo kamo nga tinmikang ako han Dyos.

en: I left the Father and came into the world. I tell you again: I am leaving the world and returning to the Father. ”
war: Tikang gud ako han Amay ngan kinmanhi ako ha kalibutan; ngan yana mabaya na ako han kalibutan ngan mabalik ako ngadto han Amay.”

en: His disciples said, “See! Now you speak plainly; you aren’t using figures of speech.
war: Ngan nagsiring an iya mga tinun-an, “Kitaa, dayag na kaupay an imo pagyakan, ngan diri ka na nagamit hin mga pananglitan.

en: Now we know that you know everything and you don’t need anyone to ask you. Because of this we believe you have come from God.”
war: Maaram na kami yana nga sayod ka han ngatanan; diri ka nagkikinahanglan nga may magpinakiana pa ha imo. Nakakapatoo ini ha amon nga tikang ka han Dyos.”

en: Jesus replied, “ Now you believe?
war: Nagbaton ha ira hi Jesus, “Natoo na ba kamo yana?

en: Look! A time is coming—and is here!—when each of you will be scattered to your own homes and you will leave me alone. I’m not really alone, for the Father is with me.
war: Maabot an panahon, ngan aanhi na, nga magkakaburublag kamo ngatanan, kada usa, ha iya kalugaringon nga urukyan, ngan babayaan ako nga mag-uusaan. Kundi diri tinuod nga nag-uusaan la ako, kay kaupod ko an Amay.

en: I’ve said these things to you so that you will have peace in me. In the world you have distress. But be encouraged! I have conquered the world. ”
war: Iginsumat ko ini ha iyo basi mamay-ada niyo kamurayaw pinaagi hin pakig-usa ha akon. Pagpapaantoson kamo han kalibutan; kundi pagmaisog kamo! Gindaog ko na an kalibutan!”

en: When Jesus finished saying these things, he looked up to heaven and said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, so that the Son can glorify you.
war: Katapos ni Jesus maghimangraw hini, hinmangad hiya ha langit ngan nagsiring, “Amay ko, inmabot na an takna. Paghimayaa an imo Anak, basi paghimayaon ka man han imo Anak.

en: You gave him authority over everyone so that he could give eternal life to everyone you gave him.
war: Kay gintagan mo man hiya hin gahom hin pagmando han ngatanan nga mga tawo basi humatag hiya han dayon nga kinabuhi ngadto han ngatanan nga igintubyan mo ha iya.

en: This is eternal life: to know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you sent.
war: Ngan amo ini an dayon nga kinabuhi; nga kumilala ha imo an mga tawo, nga ikaw la an matuod nga Dyos, ngan kumilala kan Jesu-Cristo nga imo ginsugo.

en: I have glorified you on earth by finishing the work you gave me to do.
war: Iginpakita ko ha tuna an imo himaya; ginhuman ko na an iginpabuhat mo ha akon.

en: Now, Father, glorify me in your presence with the glory I shared with you before the world was created.
war: Amay ko, himayaa ako yana ha imo atubangan sugad han himaya nga akon hadto han kaupod pa ako nimo, han waray pa himoa an kalibutan.

en: “I have revealed your name to the people you gave me from this world. They were yours and you gave them to me, and they have kept your word.
war: “Iginpakilala ko ikaw han mga tawo nga imo ginkuha ha kalibutan. Imo hira, ngan gintubyan mo hira ha akon. Gintuman nira an imo pulong,

en: Now they know that everything you have given me comes from you.
war: ngan yana maaram hira nga tikang ha imo an ngatanan nga iginhatag mo ha akon.

en: This is because I gave them the words that you gave me, and they received them. They truly understood that I came from you, and they believed that you sent me.
war: Igintutdo ko ha ira an mensahe nga iginhatag mo ha akon, ngan ginkarawat ini hira. Maaram hira nga tikang ako ha imo, ngan natoo hira nga ikaw an nagsugo ha akon.

en: “I’m praying for them. I’m not praying for the world but for those you gave me, because they are yours.
war: “Nag-aampo ako para ha ira. Diri ako nag-aampo para han kalibutan, kundi para han mga tawo nga igintubyan mo ha akon, kay imo man hira.

en: Everything that is mine is yours and everything that is yours is mine; I have been glorified in them.
war: Imo an ngatanan nga akon, ngan akon man an ngatanan nga imo; ngan napapasidunggan ako tungod ha ira.

en: I’m no longer in the world, but they are in the world, even as I’m coming to you. Holy Father, watch over them in your name, the name you gave me, that they will be one just as we are one.
war: Yana makada na ako ha imo; mabaya na ako han kalibutan, kundi hahani pa hira ha kalibutan. Baraan nga Amay, panalipdi hira pinaagi han gahom han imo ngaran, an ngaran nga ihinatag mo ha akon, basi magkaurosa hira sugad nga uusa la kita.

en: When I was with them, I watched over them in your name, the name you gave to me, and I kept them safe. None of them were lost, except the one who was destined for destruction, so that scripture would be fulfilled.
war: Ginpanalipdan ko hira pinaagi han gahom han imo ngaran nga ihinatag mo ha akon, samtang kaupod pa ako nira. Ginbantayan ko hira, ngan waray usa ha ira nga nawara, labot han tawo nga kinahanglan mawara, basi matuman an kasuratan.

en: Now I’m coming to you and I say these things while I’m in the world so that they can share completely in my joy.
war: Kundi yana makada na ako ha imo, ngan ginhihimangraw ko ini nga mga butang dinhe ha kalibutan, basi matugob gud hira han akon kalipayan.

en: I gave your word to them and the world hated them, because they don’t belong to this world, just as I don’t belong to this world.
war: Iginhatag ko ha ira an imo mensahe ngan nagdumot ha ira an kalibutan, kay diri man hira kanan kalibutan, sugad gud nga diri man ako kanan kalibutan.

en: I’m not asking that you take them out of this world but that you keep them safe from the evil one.
war: Diri ako nahangyo nga kuhaon mo hira ha kalibutan, kundi nga panalipdan mo hira han Yawa.

en: They don’t belong to this world, just as I don’t belong to this world.
war: Diri hira kanan kalibutan, sugad gud nga diri man ako kanan kalibutan.

en: Make them holy in the truth; your word is truth.
war: Ihalad hira ngada ha imo pinaagi han kamatuoran; an imo pulong amo an kamatuoran.

en: As you sent me into the world, so I have sent them into the world.
war: Ginpadara ko hira nganhi ha kalibutan sugad han pagsugoa mo ha akon nganhi ha kalibutan.

en: I made myself holy on their behalf so that they also would be made holy in the truth.
war: Ngan tungod ha ira ihinahalad ko ha imo an akon kalugaringon, basi hira liwat magin tinuod man nga iginhalad ha imo.

en: “I’m not praying only for them but also for those who believe in me because of their word.
war: “Nag-aampo ako diri para la ha ira, kundi para liwat hadton mga matoo ha akon tungod han ira mensahe.

en: I pray they will be one, Father, just as you are in me and I am in you. I pray that they also will be in us, so that the world will believe that you sent me.
war: Nag-aampo ako nga magkaurosa unta hira ngatanan. Amay, mahiusa unta hira ha aton, sugad gud nga aadi ka ha akon ngan aada ako ha imo, basi tumoo an kalibutan nga ikaw an nagsugo ha akon.

en: I’ve given them the glory that you gave me so that they can be one just as we are one.
war: Gintagan ko hira han amo nga himaya nga ihinatag mo ha akon, basi magkaurosa hira sugad nga uusa la kita;

en: I’m in them and you are in me so that they will be made perfectly one. Then the world will know that you sent me and that you have loved them just as you loved me.
war: ako dida ha ira ngan ikaw dadi ha akon, basi magkaurosa unta hira hin hingpit, basi makasabot unta an kalibutan nga ikaw an nagsugo ha akon, ngan nahigugma ka ha ira sugad han imo paghigugma ha akon.

en: “Father, I want those you gave me to be with me where I am. Then they can see my glory, which you gave me because you loved me before the creation of the world.
war: “Amay, igintubyan mo hira ha akon, ngan karuyag ko nga hira mahiusa ha akon bisan kon hain ako, basi hikit-an nira an akon himaya, an himaya nga ihinatag mo ha akon; kay ginhigugma mo ako han waray pa hihimoa an kalibutan.

en: “ Righteous Father, even the world didn’t know you, but I’ve known you, and these believers know that you sent me.
war: Matadong nga Amay, diri nakilala ha imo an kalibutan, kundi nakilala ako ha imo, ngan maaram ini hira nga ikaw an nagsugo ha akon.

en: I’ve made your name known to them and will continue to make it known so that your love for me will be in them, and I myself will be in them. ”
war: Iginpakilala ko ikaw ha ira, ngan ipadadayon ko hin pagpakilala ha imo, basi maangkon man nira an gugma mo para ha akon, ngan mag-ukoy man ako dida ha ira.”

en: After he said these things, Jesus went out with his disciples and crossed over to the other side of the Kidron Valley. He and his disciples entered a garden there.
war: Katapos ni Jesus mag-ampo hini, linmakat hiya upod an iya mga tinun-an ngan tinmabok han sapa nga Kidron an ngaran. May tanaman didto hadto nga dapit, ngan sinmulod ngadto hi Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an.

en: Judas, his betrayer, also knew the place because Jesus often gathered there with his disciples.
war: Agsob hi Jesus makig-urosa han iya mga tinun-an didto, sanglit maaram hini nga dapit an malingo nga Judas.

en: Judas brought a company of soldiers and some guards from the chief priests and Pharisees. They came there carrying lanterns, torches, and weapons.
war: Sanglit kinmadto hi Judas hini nga tanaman upod in mga sondalo ngan mga gwardya han Templo nga ginsugo han mga puno han kapadian ngan mga Parisiyo. Dara nira in mga hinganiban, mga parol, ngan mga sulo.

en: Jesus knew everything that was to happen to him, so he went out and asked, “ Who are you looking for? ”
war: Maaram hi Jesus han ngatanan nga mahinanabo ha iya, sanglit gintapo niya ngan ginpakianhan hira, “Hin-o an iyo ginbibiling?”

en: They answered, “Jesus the Nazarene.” He said to them, “ I Am. ” (Judas, his betrayer, was standing with them.)
war: Nagbaton hira, “Hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret.” “Amo ako,” nagsiring hiya. Natindog didto upod ha ira an malingo nga Judas.

en: When he said, “I Am,” they shrank back and fell to the ground.
war: Han pagsiring la ni Jesus, “Amo ako,” inmisol hira ngan nagkatutumba ha tuna.

en: He asked them again, “ Who are you looking for? ” They said, “Jesus the Nazarene.”
war: Ginpakianhan na liwat hira ni Jesus, “Hin-o gud an iyo ginbibiling?” Nagbaton hira, “Hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret.”

en: Jesus answered, “ I told you, ‘I Am.’ If you are looking for me, then let these people go. ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Ginsumatan ko na kamo nga amo ako, sanglit kon ako an iyo tuyo, palakta niyo inin iba.” (

en: This was so that the word he had spoken might be fulfilled: “ I didn’t lose anyone of those whom you gave me. ”
war: Ginsiring niya ini basi matuman an iya iginyakan, “Amay, waray ako kawad-i bisan usa han imo iginhatag ha akon.”)

en: Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, drew it and struck the high priest’s servant, cutting off his right ear. (The servant’s name was Malchus.)
war: May espada hi Simon Pedro; hinulbot ini niya ngan tigbason an oripon han Labaw nga Padi, ngan napalong an tuo nga talinga han oripon. Malco an ngaran han oripon.

en: Jesus told Peter, “ Put your sword away! Am I not to drink the cup the Father has given me? ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus kan Pedro, “Ibalik ha takob an imo espada! Naghuhunahuna ka ba nga diri ko iimnon an kupa hin pag-antos nga iginhatag ha akon han akon Amay?”

en: Then the company of soldiers, the commander, and the guards from the Jewish leaders took Jesus into custody. They bound him
war: Gindakop ngan gingapos hi Jesus han mga sondalo nga upod han ira kapitan, ngan han mga gwardya nga Judiyo.

en: and led him first to Annas. He was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year. (
war: Gindara hiya nira, syahan ngadto kan Anas nga ugangan ni Caifas nga amo an Labaw nga Padi hadto nga tuig.

en: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jewish leaders that it was better for one person to die for the people.)
war: Hi Caifas an nagsagdon han mga Judiyo nga maoruopay pa nga usa la nga tawo an mamatay para han ngatanan nga katawhan.

en: Simon Peter and another disciple followed Jesus. Because this other disciple was known to the high priest, he went with Jesus into the high priest’s courtyard.
war: Sinmunod kan Jesus hi Simon Pedro ngan hin usa nga tinun-an. Kilala kaupay han Labaw nga Padi adto nga usa nga tinun-an, sanglit binmunyog hiya kan Jesus ngadto ha bungsaran han balay han Labaw nga Padi.

en: However, Peter stood outside near the gate. Then the other disciple (the one known to the high priest) came out and spoke to the woman stationed at the gate, and she brought Peter in.
war: Nagpabilin hi Pedro ha gawas, ha may portahan. Ginmawas an tinun-an nga kilala han Labaw nga Padi, nakighimangraw han daragita nga nakada han portahan ngan ginpasulod hi Pedro.

en: The servant woman stationed at the gate asked Peter, “Aren’t you one of this man’s disciples?” “I’m not,” he replied.
war: Nagpakiana kan Pedro ini nga daragita nga bantay han portahan, “Diri ka ba usa han mga tinun-an hito nga tawo?” “Diri,” nagbaton hi Pedro.

en: The servants and the guards had made a fire because it was cold. They were standing around it, warming themselves. Peter joined them there, standing by the fire and warming himself.
war: Tungod han kahagkot nagtap-ong an mga surugoon ngan mga gwardya nga nagkatukdaw hira palibot han tap-ong nga nagdadangdang ha ira ngahaw. Tinmig-ob hi Pedro ha ira basi kapasuan hiya.

en: Meanwhile, the chief priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and his teaching.
war: Nagpakiana kan Jesus an Labaw nga Padi mahitungod han iya mga tinun-an ngan mahitungod han iya pagturon-an.

en: Jesus answered, “ I’ve spoken openly to the world. I’ve always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where all the Jews gather. I’ve said nothing in private.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Dayuday dayag an akon pagyakan ha ngatanan. Ginbuhat ko an ngatanan nga pagtutdo didto ha mga sinagoga ngan ha Templo, diin napakadto didto an ngatanan nga mga Judiyo. Waray gud ako magyakan hin bisan ano nga diri dayag ha iyo.

en: Why ask me? Ask those who heard what I told them. They know what I said. ”
war: Kay ano nga ako an iyo ginpapakianhan? Asay niyo pakianhi an mga tawo nga nagpakabati ha akon. Pakianhi hira kon ano an akon iginsumat ha ira, sayod hira han akon iginyakan.”

en: After Jesus spoke, one of the guards standing there slapped Jesus in the face. “Is that how you would answer the high priest?” he asked.
war: Han pagsiring hini ni Jesus, gintampalo hiya hin usa han mga gwardya nga nakadto ngan sidngon, “Kamailob mo hin pagyakan hin sugad ngadto han Labaw nga Padi!”

en: Jesus replied, “ If I speak wrongly, testify about what was wrong. But if I speak correctly, why do you strike me? ”
war: Nagbaton ha iya hi Jesus, “Kon may iginyakan ko nga sayop, sumati an ngatanan nga hahani kon ano an akon ginyakan. Kundi kon matadong man an akon ginyakan, kay ano nga gintampalo mo ako?”

en: Then Annas sent him, bound, to Caiaphas the high priest.
war: Ngan iginpadara ni Anas hi Jesus nga ginapos pa, ngadto kan Caifas, an Labaw nga Padi.

en: Meanwhile, Simon Peter was still standing with the guards, warming himself. They asked, “Aren’t you one of his disciples?” Peter denied it, saying, “I’m not.”
war: Han natindog pa hi Pedro nga nagdadangdang harani han tap-ong, nagpakiana ha iya an iba, “Diri ka ba usa han mga tinun-an hito nga tawo?” Naglirong hiya ngan nagsiring, “Diri!”

en: A servant of the high priest, a relative of the one whose ear Peter had cut off, said to him, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”
war: Sinmagbang hin pagpakiana in usa han mga oripon han Labaw nga Padi, nga urupod han ginpalongan ni Pedro, “Diri ba ikaw an hinkit-an ko nga kaupod niya didto han tanaman?”

en: Peter denied it again, and immediately a rooster crowed.
war: Ngan nagsiring na liwat hi Pedro, “Diri,” ngan hito ngahaw nga takna tinmugaok in manok.

en: The Jewish leaders led Jesus from Caiaphas to the Roman governor’s palace. It was early in the morning. So that they could eat the Passover, the Jewish leaders wouldn’t enter the palace; entering the palace would have made them ritually impure.
war: Han agaaga pa, gindara nira hi Jesus tikang han balay ni Caifas ngadto han palasyo han gobernador. Waray sumulod han palasyo an mga Judiyo kay diri nira karuyag magtalapas han balaod han ira tuluohan hiunong han paglinis, basi makakaon hira han panihapon han Paglabay.

en: So Pilate went out to them and asked, “What charge do you bring against this man?”
war: Sanglit ginmawas na la hi Pilato ngadto ha ira ngan nagpakiana, “Ano in iyo sumbong kontra hini nga tawo?”

en: They answered, “If he had done nothing wrong, we wouldn’t have handed him over to you.”
war: Nagbaton hira, “Diri unta namon hiya gindadara nganhi ha imo kon waray pa hiya makagtalapas.”

en: Pilate responded, “Take him yourselves and judge him according to your Law.” The Jewish leaders replied, “The Law doesn’t allow us to kill anyone.” (
war: Nagsiring hi Pilato ha ira, “Dad-a hiya ngan usisaha niyo sumala han iyo kalugaringon nga balaod.” Nagbaton an mga Judiyo, “Diri itinutugot ha amon hin pagpatay bisan kan kanay.” (

en: This was so that Jesus’ word might be fulfilled when he indicated how he was going to die.)
war: Nahinabo ini basi matuman an iginyakan ni Jesus han paghimangraw niya kon ano nga paagi mamamatay hiya.)

en: Pilate went back into the palace. He summoned Jesus and asked, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
war: Sinmulod liwat ha palasyo hi Pilato ngan gintawag hi Jesus. Nagpakiana hiya kan Jesus, “Ikaw ba an hadi han mga Judiyo?”

en: Jesus answered, “ Do you say this on your own or have others spoken to you about me? ”
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Kalugaringon mo ba ini nga pakiana, o ginsumatan ka ba hin iba mahitungod ha akon?”

en: Pilate responded, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your nation and its chief priests handed you over to me. What have you done?”
war: Nagbaton hi Pilato, “Kay ano, Judiyo ba ako? An imo kalugaringon nga mga tawo ngan an ira mga puno han kapadian an nagtubyan ha imo nganhi ha akon. Ano ba in nabuhat mo?”

en: Jesus replied, “ My kingdom doesn’t originate from this world. If it did, my guards would fight so that I wouldn’t have been arrested by the Jewish leaders. My kingdom isn’t from here. ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Diri kanan hini nga kalibutan an akon ginhadian. Kon kanan kalibutan pa an akon ginhadian, nakikig-away unta an akon mga sakop basi diri ako mahulog ha kamot han mga Judiyo. Diri, diri kanan hini nga kalibutan an akon ginhadian!”

en: “So you are a king?” Pilate said. Jesus answered, “ You say that I am a king. I was born and came into the world for this reason: to testify to the truth. Whoever accepts the truth listens to my voice. ”
war: Sanglit nagpakiana ha iya hi Pilato, “Kon sugad, hadi ka ngay-an?” Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Ikaw an nasiring nga hadi ako. Tungod hini, natawo ngan kinmanhi ako ha kalibutan, basi magpamatuod han kamatuoran. Namamati ha akon an bisan hin-o nga aada han kamatuoran.”

en: “What is truth?” Pilate asked. After Pilate said this, he returned to the Jewish leaders and said, “I find no grounds for any charge against him.
war: Nagpakiana hi Pilato, “Ano ba an kamatuoran?” Binmalik ngadto ha gawas hi Pilato ngan nagsiring ngadto han mga Judiyo, “Waray ko hin-agian nga sadang pasikaran hin pagsirot ha iya.

en: You have a custom that I release one prisoner for you at Passover. Do you want me to release for you the king of the Jews?”
war: Kundi sumala han iyo batasan, nagpapagawas ako hin usa nga priso para ha iyo ha panahon hin Paglabay. Karuyag ba niyo nga buhian ko para ha iyo an hadi han mga Judiyo?”

en: They shouted, “Not this man! Give us Barabbas!” (Barabbas was an outlaw.)
war: Ginmoliat hira pagbaton ha iya, “Diri, ayaw hiya! Karuyag namon hi Barabas?” (Tikasan ini hi Barabas.)

en: Then Pilate had Jesus taken and whipped.
war: Ngan ipinakuha ni Pilato hi Jesus ngan iginpalatob hiya ha ira.

en: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple robe.
war: Naghimo an mga sondalo hin korona tikang hin tunokon nga mga sanga ngan iginsul-ot ha iya ulo. Ginbadoan hiya nira hin panapton nga pula,

en: Over and over they went up to him and said, “Greetings, king of the Jews!” And they slapped him in the face.
war: gindaop hiya, ngan ginsiring, “Mabuhi an Hadi han mga Judiyo!” Ngan gintampalo hiya nira.

en: Pilate came out of the palace again and said to the Jewish leaders, “Look! I’m bringing him out to you to let you know that I find no grounds for a charge against him.”
war: Ginmawas na liwat hi Pilato ngan sidngon an mga tawo, “Tan-awa, dadad-on ko hiya nganhi ha iyo basi niyo hibaroan nga waray ko hin-agian nga sadang pasikaran hin pagsirot ha iya.”

en: When Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, “Here’s the man.”
war: Ngan ginmawas hi Jesus nga nakakasul-ot han tunokon nga korona ngan han panapton nga pula. Nagsiring hi Pilato ngadto han mga tawo, “Kitaa, iini an tawo!”

en: When the chief priests and their deputies saw him, they shouted out, “Crucify, crucify!” Pilate told them, “You take him and crucify him. I don’t find any grounds for a charge against him.”
war: Han pakakita la ha iya han mga puno han kapadian ngan mga gwardya, naggoliat hira, “Igraysang hiya ha kros! Igraysang hiya ha kros!” Nagsiring hi Pilato ha ira, “Kuhaa hiya niyo ngan igraysang hiya ha kros. Waray ko hin-agian nga sadang pasikaran hin pagsirot ha iya.”

en: The Jewish leaders replied, “We have a Law, and according to this Law he ought to die because he made himself out to be God’s Son.”
war: Nagbaton an mga Judiyo, “May-ada kami balaod nga nagsusumat nga kinahanglan hiya mamatay, kay nagpaka-Anak han Dyos hiya.”

en: When Pilate heard this word, he was even more afraid.
war: Labi na nga nahadlok hi Pilato han pakabati niya hini.

en: He went back into the residence and spoke to Jesus, “Where are you from?” Jesus didn’t answer.
war: Binmalik hiya pagsulod ngadto han palasyo ngan nagpakiana kan Jesus, “Tikang ka ba diin?” Kundi waray magbaton hi Jesus.

en: So Pilate said, “You won’t speak to me? Don’t you know that I have authority to release you and also to crucify you?”
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Pilato, “Diri ka ba nabaton ha akon? Tigamni nga may-ada ko gahom hin pagtalwas ha imo ngan hin pagraysang ha imo ha kros.”

en: Jesus replied, “ You would have no authority over me if it had not been given to you from above. That’s why the one who handed me over to you has the greater sin. ”
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “May-ada ka gahom ha akon tungod la nga iginhatag ini han Dyos ha imo; sanglit darudako nga salaan an nagtubyan ha akon ngada ha imo.”

en: From that moment on, Pilate wanted to release Jesus. However, the Jewish leaders cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t a friend of the emperor! Anyone who makes himself out to be a king opposes the emperor!”
war: Han pakabati hini ni Pilato, nagtalingoha hiya pagbiling hin paagi hin pagbuhi kan Jesus. Kundi naggoliat an mga Judiyo, “Kon buhian mo hiya, diri ka ngay-an sangkay han Emperador! Kaaway han Emperador an bisan hin-o nga napakahadi!”

en: When Pilate heard these words, he led Jesus out and seated him on the judge’s bench at the place called Stone Pavement (in Aramaic, Gabbatha ).
war: Han pakabati ni Pilato hini nga mga pulong, iginawas niya hi Jesus, ngan linmingkod ha lingkoran han maghurukom dida han dapit han ginngangaranan “An Plataporma nga bato.” (“Gabata” an ngaran hini ha Hebreo.)

en: It was about noon on the Preparation Day for the Passover. Pilate said to the Jewish leaders, “Here’s your king.”
war: Tikaurudto na adto han bisperas han Paglabay. Nagsiring hi Pilato ngadto han mga Judiyo, “Iini an iyo hadi!”

en: The Jewish leaders cried out, “Take him away! Take him away! Crucify him!” Pilate responded, “What? Do you want me to crucify your king?” “We have no king except the emperor,” the chief priests answered.
war: Naggoliat hira, “Pataya hiya! Pataya hiya! Igraysang hiya ha kros!” Nagpakiana hi Pilato ha ira, “Karuyag ba niyo nga igraysang ko ha kros an iyo hadi?” Nagbaton an mga puno han kapadian, “An Emperador la an amon hadi!”

en: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be crucified. The soldiers took Jesus prisoner.
war: Sanglit igintubyan ha ira ni Pilato hi Jesus, basi igraysang ha kros. Sanglit gindara nira hi Jesus.

en: Carrying his cross by himself, he went out to a place called Skull Place (in Aramaic, Golgotha ).
war: Ginmuwa hiya nga nagpapas-an han iya kros, ngan inmabot ha dapit nga gintatawag “An Dapit han Klabera.” (“Golgota” an tawag hini ha Hebreo.)

en: That’s where they crucified him—and two others with him, one on each side and Jesus in the middle.
war: Didto iginraysang nira ha kros hi Jesus. Iginraysang liwat nira ha mga kros in duha pa ka tawo ha magkasi ligid niya, nga nabubutnga nira hi Jesus.

en: Pilate had a public notice written and posted on the cross. It read “Jesus the Nazarene, the king of the Jews.”
war: Iginsurat ni Pilato in usa nga pahibaro ngan iginpataod ini ha kros. Amo ini an ginsurat: “Hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret, an Hadi han mga Judiyo.”

en: Many of the Jews read this sign, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city and it was written in Aramaic, Latin, and Greek.
war: Nakabasa hini in damo nga mga Judiyo kay diri man hirayo tikang han syudad an dapit nga ginraysangan kan Jesus. Iginsurat an pahibaro ha pinulongan nga Hebreo, Latin, ngan Griego.

en: Therefore, the Jewish chief priests complained to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The king of the Jews’ but ‘This man said, “I am the king of the Jews.”’”
war: Nagsiring kan Pilato an mga puno han kapadian han mga Judiyo, “Ayaw isurat ‘An Hadi han mga Judiyo,’ kundi ‘Nagsiring ini nga tawo, Ako an Hadi han mga Judiyo.’”

en: Pilate answered, “What I’ve written, I’ve written.”
war: Nagbaton hi Pilato, “An nahisurat, nahisurat na.”

en: When the soldiers crucified Jesus, they took his clothes and his sandals, and divided them into four shares, one for each soldier. His shirt was seamless, woven as one piece from the top to the bottom.
war: Katapos pagraysangan kan Jesus han mga sondalo, ginkuha nira an iya mga panapton ngan ginbahinbahin hin upat ka bahin, usa ka bahin ha kada sondalo. Ginkuha liwat nira an iya halawig nga panapton nga hinimo hin usa la nga dugnit nga hinablon, ngan waray tinahian.

en: They said to each other, “Let’s not tear it. Let’s cast lots to see who will get it.” This was to fulfill the scripture, They divided my clothes among themselves, and they cast lots for my clothing. That’s what the soldiers did.
war: May hinsiring han mga sondalo, “Ayaw ta paggisia ini; kundi pagripa kita kon hin-o in makakadara.” Nahinabo ini basi matuman an kasuratan nga nasiring: “Ginbahinbahin nira an akon mga panapton, ngan ginripahan an akon hilawig nga bado.” Sanglit ginbuhat ini han mga sondalo.

en: Jesus’ mother and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene stood near the cross.
war: Natukdaw hirani han kros ni Jesus hira iya nanay, an bugto nga babaye ni iya nanay, hi Maria nga asawa ni Cleopas, ngan hi Maria Magdalena.

en: When Jesus saw his mother and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to his mother, “ Woman, here is your son. ”
war: Hinkit-an ni Jesus hi iya nanay ngan an tinun-an nga iya hinigugma nga natukdaw harani han kros; sanglit nagsiring hiya kan iya nanay, “Babaye, iini an imo anak.”

en: Then he said to the disciple, “ Here is your mother. ” And from that time on, this disciple took her into his home.
war: Ngan nagsiring hiya ngadto han tinun-an, “Iini an imo nanay.” Ngan tikang hadto gindara hiya han tinun-an hin pag-ukoy tampo han iya panimalay.

en: After this, knowing that everything was already completed, in order to fulfill the scripture, Jesus said, “ I am thirsty. ”
war: Maaram hi Jesus nga natuman na an ngatanan, ngan basi matuman an kasuratan, nagsiring hiya, “Inuuhaw ako.”

en: A jar full of sour wine was nearby, so the soldiers soaked a sponge in it, placed it on a hyssop branch, and held it up to his lips.
war: May surudlan didto nga puno hin maaslom nga bino. Ginhumog nira an espongha hin bino, igintaod ha kataposan hin sanga hin isopo, ngan iginhungit ha iya.

en: When he had received the sour wine, Jesus said, “ It is completed. ” Bowing his head, he gave up his life.
war: Dinmimdim hi Jesus han bino ngan nagsiring hiya, “Natuman na!” Ngan dinmuko hiya ngan nabunoson hiya han iya kinabuhi.

en: It was the Preparation Day and the Jewish leaders didn’t want the bodies to remain on the cross on the Sabbath, especially since that Sabbath was an important day. So they asked Pilate to have the legs of those crucified broken and the bodies taken down.
war: Ngan naghangyo kan Pilato an mga Judiyo nga barion na la an mga bitiis han mga tawo nga iginraysang, ngan tanggalon na hira ha kros. Ginbuhat ini nira, kay Viernes na adto ngan nadiri hira nga magpabilin ha kros an lawas ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway, kay baraan kaupay an tiarabot nga Adlaw nga Iparahuway.

en: Therefore, the soldiers came and broke the legs of the two men who were crucified with Jesus.
war: Sanglit kinmadto an mga sondalo ngan ginbari an mga bitiis han syahan nga tawo ngan han usa pa nga tawo nga iginraysang upod kan Jesus.

en: When they came to Jesus, they saw that he was already dead so they didn’t break his legs.
war: Kundi han pag-abot na nira kan Jesus, hinkit-an nira nga patay na hiya, sanglit waray na la nira baria an iya mga bitiis.

en: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
war: Kundi ginbangkaw an iya kagiliran hin usa han mga sondalo, ngan inmawas dayon in dugo ug tubig. (

en: The one who saw this has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he speaks the truth, and he has testified so that you also can believe.
war: Nagpamatuod mahitungod hini an nakakita hini nga hinabo, basi tumoo man kamo. Matuod an iya iginsiring, ngan maaram hiya nga naghihimangraw hiya han kamatuoran.)

en: These things happened to fulfill the scripture, They won’t break any of his bones .
war: Ginbuhat ini basi matuman an kasuratan nga nasiring, “Waray usa han iya mga tul-an nga mababari.”

en: And another scripture says, They will look at him whom they have pierced.
war: Ngan may-ada lain pa nga bahin han kasuratan nga nasiring, “Makita an mga tawo ngadto hadton ginbangkaw nira.”

en: After this Joseph of Arimathea asked Pilate if he could take away the body of Jesus. Joseph was a disciple of Jesus, but a secret one because he feared the Jewish authorities. Pilate gave him permission, so he came and took the body away.
war: Katapos hini, ginhangyo hi Pilato ni Jose nga taga-Arimatea, nga tugotan hiya pagkuha han lawas ni Jesus. (Tinun-an ni Jesus ini hi Jose, kundi hilom la, kay nahadlok hiya han mga punoan nga Judiyo.) Gintugotan hiya ni Pilato, sanglit kinmadto hi Jose ngan gintanggal niya an lawas ni Jesus.

en: Nicodemus, the one who at first had come to Jesus at night, was there too. He brought a mixture of myrrh and aloe, nearly seventy-five pounds in all.
war: Binmunyog ha iya hi Nicodemo, an tawo nga nakigkita kan Jesus ha usa ka gab-i. May dara hiya nga mga kwarenta ka kilo nga pahamot nga sinakot nga mira ug aloe.

en: Following Jewish burial customs, they took Jesus’ body and wrapped it, with the spices, in linen cloths.
war: Ginkuha nira nga duha an lawas ni Jesus ngan ginputos hin lino nga mga dugnit upod han mga pahamot sumala han batasan hin paglubong han mga Judiyo.

en: There was a garden in the place where Jesus was crucified, and in the garden was a new tomb in which no one had ever been laid.
war: May-ada tanaman didto han dapit nga ginraysangan kan Jesus, ngan nakada in bag-o nga lubnganan nga waray pa paglubngi.

en: Because it was the Jewish Preparation Day and the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus in it.
war: Tungod kay bisperas na adto han Adlaw nga Iparahuway, ngan hirani manla an lubnganan, didto na la nira iglubong hi Jesus.

en: Early in the morning of the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene came to the tomb and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.
war: Temprano pa han aga han Domingo, samtang masirom pa, kinmadto hi Maria Magdalena ha lubnganan, ngan hinkit-an niya nga kinuha na an bato nga ginsada han lubnganan.

en: She ran to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one whom Jesus loved, and said, “They have taken the Lord from the tomb, and we don’t know where they’ve put him.”
war: Nagdalagan hiya ngadto kanda Simon Pedro ngan han tinun-an nga hinigugma ni Jesus, ngan ginsumatan hira, “Ginkuha nira ha lubnganan an Ginoo, ngan diri kita maaram kon diin nira ibutang hiya!”

en: Peter and the other disciple left to go to the tomb.
war: Ngan napakadto dayon ha lubnganan hi Pedro ngan an usa nga tinun-an.

en: They were running together, but the other disciple ran faster than Peter and was the first to arrive at the tomb.
war: Nagdalagan hira nga duha, kundi nahiuna pag-abot ha lubnganan an usa nga tinun-an kay malurolaksi hiya dumalagan kan Pedro.

en: Bending down to take a look, he saw the linen cloths lying there, but he didn’t go in.
war: Inmubo hiya hin paghiling ngan hinkit-an niya an lino nga mga dugnit, kundi waray hiya sumulod.

en: Following him, Simon Peter entered the tomb and saw the linen cloths lying there.
war: Inmabot hi Simon Pedro nga sinmunod ha iya, ngan sinmulod dayon han lubnganan. Hinkit-an niya didto an lino nga mga dugnit.

en: He also saw the face cloth that had been on Jesus’ head. It wasn’t with the other clothes but was folded up in its own place.
war: Diri na tampo han lino nga mga dugnit an panyo nga iginputos han ulo ni Jesus, kundi bulag nga nalulukot ha piliw.

en: Then the other disciple, the one who arrived at the tomb first, also went inside. He saw and believed.
war: Ngan sinmulod liwat an tinun-an nga una makaabot han lubnganan; nakakita hiya ngan tinmoo. (

en: They didn’t yet understand the scripture that Jesus must rise from the dead.
war: Waray pa gihapon hira makasabot han kasuratan nga nagsiring nga kinahanglan mabanhaw hiya.)

en: Then the disciples returned to the place where they were staying.
war: Ngan nanngoli an mga tinun-an.

en: Mary stood outside near the tomb, crying. As she cried, she bent down to look into the tomb.
war: Nagtitinangis hi Maria nga natukdaw ha gawas han lubnganan. Nagtitinangis pa hiya han pag-ubo niya hin paghiling han lubnganan,

en: She saw two angels dressed in white, seated where the body of Jesus had been, one at the head and one at the foot.
war: ngan hinkit-an niya didto in duha nga mga anghel nga nakakabado hin busag, ngan nagkakalingkod ha dapit nga ginpahigdaan kan Jesus, usa ha ulohan, ngan an usa ha tiilan.

en: The angels asked her, “Woman, why are you crying?” She replied, “They have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they’ve put him.”
war: Nagpakiana hira ha iya, “Babaye, kay ano nga nagtitinangis ka?” Nagbaton hiya, “Ginkuha nira an akon Ginoo ngan diri ako maaram kon diin nira igbutang hiya.”

en: As soon as she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, but she didn’t know it was Jesus.
war: Han pakayakan niya hini, tinmalikod hiya ngan hinkit-an niya hi Jesus nga natukdaw didto, kundi waray hiya makakilala nga hi Jesus adto.

en: Jesus said to her, “ Woman, why are you crying? Who are you looking for? ” Thinking he was the gardener, she replied, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have put him and I will get him.”
war: Nagpakiana hi Jesus ha iya, “Babaye, kay ano nga nagtitinangis ka? Hin-o an imo ginbibiling?” Naghunahuna hiya nga an magmarangno adto han tanaman, sanglit ginsiring niya, “Mano, kon ikaw man lugaring an nagkuha ha iya, sumati ako kon diin mo igbutang hiya, ngan kukuhaon ko hiya.”

en: Jesus said to her, “ Mary. ” She turned and said to him in Aramaic, “Rabbouni” (which means Teacher ).
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Maria!” Inmatubang hi Maria ngan nagsiring ha iya ha Hebreo, “Raboni!” (“Magturutdo” an kahulogan hini.)

en: Jesus said to her, “ Don’t hold on to me, for I haven’t yet gone up to my Father. Go to my brothers and sisters and tell them, ‘I’m going up to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’ ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Ayaw ako pagkapti, kay waray pa ako saka ngadto han Amay. Kadtoa lugod an akon kabugtoan ngan sumati hira nga masaka ako ngadto han akon Amay ngan iyo Amay, han akon Dyos ngan iyo Dyos.”

en: Mary Magdalene left and announced to the disciples, “I’ve seen the Lord.” Then she told them what he said to her.
war: Sanglit linmakat hi Maria Magdalena ngan ginsumatan niya an mga tinun-an nga hinkit-an niya an Ginoo ngan amo ini an iginsiring han Ginoo ha iya.

en: It was still the first day of the week. That evening, while the disciples were behind closed doors because they were afraid of the Jewish authorities, Jesus came and stood among them. He said, “ Peace be with you. ”
war: Han pagkagab-i na hadto ngahaw nga Domingo, nagtirok an mga tinun-an ha sulod hin balay nga trinangkahan an mga porta, kay nahadlok hira han mga punoan nga Judiyo. Ngan inmabot hi Jesus ngan tinmukdaw ha butnga nira ngan nagsiring, “An kalinaw maada ha iyo.”

en: After he said this, he showed them his hands and his side. When the disciples saw the Lord, they were filled with joy.
war: Katapos niya pagsiring hini, iginpakita niya ha ira an iya mga kamot ngan an iya kagiliran. Nalipay an mga tinun-an han pakakita nira han Ginoo.

en: Jesus said to them again, “ Peace be with you. As the Father sent me, so I am sending you. ”
war: Ngan nagsiring liwat hi Jesus ha ira, “An kalinaw maada ha iyo. Sugad nga ginsugo ako han Amay, sinusugo ko man kamo.”

en: Then he breathed on them and said, “ Receive the Holy Spirit.
war: Ginhuypan hira niya nga sidngon, “Karawata niyo an Espiritu Santo.

en: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they are forgiven; if you don’t forgive them, they aren’t forgiven. ”
war: Kon pasayloon niyo an mga sala han mga tawo, pasasayloon hira; ngan kon diri niyo pasayloon hira, diri man hira pasasayloon.”

en: Thomas, the one called Didymus, one of the Twelve, wasn’t with the disciples when Jesus came.
war: Diri kaupod nira hi Tomas, (an gintatawag nga karuha) nga usa han dose nga mga tinun-an, han pagpakita ni Jesus ha ira.

en: The other disciples told him, “We’ve seen the Lord!” But he replied, “Unless I see the nail marks in his hands, put my finger in the wounds left by the nails, and put my hand into his side, I won’t believe.”
war: Sanglit ginsumatan hiya han iba nga mga tinun-an, “Hinkit-an namon an Ginoo!” Nagsiring hi Tomas ha ira, “Diri ako matuod kon diri ko hikit-an an mga ulat han ginlahosan han mga raysang dida han iya mga kamot ngan mahibutang ko an akon tudlo dida hini nga mga ulat ngan mahiram han akon kamot an iya kagiliran.”

en: After eight days his disciples were again in a house and Thomas was with them. Even though the doors were locked, Jesus entered and stood among them. He said, “ Peace be with you. ”
war: Paglabay hin usa ka semana, nagkaurosa na liwat an mga tinun-an ha sulod hin balay, ngan upod na nira hi Tomas. Trangkado an mga porta, kundi inmabot hi Jesus ngan tinmukdaw ha butnga nira ngan nagsiring, “An kalinaw maada ha iyo.”

en: Then he said to Thomas, “ Put your finger here. Look at my hands. Put your hand into my side. No more disbelief. Believe! ”
war: Ngan nagsiring hiya kan Tomas, “Ibutang didi an imo tudlo, ngan kitaa an akon mga kamot; ngan ikadi an imo kamot ngan hirama an akon kagiliran. Ayaw na pagruhaduha, tuo na!”

en: Thomas responded to Jesus, “My Lord and my God!”
war: Nagbaton hi Tomas ha iya, “Ginoo ko ngan Dyos ko!”

en: Jesus replied, “ Do you believe because you see me? Happy are those who don’t see and yet believe. ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Natoo ka na ba kay nakakita ka ha akon? Palaran adton natoo bisan waray makakita ha akon!”

en: Then Jesus did many other miraculous signs in his disciples’ presence, signs that aren’t recorded in this scroll.
war: Ginbuhat ni Jesus in damo pa nga mga milagro ha atubangan han iya mga tinun-an, nga waray mahisurat dida hini nga basahan.

en: But these things are written so that you will believe that Jesus is the Christ, God’s Son, and that believing, you will have life in his name.
war: Kundi iginsurat ini, basi tumoo kamo nga hi Jesus amo an Mesiyas, an Anak han Dyos, nga pinaagi hini nga pagtoo ha iya, makaangkon unta kamo han kinabuhi.

en: Later, Jesus himself appeared again to his disciples at the Sea of Tiberias. This is how it happened:
war: Katapos hini, nagpakita liwat hi Jesus ngadto han iya mga tinun-an didto ha Lanaw han Tiberias. Sugad hini an iya pagpakita.

en: Simon Peter, Thomas (called Didymus ), Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, Zebedee’s sons, and two other disciples were together.
war: Urosa hira Simon Pedro, hi Tomas (an tinatawag nga Karuha), hi Natanael (an taga-Cana, ha Galilea), an mga anak ni Sebedeo, nga duha pa nga mga tinun-an ni Jesus.

en: Simon Peter told them, “I’m going fishing.” They said, “We’ll go with you.” They set out in a boat, but throughout the night they caught nothing.
war: Nagsiring hi Simon Pedro ha ira, “Mangingisda ako.” “Maupod kami,” nagsiring hira. Sanglit kinmadto hira ngan kinmalawod hira; kundi waray gud nira nadakop hadto nga bug-os nga gab-i.

en: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples didn’t realize it was Jesus.
war: Han tisirang na an adlaw, tinmindog hi Jesus ha baybayon, kundi waray makakilala an mga tinun-an nga hi Jesus ngay-an adto.

en: Jesus called to them, “ Children, have you caught anything to eat? ” They answered him, “No.”
war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Nakadakop ba kamo?” “Waray!” binmaton hira.

en: He said, “ Cast your net on the right side of the boat and you will find some. ” So they did, and there were so many fish that they couldn’t haul in the net.
war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Huloga an iyo pukot ha tuo han sakayan, ngan makakadakop kamo.” Sanglit ginhulog nira an pukot, ngan waray na hira pakakaakos hin pag-alsa tungod han kadamo han isda.

en: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” When Simon Peter heard it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked) and jumped into the water.
war: Nagsiring kan Pedro an tinun-an nga hinigugma ni Jesus, “Amo hiya an Ginoo!” Han pakabati ni Simon Pedro nga amo hiya an Ginoo, iginbagkos niya an iya bado (kay lubas man hiya) ngan linmukso ngadto ha tubig.

en: The other disciples followed in the boat, dragging the net full of fish, for they weren’t far from shore, only about one hundred yards.
war: Dinmuong ha baybayon an iba nga mga tinun-an, nga nagbubutong han pukot nga puno hin isda, kay diri man hira hirayo ha tabi, may mga 60 la ka dupa.

en: When they landed, they saw a fire there, with fish on it, and some bread.
war: Paghaw-as na nira, hinkit-an nira in mga baga nga may ginsusugba nga isda ngan mga tinapay.

en: Jesus said to them, “ Bring some of the fish that you’ve just caught. ”
war: Ngan nagsiring ha ira hi Jesus, “Pagdara ngadi hin mga isda nga iyo pa la nadakop.”

en: Simon Peter got up and pulled the net to shore. It was full of large fish, one hundred fifty-three of them. Yet the net hadn’t torn, even with so many fish.
war: Sanglit sinmakay hi Pedro ngan ginguyod niya ngadto ha baybayon an pukot nga puno hin dagko nga mga isda, 153 ngatanan; waray magisi an pukot, bisan kon damo hin duro an mga isda.

en: Jesus said to them, “ Come and have breakfast. ” None of the disciples could bring themselves to ask him, “Who are you?” They knew it was the Lord.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Kadi, ngan pamahaw kita.” Waray gud han mga tinun-an nangahas hin pagpakiana ha iya, “Hin-o ka?” kay nasayod man hira nga amo hiya an Ginoo.

en: Jesus came, took the bread, and gave it to them. He did the same with the fish.
war: Sanglit dinmaop hi Jesus, ginkuha an tinapay, ngan iginhatag ha ira, ngan sugad man an mga isda.

en: This was now the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from the dead.
war: Amo ini an ikatulo nga pagpakita ni Jesus han iya mga tinun-an katapos niya mabanhaw.
