war: Niyan nanguli hira ngan nag-andam hin mga pahamot ngan mga idirihog han iya lawas. Pinmahuway hira ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway sumala han sugo han Balaod.

en: Very early in the morning on the first day of the week, the women went to the tomb, bringing the fragrant spices they had prepared.
war: Maagahon pa gud han Domingo kinmadto na ha lubnganan an kababayen-an dara an mga pahamot nga ira gin-andam.

en: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb,
war: Hinkit-an nira nga nakadto na ha ligid an bato nga igintaklob han porta han lubnganan,

en: but when they went in, they didn’t find the body of the Lord Jesus.
war: sanglit sinmulod hira; kundi waray nira hiagii an lawas han Ginoo nga Jesus.

en: They didn’t know what to make of this. Suddenly, two men were standing beside them in gleaming bright clothing.
war: Samtang natindog hira didto nga nagugupong mahitungod hini, tinmindog dayon tupad ha ira in duha nga kalalaken-an nga magsilaw an mga panapton.

en: The women were frightened and bowed their faces toward the ground, but the men said to them, “Why do you look for the living among the dead?
war: Tugob hin kahadlok yinmukbo ha tuna an kababayen-an, samtang ginsiring hira han kalalaken-an, “Kay ano nga ginbibiling niyo an buhi dinhe han mga minatay?

en: He isn’t here, but has been raised. Remember what he told you while he was still in Galilee,
war: Waray na hiya dinhe, nabanhaw na hiya. Panumdoma an iginsiring niya ha iyo han nakadto pa hiya ha Galilea:

en: that the Human One must be handed over to sinners, be crucified, and on the third day rise again.”
war: ‘Kinahanglan itubyan an Anak han Tawo ngadto han mga makasasala, igraysang ha kros, ngan mabanhaw ha ikatulo ka adlaw.’”

en: Then they remembered his words.
war: Niyan nahinumdom an kababayen-an han iya mga pulong,

en: When they returned from the tomb, they reported all these things to the eleven and all the others.
war: inmoli hira tikang han lubnganan, ngan iginsumat ini ngatanan nga mga butang ngadto han onse nga mga tinun-an ngan han iba pa.

en: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the other women with them who told these things to the apostles.
war: An kababayen-an amo hira Maria Magdalena, Juana, ug Maria nga iroy ni Santiago. Hira ngan an iba pa nga kababayen-an nga kaupod nira nagsumat han mga apostoles hini nga mga butang.

en: Their words struck the apostles as nonsense, and they didn’t believe the women.
war: Kundi naghunahuna an mga apostoles nga kalurongan la an iginsiring han kababayen-an ngan waray tumuod ha ira.

en: But Peter ran to the tomb. When he bent over to look inside, he saw only the linen cloth. Then he returned home, wondering what had happened.
war: Kundi binmuhat hi Pedro ngan nagdalagan ngadto ha lubnganan. Inmubo hiya hin paghiling, ngan hinkit-an niya an lino nga mga dugnit ngan waray na iba nga iya hinkit-an. Ngan inmoli hiya nga dako an paghipausa hiunong han nahinabo.

en: On that same day, two disciples were traveling to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.
war: Hadto manta nga adlaw duha han kan Jesus mga tinun-an napakadto ha usa nga baryo nga Emmaus an ngaran, mga onse ka kilometro tikang ha Jerusalem.

en: They were talking to each other about everything that had happened.
war: Naghihinimangraw hira mahitungod han ngatanan nga mga butang nga nanhinabo.

en: While they were discussing these things, Jesus himself arrived and joined them on their journey.
war: Samtang naghihimangraw hira, dinmaop hi Jesus ngan binmunyog ha ira.

en: They were prevented from recognizing him.
war: Hinkit-an hiya nira, kundi ambot kon ano nga waray man hira pakakilala ha iya.

en: He said to them, “ What are you talking about as you walk along? ” They stopped, their faces downcast.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Mahitungod hin ano an iyo ginkakarukayakan samtang naglalakat kamo?” Inmukoy hira nga mabidoon an ira mga bayhon.

en: The one named Cleopas replied, “Are you the only visitor to Jerusalem who is unaware of the things that have taken place there over the last few days?”
war: Nagpakiana ha iya an usa ha ira nga Cleopas an ngaran, “Ikaw gud la an umurukoy ha Jerusalem nga waray mahibaro han mga butang nga nanhinabo didto hini nga pira ka mga adlaw nga naglabay?”

en: He said to them, “ What things? ” They said to him, “The things about Jesus of Nazareth. Because of his powerful deeds and words, he was recognized by God and all the people as a prophet.
war: “Ano nga mga butang?” nagpakiana hiya. Nagbaton hira, “An mga butang nga nahinabo kan Jesus nga taga-Nazaret. Manaragna ini nga tawo, ngan gin-iisip han Dyos ngan han ngatanan nga mga tawo nga may gahom ha ngatanan nga iya ginyakan ug ginbuhat.

en: But our chief priests and our leaders handed him over to be sentenced to death, and they crucified him.
war: Igintubyan hiya han amon mga puno han kapadian ngan mga punoan nga sirotan han kamatayon ngan iginraysang hiya ha kros.

en: We had hoped he was the one who would redeem Israel. All these things happened three days ago.
war: Ngan naglaom gud kami nga amo hiya an magtutubos han Israel! Labot pa hini ngatanan, amo na yana an ikatulo ka adlaw tikang mahinabo ini.

en: But there’s more: Some women from our group have left us stunned. They went to the tomb early this morning
war: Nanhipausa kami han sumat hin pira nga kababayen-an han amon hugpo. Kinmadto hira ha lubnganan han maagahon pa,

en: and didn’t find his body. They came to us saying that they had even seen a vision of angels who told them he is alive.
war: kundi waray hiagii nira an iya lawas. Binmalik hira hin pagsumat nga nakakita hira hin panan-awon hin mga anghel nga nagsumat ha ira nga buhi hiya.

en: Some of those who were with us went to the tomb and found things just as the women said. They didn’t see him.”
war: Kinmadto ha lubnganan in pira han amon hugpo, ngan hinsabotan nira sumala han iginsiring ha kababayen-an, kundi waray hira makakita ha iya.”

en: Then Jesus said to them, “ You foolish people! Your dull minds keep you from believing all that the prophets talked about.
war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Hin ka mga lurong niyo, hin kahinay niyo tumoo han ngatanan nga iginsiring han mga manaragna!

en: Wasn’t it necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and then enter into his glory? ”
war: Diri ba kinahanglan mag-antos anay an Mesiyas hini nga mga butang san-o hiya makasulod han iya himaya?”

en: Then he interpreted for them the things written about himself in all the scriptures, starting with Moses and going through all the Prophets.
war: Niyan iginsaysay ha ira ni Jesus an iginsiring mahitungod ha iya ha ngatanan nga Kasuratan, tikang han mga basahan ni Moises ngan han mga sinurat han ngatanan nga mga manaragna.

en: When they came to Emmaus, he acted as if he was going on ahead.
war: Inmabot hira hirani han baryo nga ira kinakadtoan, ngan nagpakita hi Jesus nga sugad hin magpapadayon pa hiya ngadto ha unhan;

en: But they urged him, saying, “Stay with us. It’s nearly evening, and the day is almost over.” So he went in to stay with them.
war: kundi ginhawiran hiya nira, “Pabilin na la upod ha amon kay kulopay na man ngan tikasirom na.” Sanglit sinmulod hiya ngan nagpabilin upod ha ira.

en: After he took his seat at the table with them, he took the bread, blessed and broke it, and gave it to them.
war: Linmingkod hiya ha lamesa upod ha ira, kinmuha han tinapay, ngan ginbendisyonan ini niya; katapos, ginpinitpinit niya an tinapay ngan iginhatag ha ira.

en: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him, but he disappeared from their sight.
war: Nabuksan an ira mga mata ngan kinmilala hira ha iya; kundi napara hiya dayon ha ira mga mata.

en: They said to each other, “Weren’t our hearts on fire when he spoke to us along the road and when he explained the scriptures for us?”
war: Naggipasiringsiring hira, “Diri ba sugad hin kalayo nga nagdidilaab dinhe ha aton, han nagyayakan hiya ha aton dida ha dalan, ngan nagsasaysay ha aton han Kasuratan?”

en: They got up right then and returned to Jerusalem. They found the eleven and their companions gathered together.
war: Nagkabuhat hira dayon ngan binmalik ha Jerusalem, diin ira hin-agian nga nagkakatirok an onse nga mga tinun-an, kaupod han iba

en: They were saying to each other, “The Lord really has risen! He appeared to Simon!”
war: nga nagsiring, “Tinuod gud nga nabanhaw an Ginoo! Nagpakita hiya kan Simon!”

en: Then the two disciples described what had happened along the road and how Jesus was made known to them as he broke the bread.
war: Niyan iginsaysay nira nga duha ha ira an nahinabo ha dalan ngan kon naunan-o an ira pakakilala han Ginoo dida han pagpinitpinit niya han tinapay.

en: While they were saying these things, Jesus himself stood among them and said, “ Peace be with you! ”
war: Samtang nagsusumat hira hini ha ira, tigda la nga tinmindog an Ginoo ngahaw ha butnga nira ngan ginsiring hira, “An kalinaw maada ha iyo.”

en: They were terrified and afraid. They thought they were seeing a ghost.
war: Tugob hira hin kahadlok ngan kakulba. An ira hunahuna nga kinmita hira hin kalag.

en: He said to them, “ Why are you startled? Why are doubts arising in your hearts?
war: Kundi nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Kay ano nga nababaraka man kamo? Kay ano nga nagruruhaduha man kamo ha iyo mga hunahuna?

en: Look at my hands and my feet. It’s really me! Touch me and see, for a ghost doesn’t have flesh and bones like you see I have. ”
war: Panginanoa an akon mga kamot ngan mga tiil, ngan kitaa, hi ako gud ini. Kapti ako niyo ngan masabot kamo, kay waray unod ngan mga tul-an an usa nga kalag, sugad han iyo nakikita nga aanhi ha akon.”

en: As he said this, he showed them his hands and feet.
war: Iginsiring niya ini ngan iginpakita niya ha ira an iya mga kamot ngan mga tiil.

en: Because they were wondering and questioning in the midst of their happiness, he said to them, “ Do you have anything to eat? ”
war: Waray la gihapon hira makakatoo tungod han ira dako nga kalipay ngan paghipausa, sanglit nagpakiana hiya ha ira, “May-ada ba niyo sadang makaon dinhe?”

en: They gave him a piece of baked fish.
war: Gintagan hiya nira hin sinugba nga isda,

en: Taking it, he ate it in front of them.
war: ngan kinarawat ini ni Jesus ngan ginkaon ha ira atubangan.

en: Jesus said to them, “ These are my words that I spoke to you while I was still with you—that everything written about me in the Law from Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms must be fulfilled. ”
war: Niyan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Amo gud ini an mga butang nga iginsumat ko ha iyo han kaupod pa ako niyo: kinahanglan matuman an ngatanan nga nahisurat mahitungod ha akon dida han Balaod ni Moises, han mga sinurat han mga manaragna, ngan han mga Salmo.”

en: Then he opened their minds to understand the scriptures.
war: Ngan ginbuksan niya an ira mga hunahuna basi makasabot hira han Kasuratan,

en: He said to them, “ This is what is written: the Christ will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,
war: ngan nagsiring ha ira, “Amo ini an nahisurat: kinahanglan mag-antos an Mesiyas ngan mabanhaw ha ikatulo ka adlaw,

en: and a change of heart and life for the forgiveness of sins must be preached in his name to all nations, beginning from Jerusalem.
war: ngan ha iya ngaran kinahanglan igwali ha ngatanan nga mga nasod, tikang ha Jerusalem, an mensahe mahitungod han pagbasol ngan pagpasaylo han mga sala.

en: You are witnesses of these things.
war: Mga saksi kamo hini nga mga butang.

en: Look, I’m sending to you what my Father promised, but you are to stay in the city until you have been furnished with heavenly power. ”
war: Ngan ako ngahaw an magpapadara nganhi ha iyo han iginsaad han akon Amay. Kundi kinahanglan maghulat kamo didto ha syudad tubtob nga kumunsad ha iyo an gahom nga tikang ha igbaw.”

en: He led them out as far as Bethany, where he lifted his hands and blessed them.
war: Niyan gindara hira niya ha gawas han syudad tubtob ha Betania diin gin-alsa niya an iya mga kamot ngan ginbendisyonan hira.

en: As he blessed them, he left them and was taken up to heaven.
war: Samtang nagbebendisyon hiya ha ira, binmaya hiya ha ira ngan ginbayaw hiya ha langit.

en: They worshipped him and returned to Jerusalem overwhelmed with joy.
war: Nagsingba hira ha iya ngan binmalik hira ngadto ha Jerusalem, nga malipayon,

en: And they were continuously in the temple praising God.
war: ngan dayuday didto hira ha Templo, hin pagpasalamat han Dyos.

en: A record of the ancestors of Jesus Christ, son of David, son of Abraham:
war: Amo ini an pagkasunodsunod han mga kaapoy-apoyan ni Jesu-Cristo nga tulin ni David, nga tulin ni Abraham.

en: Abraham was the father of Isaac. Isaac was the father of Jacob. Jacob was the father of Judah and his brothers.
war: 2-6a Tikang kan Abraham ngadto kan Hadi David, amo ini an mga kaapoy-apoyan: Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Juda, ngan an iya kabugtoan; Fares ug Sara (an iroy nira amo hi Tamar), Esrom, Aram, Aminadab, Naason, Salmon, Boos (an iroy niya amo hi Rahab), Obed (an iroy niya amo hi Rut), Isai, ngan hi Hadi David.

en: Judah was the father of Perez and Zerah, whose mother was Tamar. Perez was the father of Hezron. Hezron was the father of Aram.
war: 6b-11 Tikang kan David ngadto han panahon han pagbalhina nga mga bihag han mga tawo han Israel ngadto ha Babilonia, amo ini an mga kaapoy-apoyan: David, Solomon (an iroy niya amo an asawa anay ni Urias), Roboam, Abias, Asa, Josafat, Joram, Usias, Jotam, Acas, Ezequias, Manases, Amon, Josias, ngan hi Jeconias ngan an iya kabugtoan.

en: Aram was the father of Amminadab. Amminadab was the father of Nahshon. Nahshon was the father of Salmon.
war: 12-16 Tikang han panahon kahuman han kabalhin nira nga mga bihag ha Babilonia ngadto han katawo ni Jesus, amo ini an mga kaapoy-apoyan: Salatiel, Sorobabel, Abiud, Eliaquim, Asor, Sadoc, Aquim, Eliud, Eleasar, Matan, Jacob, ngan Jose nga nangasawa kan Maria, an iroy ni Jesus nga ginngaranan nga Mesiyas.

en: Salmon was the father of Boaz, whose mother was Rahab. Boaz was the father of Obed, whose mother was Ruth. Obed was the father of Jesse.
war: Sanglit, may-ada katorse ngatanan nga katulinan tikang kan Abraham ngadto kan David, katorse man nga katulinan tikang kan David ngadto han kabalhin nira nga mga bihag ha Babilonia, ngan katorse liwat nga katulinan tikang han kabalhin nira nga mga bihag ha Babilonia ngadto han katawo han Mesiyas.

en: Jesse was the father of David the king. David was the father of Solomon, whose mother had been the wife of Uriah.
war: Sugad hini an katawo ni Jesu-Cristo. Han karaslon pa la hi Maria nga iroy niya ngan hi Jose, nahibaroan ni Maria nga burod na hiya ha larang han Espiritu Santo.

en: Solomon was the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam was the father of Abijah. Abijah was the father of Asaph.
war: Diri karuyag magpakaalo kan Maria hi Jose kay matadong hiya nga tawo. Sanglit, nakahunahuna hiya hin pagbaya kan Maria hin hilom la.

en: Asaph was the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat was the father of Joram. Joram was the father of Uzziah.
war: Kundi samtang ginhunahuna niya ini, pinmakita ha iya in usa nga anghel han Ginoo pinaagi hin inop, ngan nagsiring, “Jose, tulin ni David, ayaw pag-alang hin pagkarawat kan Maria nga imo asawa kay nagburod hiya ha larang han Espiritu Santo.

en: Uzziah was the father of Jotham. Jotham was the father of Ahaz. Ahaz was the father of Hezekiah.
war: Mag-aanak hiya hin lalake, ngan pagngangaranan mo hiya nga Jesus, kay magtatalwas hiya han iya katawhan tikang han ira mga sala.”

en: Hezekiah was the father of Manasseh. Manasseh was the father of Amos. Amos was the father of Josiah.
war: Nahinabo ini ngatanan basi matuman an iginyakan han Ginoo pinaagi han manaragna nga nasiring,

en: Josiah was the father of Jechoniah and his brothers. This was at the time of the exile to Babylon.
war: “Magbuburod in usa nga uray nga daraga ngan mag-aanak hin lalake, ngan tatawgon hiya nga Emmanuel” (nga karuyag sidngon, “An Dyos aanhi upod ha aton”).

en: After the exile to Babylon: Jechoniah was the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel was the father of Zerubbabel.
war: Sanglit, han pagmata ni Jose, gintuman niya an iginsugo ha iya han anghel han Ginoo, ngan pinangasawa niya hi Maria.

en: Zerubbabel was the father of Abiud. Abiud was the father of Eliakim. Eliakim was the father of Azor.
war: Kundi hi Jose waray makighilawas kan Maria tubtob nga nag-anak hi Maria. Ngan Jesus an iginngaran ni Jose han bata.

en: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in the territory of Judea during the rule of King Herod, magi came from the east to Jerusalem.
war: Natawo hi Jesus ha bungto han Betlehem, ha tuna han Judea, han panahon nga hi Herodes an hadi. Waray pag-iha, nagkaabot ha Jerusalem, tikang ha sinirangan, in mga tawo nga batid hin kamaaram bahin han kabitun-an,

en: They asked, “Where is the newborn king of the Jews? We’ve seen his star in the east, and we’ve come to honor him.”
war: ngan nagpakiana hira, “Hain ba an natawo nga bata nga hadi han mga Judiyo? Hinkit-an namon ha sinirangan an iya bituon, ngan kinmanhi kami hin pagsingba ha iya.”

en: When King Herod heard this, he was troubled, and everyone in Jerusalem was troubled with him.
war: Han pakabati hini ni Hadi Herodes, nabaraka hiya pati an bug-os nga Jerusalem.

en: He gathered all the chief priests and the legal experts and asked them where the Christ was to be born.
war: Gintirok niya an ngatanan nga mga puno han kapadian ngan mga magturutdo han Balaod, ngan ginpakianhan hira, “Diin ba matatawo an Mesiyas?”

en: They said, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is what the prophet wrote:
war: “Didto ha bungto han Betlehem, ha Judea,” nagbaton hira. “Amo ini an iginsurat han manaragna:

en: You, Bethlehem, land of Judah, by no means are you least among the rulers of Judah, because from you will come one who governs, who will shepherd my people Israel.
war: ‘Ikaw Betlehem, ha tuna han Juda, diri ka gud amo an giuubosi han mga bungto han Juda; kay magawas tikang ha imo in usa nga pangulo nga magpapakaupay han akon katawhan nga Israel.’”

en: Then Herod secretly called for the magi and found out from them the time when the star had first appeared.
war: Sanglit, iginpatawag ni Herodes hin hilom an mga kamag-araman nga tikang ha sinirangan. Hinbaroan niya tikang ha ira an untop nga takna han pagpakita han bitoon.

en: He sent them to Bethlehem, saying, “Go and search carefully for the child. When you’ve found him, report to me so that I too may go and honor him.”
war: Ngan ginpakadto hira ha Betlehem ngan gintugon hira: “Pakadto kamo, ngan pamilnga niyo hin maupay an bata. Kon hiagian niyo, pahibaroa ako dayon, basi kumadto man ako hin pagsingba ha iya.”

en: When they heard the king, they went; and look, the star they had seen in the east went ahead of them until it stood over the place where the child was.
war: 9-10 Ngan nagkalakat hira. Nakita nira an amo ngahaw nga bitoon nga hinkit-an nira ha sinirangan. Nalipay hira han pakakita nira han bitoon. Nag-una ini ha ira tubtob nga tinmungod ngan hinmunong ha dapit nga hinmumutangan han bata.

en: When they saw the star, they were filled with joy.
war: Sinmulod hira han balay ngan hinkit-an nira an bata upod hi Maria nga iroy niya. Linmuhod hira, ngan nagsingba ha iya. Binuksan nira an ira mga dara ngan naghalad hira ha iya hin bulawan, insyenso ug mira.

en: They entered the house and saw the child with Mary his mother. Falling to their knees, they honored him. Then they opened their treasure chests and presented him with gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
war: Ginpahimangno hira han Dyos pinaagi hin inop nga diri na bumalik hira ngadto kan Herodes; sanglit nangoli hira ngan lain nga dalan an ira gin-agian.

en: Because they were warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country by another route.
war: Han paghilakat na nira, pinmakita kan Jose ha inop in usa nga anghel han Ginoo ngan nagsiring, “Buhat, dad-a an bata ngan an iroy niya, ngan palagiw kamo ngadto ha Ehipto. Pabilin kamo didto ngada han pagsidnga ko ha iyo, kay magbibiling han bata hi Herodes basi patayon niya.”

en: When the magi had departed, an angel from the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, “Get up. Take the child and his mother and escape to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod will soon search for the child in order to kill him.”
war: Binmuhat hi Jose, gindara niya an bata ngan an iroy, ngan pinmalagiw hira ngadto ha Ehipto hadto ngahaw nga gab-i.

en: Joseph got up and, during the night, took the child and his mother to Egypt.
war: Nagpabilin hira didto ngada han kamatay ni Herodes. Nahinabo ini basi matuman an iginsiring han Ginoo pinaagi han manaragna, “Gintawag ko an akon Anak tikang ha Ehipto.”

en: He stayed there until Herod died. This fulfilled what the Lord had spoken through the prophet: I have called my son out of Egypt .
war: Duro an kapungot ni Herodes han pakasabot niya nga gintuyaw la hiya han mga kamag-araman nga tikang ha sinirangan. Nagsugo hiya nga pamatayon an ngatanan nga kabataan nga kalalaken-an ha Betlehem ngan ha higrani nga mga dapit nga may duha ka tuig an panuigon ug bisan diri pa duha ka tuig sumala han iya nahibaroan tikang han mga bisita han takna han pagpakita han bitoon.

en: When Herod knew the magi had fooled him, he grew very angry. He sent soldiers to kill all the children in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding territory who were two years old and younger, according to the time that he had learned from the magi.
war: Dida hini natuman an iginsurat ni Jeremias nga manaragna nga nasiring:

en: This fulfilled the word spoken through Jeremiah the prophet:
war: “Binati in tingog ha Rama, tingog hin mapait nga pagnguyngoy ngan pagtangis. Nagtangis hi Raquel tungod han iya mga anak, nagtangis hiya ngan waray makakaliaw ha iya, kay patay na hira ngatanan.”

en: A voice was heard in Ramah, weeping and much grieving. Rachel weeping for her children, and she did not want to be comforted, because they were no more.
war: Han kamatay na ni Herodes, pinmakita kan Jose pinaagi hin inop didto ha Ehipto in usa nga anghel han Ginoo.

en: After King Herod died, an angel from the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt.
war: Nagsiring hiya, “Buhat, dad-a an bata ngan an iroy niya, ngan balik ngadto ha tuna han Israel, kay patay na an mga nagdudumot han bata.”

en: “Get up,” the angel said, “and take the child and his mother and go to the land of Israel. Those who were trying to kill the child are dead.”
war: Sanglit binmuhat hi Jose, gindara niya an bata ngan an iroy niya, ngan inmoli ngadto ha Israel.

en: Joseph got up, took the child and his mother, and went to the land of Israel.
war: Kundi han pakabati niya nga hi Arquelao nga anak ni Herodes, amo an sinmaliwan nga hadi han Judea, nahadlok hi Jose hin pag-ukoy didto. Ginpahimangno pa hiya pinaagi hin inop, sanglit kinmadto hiya ha lalawigan han Galilea;

en: But when he heard that Archelaus ruled over Judea in place of his father Herod, Joseph was afraid to go there. Having been warned in a dream, he went to the area of Galilee.
war: ngan nag-ukoy hiya ha Nazaret nga bungto, basi matuman ini nga iginsiring han manaragna: “Tatawgon hiya nga Nazareno.”

en: In those days John the Baptist appeared in the desert of Judea announcing,
war: Hadto nga panahon hi Juan nga Parabunyag kinmadto ha kamingawan han Judea ngan nagtikang hin pagwali.

en: “Change your hearts and lives! Here comes the kingdom of heaven!”
war: Nagsiring hiya, “Magbasol ngan bayai an iyo mga sala kay hirani na an Ginhadian han langit.”

en: He was the one of whom Isaiah the prophet spoke when he said: The voice of one shouting in the wilderness, “ Prepare the way for the Lord; make his paths straight. ”
war: Hi Juan amo an hinabihan ni Isaias nga manaragna han pagsiring niya: “May nagoliat ha kamingawan, ‘Andama niyo an dalan para han Ginoo; tadonga an dalan nga iya aagian!’”

en: John wore clothes made of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.
war: Hinimo hin buhok hin kamelyo an kan Juan panapton, anit an iya bakos ha hawak, ngan mga duron ngan dugos ha kagurangan an karaonon niya.

en: People from Jerusalem, throughout Judea, and all around the Jordan River came to him.
war: Kinmadto ha iya an mga tawo tikang ha Jerusalem, tikang ha bug-os nga lalawigan han Judea ngan tikang han ngatanan nga katunaan nga harani han Salog Jordan.

en: As they confessed their sins, he baptized them in the Jordan River.
war: Iginkumpisal nira an ira mga sala ngan ginbunyagan hira ni Juan didto ha Salog Jordan.

en: Many Pharisees and Sadducees came to be baptized by John. He said to them, “You children of snakes! Who warned you to escape from the angry judgment that is coming soon?
war: Han pakakita ni Juan han damo nga mga Parisiyo ngan mga Sadusiyo nga nadaop pagpabunyag ha iya, nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Kamo nga mga halas—hin-o ngani an nagsumat ha iyo nga makakalikay kamo han tiarabot nga kasina han Dyos?

en: Produce fruit that shows you have changed your hearts and lives.
war: Ipakita ha iyo mga buhat nga nagbasol na kamo han iyo mga sala.

en: And don’t even think about saying to yourselves, Abraham is our father. I tell you that God is able to raise up Abraham’s children from these stones.
war: Ayaw kamo tapod nga mga anak kamo ni Abrahan. Nasiring ako ha iyo nga ini nga mga bato mahihimo han Dyos nga mga anak ni Abraham.

en: The ax is already at the root of the trees. Therefore, every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit will be chopped down and tossed into the fire.
war: Andam na an parakol hin pagpulod han kahoy ha iya mga gamot; pupudlon ngan susunogon an tagsa nga kahoy nga diri nahatag hin maupay nga bunga.

en: I baptize with water those of you who have changed your hearts and lives. The one who is coming after me is stronger than I am. I’m not worthy to carry his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
war: Nagbubunyag ako ha iyo hin tubig, tigaman han iyo pagbasol; kundi magbubunyag ha iyo han Espiritu Santo ngan hin kalayo hiya nga masunod ha akon. Labaw gud hiya ha akon; diri ngani ako takos magbitbit han iya mga sandalyas.

en: The shovel he uses to sift the wheat from the husks is in his hands. He will clean out his threshing area and bring the wheat into his barn. But he will burn the husks with a fire that can’t be put out.”
war: Dara niya an iya nigo hin pagpalid basi an uhot mahilain han tipasi. Pagtitirokon niya an trigo didto ha iya kamalig, kundi an uhot pagsusunogon ha kalayo nga diri napaparong.”

en: At that time Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan River so that John would baptize him.
war: Hadto nga panahon, inmabot hi Jesus tikang ha Galilea, ngan kinmadto kan Juan didto ha Jordan basi bunyagan hiya ni Juan.

en: John tried to stop him and said, “I need to be baptized by you, yet you come to me?”
war: Gintalinguha ni Juan nga magbalhin hi Jesus han iya nahuhunahunaan ngan iya ginsiring, “Ako kunta an angay pagbunyagan mo, kundi ikaw lugod an napakanhi ha akon!”

en: Jesus answered, “ Allow me to be baptized now. This is necessary to fulfill all righteousness. ” So John agreed to baptize Jesus.
war: Kundi binmaton hi Jesus ha iya, “Pabay-i la anay ini yana. Kay dida hini nga paagi mahihimo naton an ngatanan nga ginkikinahanglan han Dyos.” Ngan tinmangdo hi Juan.

en: When Jesus was baptized, he immediately came up out of the water. Heaven was opened to him, and he saw the Spirit of God coming down like a dove and resting on him.
war: Han kabunyagi na kan Jesus, hinmawas hiya han tubig. Nabuksan an langit ngan hinkit-an ni Jesus an Espiritu han Dyos nga nakunsad sugad hin sarapati ngan hinmugdon dida ha iya.

en: A voice from heaven said, “This is my Son whom I dearly love; I find happiness in him.”
war: Ngan nagsiring in tingog tikang ha langit, “Amo ini an akon hinigugma nga Anak nga nakakalipay gud ha akon.”

en: Then the Spirit led Jesus up into the wilderness so that the devil might tempt him.
war: Niyan gindara hi Jesus han Espiritu ngadto han kamingawan basi pagsulayon han Yawa.

en: After Jesus had fasted for forty days and forty nights, he was starving.
war: Katapos hin 40 ka adlaw ngan 40 ka gab-i nga pagpuasa, ginutom hi Jesus.

en: The tempter came to him and said, “Since you are God’s Son, command these stones to become bread.”
war: Dinmaop ha iya an Yawa ngan nagsiring, “Kon Anak ka manggud han Dyos, himoa nga tinapay ini nga mga bato.”

en: Jesus replied, “ It’s written, People won’t live only by bread, but by every word spoken by God . ”
war: Kundi binmaton hi Jesus, “Nasiring an kasuratan, ‘Nabubuhi an tawo diri la hin tinapay, kundi han tagsa nga pulong nga ginyayakan han Dyos.’”

en: After that the devil brought him into the holy city and stood him at the highest point of the temple. He said to him,
war: Niyan gindara hiya han Yawa ngadto han Baraan nga Syudad, ngan ibinutang hiya didto han gihahataasi nga atop han Templo,

en: “Since you are God’s Son, throw yourself down; for it is written, I will command my angels concerning you, and they will take you up in their hands so that you won’t hit your foot on a stone. ”
war: ngan ginsiring hiya, “Kon Anak ka manggud han Dyos, patinhulog ngadto ha tuna kay nasiring an kasuratan, ‘Magsusugo an Dyos han iya mga anghel mahitungod ha imo; sasapnayon ka nira han ira mga kamot, basi diri mapilas an imo mga tiil ha mga bato.’”

en: Jesus replied, “ Again it’s written, Don’t test the Lord your God . ”
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Kundi nasiring man liwat an kasuratan, ‘Kinahanglan diri mo pagsulayon an Ginoo nga imo Dyos.’”

en: Then the devil brought him to a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.
war: Niyan gindara hiya han Yawa ngadto hin gihahataasi nga bukid ngan iginpakita ha iya an ngatanan nga mga ginhadian han kalibutan, ngan an ira kagamhanan.

en: He said, “I’ll give you all these if you bow down and worship me.”
war: “Ihahatag ko ha imo ini ngatanan,” nagsiring an Yawa, “kon humapa ka ngan magsingba ka ha akon.”

en: Jesus responded, “ Go away, Satan, because it’s written, You will worship the Lord your God and serve only him . ”
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Iwas dida, Satanas! Kay nasiring an kasuratan, ‘Singbahon mo an Ginoo nga imo Dyos, ngan hiya la an pag-alagdon nimo!’”

en: The devil left him, and angels came and took care of him.
war: Ngan binmaya an Yawa kan Jesus, ngan nagkaabot in mga anghel ug nagtimangno kan Jesus.

en: Now when Jesus heard that John was arrested, he went to Galilee.
war: Han pakabati ni Jesus nga napriso hi Juan, kinmadto hiya ha Galilea.

en: He left Nazareth and settled in Capernaum, which lies alongside the sea in the area of Zebulun and Naphtali.
war: Waray na hiya pag-ukoy ha Nazaret kundi ha Capernaum. Aada ini nga bungto ha ligid han Lanaw Galilea, ha katunaan han Zabulon ug Neftali.

en: This fulfilled what Isaiah the prophet said:
war: Nahinabo ini basi matuman an iginsurat ni Isaias nga manaragna nga nasiring:

en: Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, alongside the sea, across the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,
war: “Galilea han mga Hentil! An tuna ha Zabulon ngan an tuna ha Neftali, aragian tipakadto ha dagat, ha tabok han Jordan.

en: the people who lived in the dark have seen a great light, and a light has come upon those who lived in the region and in shadow of death.
war: An mga tawo nga nag-uukoy ha kasisidman makita hin dako nga kapawa. Ha ira nga nag-uokoy ha masirom nga tuna han kamatayon malamrag an kapawa!”

en: From that time Jesus began to announce, “ Change your hearts and lives! Here comes the kingdom of heaven! ”
war: Tikang hadto nagtikang hi Jesus hin pagwali, “Bayai niyo an iyo mga sala, kay hirani na an Ginhadian han langit!”

en: As Jesus walked alongside the Galilee Sea, he saw two brothers, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, throwing fishing nets into the sea, because they were fishermen.
war: Samtang naglalakat hi Jesus ha baybayon han Lanaw han Galilea, hinkit-an niya in duha nga magbugto nga mangirisda, hi Simon nga tinatawag nga Pedro ngan an iya bugto nga hi Andres, nga nagtutunod han ira pukot didto han lanaw.

en: “Come, follow me,” he said, “and I’ll show you how to fish for people.”
war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Upod kamo ha akon ngan tututdoan ko kamo pagdakop hin mga tawo.”

en: Right away, they left their nets and followed him.
war: Ira binayaan dayon an ira mga pukot ngan binmunyog hira ha iya.

en: Continuing on, he saw another set of brothers, James the son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat with Zebedee their father repairing their nets. Jesus called them and
war: Nagtipaunhan hiya ngan hinkit-an niya in duha pa nga magbugto, hira Santiago ug Juan nga mga anak ni Sebedeo. Nakadto hira han ira sakayan upod an amay nira nga hi Sebedeo, nag-aandam han ira mga pukot. Gintawag hira ni Jesus.

en: immediately they left the boat and their father and followed him.
war: Dida dayon binayaan nira an sakayan ngan an ira amay, ngan binmunyog hira kan Jesus.

en: Jesus traveled throughout Galilee, teaching in their synagogues. He announced the good news of the kingdom and healed every disease and sickness among the people.
war: Nagsudoy hi Jesus ha bug-os nga Galilea ngan nagtutdo hiya didto han ira mga sinagoga, nagwali han Maupay nga Sumat han Ginhadian, ngan nagtambal han magkalainlain nga mga sakit ngan mga balatian han mga tawo.

en: News about him spread throughout Syria. People brought to him all those who had various kinds of diseases, those in pain, those possessed by demons, those with epilepsy, and those who were paralyzed, and he healed them.
war: Nahibantog hiya ha bug-os nga Siria, sanglit gindara ngada ha iya an ngatanan nga mga nag-antos hin magkalainlain nga sakit ug balatian: mga sinasangkayan, mga bungtogon, ngan mga lulid. Gintambal hira ngatanan ni Jesus.

en: Large crowds followed him from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from the areas beyond the Jordan River.
war: Damo nga mga tawo in nagsunod ha iya tikang ha Galilea ngan ha Decapolis, ha Jerusalem, ha Judea, ngan ha tuna nga tabok han Jordan.

en: Now when Jesus saw the crowds, he went up a mountain. He sat down and his disciples came to him.
war: Han pakakita ni Jesus han damo nga mga tawo, sinmagka hiya hin pungtod ngan didto linmingkod hiya. Gin-alirongan hiya han iya mga tinun-an,

en: He taught them, saying:
war: ngan nagtikang hiya hin pagtutdo ha ira:

en: “Happy are people who are hopeless, because the kingdom of heaven is theirs.
war: “Palaran adton nakilala nga kablas hira ha espiritu, kay ira an Ginhadian han langit!

en: “Happy are people who grieve, because they will be made glad.
war: “Palaran adton masulob-on, kay pagliliawon hira han Dyos!

en: “Happy are people who are humble, because they will inherit the earth.
war: “Palaran adton mapinaubsanon, kay kakarawaton nira an iginsaad han Dyos!

en: “Happy are people who are hungry and thirsty for righteousness, because they will be fed until they are full.
war: “Palaran adton may dako nga tinguha pagtuman han kaburut-on han Dyos, kay patutungahon gud hira han Dyos!

en: “Happy are people who show mercy, because they will receive mercy.
war: “Palaran adton maloloy-on ha iba, kay malolooy man an Dyos ha ira!

en: “Happy are people who have pure hearts, because they will see God.
war: “Palaran adton maglinis in kasingkasing, kay makakakita hira han Dyos!

en: “Happy are people who make peace, because they will be called God’s children.
war: “Palaran adton nagbubuhat para hin kamurayaw ha mga tawo, kay tatawgon hira nga mga anak han Dyos!

en: “Happy are people whose lives are harassed because they are righteous, because the kingdom of heaven is theirs.
war: “Palaran adton ginpapakurian tungod nga nagtutuman hira han kaburut-on han Dyos, kay ira an Ginhadian han langit!

en: “Happy are you when people insult you and harass you and speak all kinds of bad and false things about you, all because of me.
war: “Palaran kamo kon pagbiaybiayon, ngan pagpakurian kamo han mga tawo, ngan pagbutangbutangan kamo tungod la nga akon kamo mga sakop.

en: Be full of joy and be glad, because you have a great reward in heaven. In the same way, people harassed the prophets who came before you.
war: Pagrayhak ngan paglipay kamo, kay dako an balos nga andam didto ha langit para ha iyo. Amo ini an ginbuhat han mga tawo han pagpakurii nira han mga manaragna nga una pa ha iyo.

en: “You are the salt of the earth. But if salt loses its saltiness, how will it become salty again? It’s good for nothing except to be thrown away and trampled under people’s feet.
war: “Kamo amo an asin para han ngatanan nga katawhan ha tuna. Kundi kon tumab-ang an asin, waray na iba nga paagi hin pagpabalik han iya kapag-ad. Waray na ito gamit, sanglit ilalabog nala basi pagtamaktamakan han mga tawo.

en: You are the light of the world. A city on top of a hill can’t be hidden.
war: “Kamo amo an kapawa han bug-os nga kalibutan. Diri matatago in bungto nga gintindog ha bawbaw hin bukid.

en: Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a basket. Instead, they put it on top of a lampstand, and it shines on all who are in the house.
war: Waray nadagkot hin suga ngan takloban. Lugod, ibinubutang ha burutangan hin suga basi makalamrag han ngatanan nga aada ha balay.

en: In the same way, let your light shine before people, so they can see the good things you do and praise your Father who is in heaven.
war: Ha sugad nga paagi, kinahanglan an iyo suga magmapawa ha atubangan han mga tawo, basi hikit-an nira an iyo maupay nga buhat, ngan pagdayawon nira an Amay niyo ha langit.

en: “Don’t even begin to think that I have come to do away with the Law and the Prophets. I haven’t come to do away with them but to fulfill them.
war: “Ayaw kamo paghunahuna nga kinmanhi ako pagpara han Balaod ni Moises ngan han mga igintutdo han mga manaragna. Waray ako kumanhi hin pagpara hini, kundi hin pagtuman.

en: I say to you very seriously that as long as heaven and earth exist, neither the smallest letter nor even the smallest stroke of a pen will be erased from the Law until everything there becomes a reality.
war: Tigamni niyo ini: samtang aada pa an langit ngan an tuna waray bisan usa nga tulbok ug usa nga bagis in paparaon dida han Balaod, ngada han katuman han ngatanan.

en: Therefore, whoever ignores one of the least of these commands and teaches others to do the same will be called the lowest in the kingdom of heaven. But whoever keeps these commands and teaches people to keep them will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
war: Sanglit, an magpasibaya bisan han gigugutiayi han mga sugo, ngan magtutdo han iba hin diri pagtuman, giuubosi hiya paghunahunaon didto ha langit. Kundi an nasugot han Balaod ngan magtutdo han iba hin pagtuman hini, magigin dako hiya didto han Ginhadian han langit.

en: I say to you that unless your righteousness is greater than the righteousness of the legal experts and the Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
war: Sanglit nasiring ako ha iyo: kon diri lumabaw an iyo pagkamatadong han kanan mga Parisiyo ngan mga magturutdo han Balaod, diri gud kamo makakasulod han Ginhadian han langit.

en: “You have heard that it was said to those who lived long ago, Don’t commit murder, and all who commit murder will be in danger of judgment.
war: “Hinbatian niyo nga gintutdoan hini an mga tawo han una nga panahon, ‘Diri ka magpatay; dadad-on ha hukmanan an bisan hin-o nga makamatay.’

en: But I say to you that everyone who is angry with their brother or sister will be in danger of judgment. If they say to their brother or sister, ‘You idiot,’ they will be in danger of being condemned by the governing council. And if they say, ‘You fool,’ they will be in danger of fiery hell.
war: Kundi yana nasiring ako ha iyo: dadad-on ha hukmanan an bisan hin-o nga masina han iya bugto; dadad-on ha Labaw nga Hukmanan an bisan hin-o nga magbiaybiay han iya bugto; ngan an matawag han iya bugto, ‘Tuyawtuyaw ka;’ mahingangadto ha kalayo han impyerno!

en: Therefore, if you bring your gift to the altar and there remember that your brother or sister has something against you,
war: Sanglit kon maghalad ka sa Dyos ngan manumdom ka nga may kasina an imo bugto ha imo,

en: leave your gift at the altar and go. First make things right with your brother or sister and then come back and offer your gift.
war: bayai anay an imo halad didto ha altar ngan kadto dayon pakighioli han imo bugto. Kahuman, balik ngan paghalad sa Dyos.

en: Be sure to make friends quickly with your opponents while you are with them on the way to court. Otherwise, they will haul you before the judge, the judge will turn you over to the officer of the court, and you will be thrown into prison.
war: “Kon may tawo nga magsumbong kontra ha imo ngan dad-on ka ha hukmanan, pakigsaboti hiya samtang may panahon pa, nga diri ka pa naatubang han hukmanan. Kay kon mahingadto ka na, itutubyan ka niya ngadto ha hukom, nga matubyan ha imo ngadto ha polis, ngan mabibilanggo ka.

en: I say to you in all seriousness that you won’t get out of there until you’ve paid the very last penny.
war: Nasiring ako ha imo: diri ka makakagawas didto tubtob nga kabaydan mo an ngatanan nga multa ha imo.

en: “You have heard that it was said, Don’t commit adultery.
war: “Hinbatian niyo nga iginsiring ini, ‘Diri ka manlibog.’

en: But I say to you that every man who looks at a woman lustfully has already committed adultery in his heart.
war: Kundi yana nasiring ako ha iyo: nakapanlibog na ha iya kasingkasing an bisan hin-o nga nasiplat hin babaye ngan nakahunahuna hin pakighilawas ha iya.

en: And if your right eye causes you to fall into sin, tear it out and throw it away. It’s better that you lose a part of your body than that your whole body be thrown into hell.
war: Sanglit kon an imo tuo nga mata amo an tinikangan han imo pakasala, lukata ngan ilabog. Gabay ka nala kawad-an hin usa nga bahin han imo lawas, kay hin mahingadto ha impyerno an imo bug-os nga lawas.

en: And if your right hand causes you to fall into sin, chop it off and throw it away. It’s better that you lose a part of your body than that your whole body go into hell.
war: Kon an imo tuo nga kamot amo an tinikangan han imo pakasala, utda ngan ilabog! Gabay ka nala kawad-an hin usa nga bahin han imo lawas, kay hin mahingadto ha impyerno an bug-os mo nga lawas.

en: “It was said, ‘Whoever divorces his wife must give her a divorce certificate.’
war: “Iginsiring liwat ini, ‘Adton makig-bulag han iya asawa, kinahanglan nga maghatag hin sinurat nga karig-onan hin pagpahibaro han iya asawa mahitungod han iya pakigbulag.’

en: But I say to you that whoever divorces his wife except for sexual unfaithfulness forces her to commit adultery. And whoever marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
war: Kundi yana nasiring ako: kon in lalake makigbulag han iya asawa hin bisan ano nga pasangil—labot kono naglalake hiya—nakasala hiya, kay hiya man an tinikangan nga nakasala hin panlibog an iya asawa, kon pumaasawa hin iba nga lalake an iya asawa. Makakasala liwat hin panlibog an mangasawa han babaye nga binulagan.

en: “Again you have heard that it was said to those who lived long ago: Don’t make a false solemn pledge, but you should follow through on what you have pledged to the Lord.
war: “Hinbatian liwat niyo nga igintutdo ha mga tawo han una nga panahon, ‘Tumana an imo iginsaad ngan buhata an imo iginsumpa ha Ginoo.’

en: But I say to you that you must not pledge at all. You must not pledge by heaven, because it’s God’s throne.
war: Kundi yana nasiring ako ha iyo: ayaw pagsumpa kon nagsasaad ka. Ayaw gamita an langit hin pagsumpa, kay trono ito han Dyos;

en: You must not pledge by the earth, because it’s God’s footstool. You must not pledge by Jerusalem, because it’s the city of the great king.
war: ayaw man an tuna, kay tungtungan ito han iya mga tiil. Ayaw liwat an Jerusalem, kay syudad ito han harangdon nga Hadi.

en: And you must not pledge by your head, because you can’t turn one hair white or black.
war: Ayaw gamita bisan pa an imo ulo, kay diri ka makakapabusag o makakapaitom hin usa han imo buhok.

en: Let your yes mean yes, and your no mean no. Anything more than this comes from the evil one.
war: Igo na nga masiring ka, ‘Oo’ kon matangdo ka; ‘Diri’ kon mariwa ka; natikang na han Yawa an sobra pa hini nga igyayakan mo.

en: “You have heard that it was said, An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth .
war: “Hinbatian niyo nga iginsiring, ‘An mata bayaran hin mata ngan an ngipon bayaran hin ngipon.’

en: But I say to you that you must not oppose those who want to hurt you. If people slap you on your right cheek, you must turn the left cheek to them as well.
war: Kundi yana nasiring ako ha iyo: ayaw pagbulos han nagpapakaraot ha imo. Kon may magtampalo han imo tuo nga bayhon, ipatampalo liwat ha iya an imo wala nga bayhon.

en: When they wish to haul you to court and take your shirt, let them have your coat too.
war: Ngan kon may magsumbong ha imo basi makuha niya an imo kamiseta, ihatag pa ha iya pati an imo kamisadentro.

en: When they force you to go one mile, go with them two.
war: Kon in sondalo magpirit ha imo hin pagdara han iya kasangkapan sulod hin usa ka kilometro, dad-a ito hin duha ka kilometro.

en: Give to those who ask, and don’t refuse those who wish to borrow from you.
war: Tagi kon may mangaro ha imo, ngan pahudma kon may humoram ha imo.

en: “You have heard that it was said, You must love your neighbor and hate your enemy.
war: “Hinbatian niyo nga iginsiring, ‘Higugmaa an iyo kasangkayan, pagdumti an iyo mga kaaway.’

en: But I say to you, love your enemies and pray for those who harass you
war: Kundi yana nasiring ako ha iyo: higugmaa an iyo mga kaaway ngan ig-ampo an mga nagpapakuri ha iyo,

en: so that you will be acting as children of your Father who is in heaven. He makes the sun rise on both the evil and the good and sends rain on both the righteous and the unrighteous.
war: basi mahimo kamo nga mga anak han iyo Amay ha langit. Kay hiya in waray pinalabi, kay hiya an nagpapasirak han adlaw ug nagpapauran ngadto han mga magtadong ngan mga makasasala.

en: If you love only those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?
war: Kon hihigugmaon la niyo an mga tawo nga nahigugma ha iyo, ano man nga balos an iyo pamumulaton? Diri ba amo ini an ginbubuhat han mga parasukot hin buhis?

en: And if you greet only your brothers and sisters, what more are you doing? Don’t even the Gentiles do the same?
war: Ngan kon makikig-upay kamo hin kaburut-on ha iyo la mga kasangkayan, ano man an ginbubuhat niyo nga malabaw han iba? Ginbubuhat ini bisan pa han mga Hentil.

en: Therefore, just as your heavenly Father is complete in showing love to everyone, so also you must be complete.
war: Sanglit kinahanglan mahingpit kamo, sugad nga hingpit an iyo Amay ha langit.

en: “Be careful that you don’t practice your religion in front of people to draw their attention. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.
war: “Paghirot kamo nga diri mahimo nga parayaw la ha mga tawo an pagbuhat niyo hin maupay. Kay kon amo ito an pagbuhaton niyo, diri kamo makarawat hin balos tikang han Amay niyo ha langit.

en: “Whenever you give to the poor, don’t blow your trumpet as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets so that they may get praise from people. I assure you, that’s the only reward they’ll get.
war: “Sanglit kon mahatag kamo ngadto hin nagkikinahanglan, ayaw paghimoa ini nga dako nga kiritaon sugad han ginbubuhat han mga maglabyaw didto han mga sinagoga ngan ha kadalanan. Ginbubuhat nira ini basi pagdayawon hira han mga tawo. Tigamni niyo ini: kinmarawat na hira han ira balos.

en: But when you give to the poor, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand is doing
war: Kundi kon mabulig kamo han nagkikinahanglan, buhata ini hin hilom, kon mahimo, diri mahibaroan han wala niyo nga kamot an ginbubuhat han iyo tuo,

en: so that you may give to the poor in secret. Your Father who sees what you do in secret will reward you.
war: basi mahilom an iyo paghatag, ngan babaloson kamo han Amay niyo nga nakita han maupay nga ginbubuhat niyo hin hilom.

en: “When you pray, don’t be like hypocrites. They love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners so that people will see them. I assure you, that’s the only reward they’ll get.
war: “Kon mag-aampo kamo, ayaw subad han mga maglabyaw! Karuyag nira mag-ampo nga natukdaw ha mga sinagoga ngan ha kanto han kadalanan, basi hikit-an hira han ngatanan. Tigamni niyo ini: kinmarawat na hira han ira balos.

en: But when you pray, go to your room, shut the door, and pray to your Father who is present in that secret place. Your Father who sees what you do in secret will reward you.
war: Kundi kon mag-aampo kamo, sakob ha iyo sulod ngan sadhi an porta, ngan pag-ampo han Amay niyo nga diri kinikita, ngan babaloson kamo han Amay niyo nga nakita han maupay nga ginbubuhat niyo hin hilom.

en: “When you pray, don’t pour out a flood of empty words, as the Gentiles do. They think that by saying many words they’ll be heard.
war: “Ha iyo mga pag-ampo, ayaw paggamit hin damo nga waray kahulogan nga mga pulong sugad han ginbubuhat han mga Hentil. An pagsabot nira nga pamamatian hira han Dyos tungod han ira higlaba nga mga pag-ampo.

en: Don’t be like them, because your Father knows what you need before you ask.
war: Ayaw kamo pagsubad ha ira, kay maaram na nga daan an Amay niyo han iyo ginkikinahanglan samtang nga diri pa kamo naaro ha iya.

en: Pray like this: Our Father who is in heaven, uphold the holiness of your name.
war: Sanglit sugara hini an iyo pag-ampo: ‘Amay namon ha langit: Pagdayawon an imo baraan nga ngaran,

en: Bring in your kingdom so that your will is done on earth as it’s done in heaven.
war: Maghadi ka unta ha amon, matuman dinhe ha tuna an imo kaburut-on sugad han didto ha langit.

en: Give us the bread we need for today.
war: Tagi kami yana nga adlaw han pagkaon nga amon kinahanglan.

en: Forgive us for the ways we have wronged you, just as we also forgive those who have wronged us.
war: Pasayloa kami han amon mga sala sugad han pagpasaylo namon han mga nakasala ha amon.

en: And don’t lead us into temptation, but rescue us from the evil one.
war: Ayaw itugot nga mahingadto kami hin makuri nga kataragman, kundi bawia kami ha Karat-an.’ [Kay imo an ginhadian, an gahom ngan an himaya ha kadayonan! Amen.]

en: “If you forgive others their sins, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
war: “Kon pasayloon niyo an nakakasala ha iyo, pasasayloon man kamo han Amay niyo ha langit.

en: But if you don’t forgive others, neither will your Father forgive your sins.
war: Kundi kon diri niyo pasayloon an mga nakakasala ha iyo, diri man mapasaylo ha iyo an Amay niyo ha langit.

en: “And when you fast, don’t put on a sad face like the hypocrites. They distort their faces so people will know they are fasting. I assure you that they have their reward.
war: “Ngan kon magpupuasa kamo, ayaw pagpakita hin bayhon nga masulob-on sugad han mga maglabyaw. Ginraraksot nira an ira nawong basi hikit-an hira han mga tawo nga nagpupuasa hira. Tigamni niyo ini: kinmarawat na hira han ira balos.

en: When you fast, brush your hair and wash your face.
war: Kon magpupuasa kamo, paghiram-os ngan pagsudlay,

en: Then you won’t look like you are fasting to people, but only to your Father who is present in that secret place. Your Father who sees in secret will reward you.
war: basi diri mahibaroan han mga tawo nga nagpupuasa kamo. An Amay niyo nga diri kinikita amo la an mahibabaro, ngan babaloson kamo han maupay nga iyo ginbubuhat hin hilom.

en: “Stop collecting treasures for your own benefit on earth, where moth and rust eat them and where thieves break in and steal them.
war: “Ayaw kamo pagtirok hin mga bahandi dinhe ha tuna nga pagkukutkuton hin mga tangkob ug taoy, ngan may-ada makakasulod hin pangawat nga mga tikasan.

en: Instead, collect treasures for yourselves in heaven, where moth and rust don’t eat them and where thieves don’t break in and steal them.
war: Lugod, pagtirok kamo para han iyo kalugaringon hin mga manggad didto ha langit diin waray tangkob ug taoy nga nakakakutkot, ngan waray makakasulod hin pangawat nga mga tikasan.

en: Where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
war: Kay kon hain an iyo mga manggad, dayuday aadto man an iyo kasingkasing.

en: “The eye is the lamp of the body. Therefore, if your eye is healthy, your whole body will be full of light.
war: “An mga mata amo an suga para han lawas. Kon maupay an iyo mga mata, malulukop hin kapawa an bug-os niyo nga lawas.

en: But if your eye is bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light in you is darkness, how terrible that darkness will be!
war: Kundi kon diri maupay an iyo mata, mapuputos hin kamasirom an bug-os niyo nga lawas. Sanglit kon an kapawa dida ha iyo, kasisidman ngay-an, kamakalilisang hito nga kasisidman!

en: No one can serve two masters. Either you will hate the one and love the other, or you will be loyal to the one and have contempt for the other. You cannot serve God and wealth.
war: “Waray tawo nga makakahimo hin pag-alagad hin duha nga agaron, kay mahinanabo nga pagdudumtan niya an usa ngan paghihigugmaon niya an ikaduha. Uunongan niya an usa ngan pagtatamayon niya an ikaduha. Diri ka makakag-alagad han Dyos ngan han manggad.

en: “Therefore, I say to you, don’t worry about your life, what you’ll eat or what you’ll drink, or about your body, what you’ll wear. Isn’t life more than food and the body more than clothes?
war: “Sanglit nasiring ako ha iyo: ayaw kamo kabaraka mahitungod han pagkaon ngan pag-inom nga kinahanglanon niyo basi mabuhi kamo, o tungod han panapton para han iyo lawas. Diri ba an kinabuhi labaw pa han pagkaon, ngan an lawas labaw pa han panapton?

en: Look at the birds in the sky. They don’t sow seed or harvest grain or gather crops into barns. Yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you worth much more than they are?
war: Tan-awa daw niyo an katamsihan: diri hira nagpupugas, o nagbabari, o nagsisibog ngadto ha kamalig, kundi ginmamangnoan hira han Amay niyo ha langit. Diri ba kamo labaw pa han katamsihan?

en: Who among you by worrying can add a single moment to your life?
war: Hin-o man ha iyo in makakapahilaba han iya kinabuhi hin bisan pira la ka tuig pinaagi han iyo pagkinabaraka?

en: And why do you worry about clothes? Notice how the lilies in the field grow. They don’t wear themselves out with work, and they don’t spin cloth.
war: “Ngan kay ano nga nababaraka kamo mahitungod hin panapton? Paghunahunaa daw niyo an pagtubo han mga bukad ha kapatagan; diri hira nagbubuhat o naghahablon.

en: But I say to you that even Solomon in all of his splendor wasn’t dressed like one of these.
war: Kundi nasiring ako ha iyo: bisan hi Solomon, dida han iya pagkamanggaranon, waray panapton nga sugad kamakaruruyag han usa hini nga mga bukad.

en: If God dresses grass in the field so beautifully, even though it’s alive today and tomorrow it’s thrown into the furnace, won’t God do much more for you, you people of weak faith?
war: Kon ginpapanaptonan han Dyos an mga banwa ha kapatagan nga buhi yana, ngan pagkabuwas sinusunog ha hudno, kamo pa in diri? Pagkagutiay han iyo pagtoo!

en: Therefore, don’t worry and say, ‘What are we going to eat?’ or ‘What are we going to drink?’ or ‘What are we going to wear?’
war: “Sanglit ayaw kamo kabaraka han iyo kakaonon, iimnon, o igpapanapton.

en: Gentiles long for all these things. Your heavenly Father knows that you need them.
war: (Amo ini nga mga butang an nababarak-an han mga tawo nga waray pagsarig sa Dyos.) Maaram an Amay niyo ha langit nga kinahanglan niyo ini ngatanan.

en: Instead, desire first and foremost God’s kingdom and God’s righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.
war: Sanglit unaha gud niyo pamiling han iya Ginhadian ngan han iya kaburut-on, ngan ihahatag niya ha iyo an iba ngatanan nga mga butang.

en: Therefore, stop worrying about tomorrow, because tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.
war: Sanglit, ayaw kamo kabaraka mahitungod hiton buwas nga adlaw; may-ada hito kalugaringon nga mga kabaraka. Sanglit ayaw na dugangi an mga kabaraka ha kada adlaw.

en: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.
war: “Ayaw kamo paghukom han iba basi diri kamo paghukman han Dyos.

en: You’ll receive the same judgment you give. Whatever you deal out will be dealt out to you.
war: Kay paghuhukman kamo han Dyos sumala han paghukom niyo han iba, ngan an iyo igsusukol han iba amo man an gagamiton ha iyo.

en: Why do you see the splinter that’s in your brother’s or sister’s eye, but don’t notice the log in your own eye?
war: Kay ano nga nakita man kamo han poling ha mata han iyo bugto, kundi diri kamo nanginginano han nabalabag han iyo kalugaringon nga mata?

en: How can you say to your brother or sister, ‘Let me take the splinter out of your eye,’ when there’s a log in your eye?
war: Uunanhon niyo hin pagsiring ha imo bugto, ‘Kadi, kukuhaon ta an poling ha imo mata,’ kon aada pa in nabalabag ha iyo kalugaringon nga mata?

en: You deceive yourself! First take the log out of your eye, and then you’ll see clearly to take the splinter out of your brother’s or sister’s eye.
war: Kamalabyaw niyo! Kuhaa anay an nabalabag ha iyo mata, ngan unina, makakakita kamo hin maupay, ngan makakakuha kamo han poling han iyo bugto.

en: Don’t give holy things to dogs, and don’t throw your pearls in front of pigs. They will stomp on the pearls, then turn around and attack you.
war: “Ayaw ihatag ha mga ayam an baraan nga butang, kay bangin kamo banhagon ngan kumagat ha iyo. Ayaw ilabog an iyo mga perlas ngadto han mga baboy, kay pagtatamaktamakan la ito nira.

en: “Ask, and you will receive. Search, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened to you.
war: “Pangaro ngan tatagan kamo; pamiling ngan makakaagi kamo; pagtuktok ngan bubuksan an porta para ha iyo.

en: For everyone who asks, receives. Whoever seeks, finds. And to everyone who knocks, the door is opened.
war: Kay makarawat an tagsa nga nangangaro, makakaagi an namimiling, ngan bubuksan an porta para ha iya nga nagtutuktok.

en: Who among you will give your children a stone when they ask for bread?
war: Kamo nga mga amay, tatagan ba niyo hin bato kon mangaro an iyo anak hin tinapay?

en: Or give them a snake when they ask for fish?
war: Tatagan ba niyo hin halas kon mangaro hiya hin isda?

en: If you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give good things to those who ask him.
war: Kon kamo nga magraot, maaram humatag hin mag-upay nga mga butang ha iyo mga anak, asay pa ba an Amay niyo ha langit in diri humatag han mag-upay nga mga butang hadton mga nangangaro ha iya!

en: Therefore, you should treat people in the same way that you want people to treat you; this is the Law and the Prophets.
war: “Buhata niyo ha iba an karuyag niyo nga buhaton nira ha iyo. Amo ini an kahulogan han Balaod ni Moises ngan han igintutdo han mga manaragna.

en: “Go in through the narrow gate. The gate that leads to destruction is broad and the road wide, so many people enter through it.
war: “Sulod kamo han haligot nga aragian; kay haluag an aragian ngan masayon an dalan tipakadto ha impyerno, ngan damo an naagi hini nga dalan.

en: But the gate that leads to life is narrow and the road difficult, so few people find it.
war: Kundi haligot an aragian ngan makuri an dalan tipakadto ha kinabuhi nga dayon, ngan diri damo an nakakatoltol hini nga dalan.

en: “Watch out for false prophets. They come to you dressed like sheep, but inside they are vicious wolves.
war: “Pag-ikmat kamo han buwaon nga mga manaragna; napahirani hira ha iyo sugad hin mga karnero pagkit-on, kundi balitaw, ha sulod, sugad gud hira hin magbangis nga mga lubo.

en: You will know them by their fruit. Do people get bunches of grapes from thorny weeds, or do they get figs from thistles?
war: Makikilala niyo hira pinaagi han ira mga panggawi. Binuburo ba in ubas tikang hin kasapinitan, o in igos tikang hin niyutiyo?

en: In the same way, every good tree produces good fruit, and every rotten tree produces bad fruit.
war: Nabunga hin maupay an maupay nga kahoy, kundi nabunga hin maraot an maraot man nga kahoy.

en: A good tree can’t produce bad fruit. And a rotten tree can’t produce good fruit.
war: Diri makakabunga hin maraot an maupay nga kahoy, diri man liwat makakabunga hin maupay an maraot nga kahoy.

en: Every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is chopped down and thrown into the fire.
war: Pupudlon ngan susunogon an kahoy nga diri nahatag hin maupay nga bunga.

en: Therefore, you will know them by their fruit.
war: Sanglit, makikilala niyo an buwaon nga mga manaragna pinaagi han ira mga panggawi.

en: “Not everybody who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will get into the kingdom of heaven. Only those who do the will of my Father who is in heaven will enter.
war: “Diri ngatanan nga natawag ha akon, ‘Ginoo, Ginoo,’ makakasulod han Ginhadian han langit, kundi adton nagtutuman la han kaburut-on han akon Amay ha langit.

en: On the Judgment Day, many people will say to me, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name and expel demons in your name and do lots of miracles in your name?’
war: Pag-abot han Adlaw han Paghukom, damo in masiring ha akon, ‘Ginoo, Ginoo! ha imo ngaran nagpasangyaw kami han mensahe han Dyos, nagpaiwas kami hin mga yawa, ngan nagbuhat kami hin mga milagro!’

en: Then I’ll tell them, ‘I’ve never known you. Get away from me, you people who do wrong.’
war: Niyan masiring ako ha ira, ‘Waray gud ako kumilala ha iyo. Pahirayo kamo, mga banyaga nga mga tawo!’

en: “ Everybody who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise builder who built a house on bedrock.
war: “Sanglit, an tagsa nga mamati ngan magtuman hini nga akon mga pulong masusugad hin tawo nga may-ada hibaro nga nagbalay ha bawbaw han bato.

en: The rain fell, the floods came, and the wind blew and beat against that house. It didn’t fall because it was firmly set on bedrock.
war: Inmuranos, binmaha an mga salog, ngan inagmakan han makusog nga hangin adto nga balay; kundi waray mapukan, kay maupay an katindog ha bawbaw han bato.

en: But everybody who hears these words of mine and doesn’t put them into practice will be like a fool who built a house on sand.
war: “An tagsa nga mamati hini nga akon mga pulong, ngan diri magtuman masusugad hin tawo nga buangbuang nga nagbalay ha bawbaw han baras.

en: The rain fell, the floods came, and the wind blew and beat against that house. It fell and was completely destroyed. ”
war: Inmuranos, binmaha an mga salog, ngan inagmakan han makusog nga hangin adto nga balay, ngan napukan. Kamakalilisang an pagkapukan hadto nga balay!”

en: When Jesus finished these words, the crowds were amazed at his teaching
war: Katapos ni Jesus pagyakan hini nga mga butang, nahipausa an mga tawo han paagi han iya pagtutdo,

en: because he was teaching them like someone with authority and not like their legal experts.
war: kay nagtutdo hiya nga may gahom ngan diri sugad han ira mga magturutdo han Balaod.

en: Now when Jesus had come down from the mountain, large crowds followed him.
war: Linmugsong hi Jesus tikang hin pungtod ngan nagsunod ha iya in damo kaupay nga mga tawo.

en: A man with a skin disease came, kneeled before him, and said, “Lord, if you want, you can make me clean.”
war: Hinmarani ha iya in usa nga sanlahon, linmuhod ha atubangan niya ngan sinmiring, “Kon imo karuyag, makakalinis ka ha akon.”

en: Jesus reached out his hand and touched him, saying, “ I do want to. Become clean. ” Instantly his skin disease was cleansed.
war: Kinamkam hiya ni Jesus ngan ginsiring, “Karuyag ko, magmalinis ka!” Dida dayon nalinisan an tawo han iya sanla.

en: Jesus said to him, “ Don’t say anything to anyone. Instead, go and show yourself to the priest and offer the gift that Moses commanded. This will be a testimony to them. ”
war: Ginsiring hiya ni Jesus, “Pamati! Ayaw pagsumat bisan kan kanay, kundi kadto dayon ha padi ngan pakita ha iya. Kahuman, paghalad sugad han iginsugo ni Moises, pagpakita han mga tawo nga malinis ka na.”

en: When Jesus went to Capernaum, a centurion approached,
war: Han pagsulod ni Jesus ha Capernaum gintapo hiya hin kapitan nga Romano nga nakimalooy ha iya,

en: pleading with him, “Lord, my servant is flat on his back at home, paralyzed, and his suffering is awful.”
war: “Sir, masakit an akon surugoon, nahigda, diri nakakakiwa, ngan nagkukuri hin duro.”

en: Jesus responded, “ I’ll come and heal him. ”
war: “Makadto ako ngan uupayon ko hiya,” nagsiring hi Jesus.

en: But the centurion replied, “Lord, I don’t deserve to have you come under my roof. Just say the word and my servant will be healed.
war: Kundi binmaton an kapitan, “Sir, diri ako takos nga sumulod ka ha akon balay. Sugoa la ako ngan mauupay dayon an akon surugoon.

en: I’m a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I say to one, ‘Go,’ and he goes, and to another, ‘Come,’ and he comes. I say to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and the servant does it.”
war: Usa liwat ako ka tawo nga ubos hin labaw nga mga opisyal, ngan may-ada ko liwat mga sakop nga mga sondalo. Kon nasugo ako ha usa, ‘Kadto na!’ napakadto hiya; ngan ha iba, ‘Kadi na!’ nadaop hiya. Kon nasugo ako han akon oripon, ‘Buhata ini!’ ginbubuhat niya dayon.”

en: When Jesus heard this, he was impressed and said to the people following him, “ I say to you with all seriousness that even in Israel I haven’t found faith like this.
war: Nahipausa hi Jesus han pakabati niya hini, ngan ginsiring an mga tawo nga nagsusunod ha iya, “Nasiring ako ha iyo, waray pa gud ako makakita ha Israel hin pagtoo nga sugad kadako hini.

en: I say to you that there are many who will come from east and west and sit down to eat with Abraham and Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.
war: Tigamni niyo ini: damo in maabot tikang ha sinirangan ngan ha katundan, ngan makikigsaro kanda Abraham, Isaac, ug Jacob didto han Ginhadian han langit,

en: But the children of the kingdom will be thrown outside into the darkness. People there will be weeping and grinding their teeth. ”
war: samtang an mga anak han Ginhadian ilalabog lugod ha kasisidman ha gawas; didto mananangis hira ngan manliligot an ira mga ngipon.”

en: Jesus said to the centurion, “ Go; it will be done for you just as you have believed. ” And his servant was healed that very moment.
war: Ngan ginsiring ni Jesus an kapitan, “Hala, oli na la, ngan matumanan ka sumala han imo pagtoo.” Ngan hito ngahaw nga takna naupay an surugoon han kapitan.

en: Jesus went home with Peter and saw Peter’s mother-in-law lying in bed with a fever.
war: Kinmadto hi Jesus ha balay ni Pedro ngan hinkit-an niya an babaye nga ugangan ni Pedro nga nahigda kay hinihirantan.

en: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. Then she got up and served them.
war: Kinaptan ni Jesus an iya kamot ngan nalungasan hiya han hiranat. Binmuhat hiya ngan nagsirbe kan Jesus.

en: That evening people brought to Jesus many who were demon-possessed. He threw the spirits out with just a word. He healed everyone who was sick.
war: Han pagkagab-i na, gindara ngadto kan Jesus in damo nga mga tawo nga sinasangkayan hin yawa. Ha usa la ka pulong ginpagawas ni Jesus an magraot nga mga espiritu, ngan gintambal an ngatanan nga mga magsakit.

en: This happened so that what Isaiah the prophet said would be fulfilled: He is the one who took our illnesses and carried away our diseases.
war: Ginbuhat niya ini basi matuman an iginsiring ni Isaias nga manaragna, “Hiya ngahaw an nagkuha han ngatanan naton nga mga sakit.”

en: Now when Jesus saw the crowd, he ordered his disciples to go over to the other side of the lake.
war: Han pagkita ni Jesus han kadam-an nga nag-aalirong ha iya, nagsugo hiya han iya mga tinun-an nga mapakadto ha tabok han lanaw.

en: A legal expert came and said to him, “Teacher, I’ll follow you wherever you go.”
war: Dinimaop ha iya in usa nga magturutdo han Balaod ngan nagsiring, “Magturutdo, andam ako hin pag-upod ha imo bisan ngain.”

en: Jesus replied, “ Foxes have dens, and the birds in the sky have nests, but the Human One has no place to lay his head. ”
war: Ginbaton hiya ni Jesus, “May mga buho an mga miro, ngan may mga salag an katamsihan, kundi waray ngani hinihigdaan hin pagpahuway an Anak han Tawo.”

en: Another man, one of his disciples, said to him, “Lord, first let me go and bury my father.”
war: Nagsiring liwat in lain nga tinun-an, “Tugoti gad ako hin pag-oli anay hin paglubong han akon amay.”

en: But Jesus said to him, “ Follow me, and let the dead bury their own dead. ”
war: Kundi ginbaton hiya ni Jesus, “Sunod ha akon, ngan pabay-i an mga patay nga asay maglubong han ira minatay.”

en: When Jesus got into a boat, his disciples followed him.
war: Sinmakay hi Jesus han sakayan ngan inmupod ha iya an iya mga tinun-an.

en: A huge storm arose on the lake so that waves were sloshing over the boat. But Jesus was asleep.
war: Han nakaturog hi Jesus, tigda la nga inmabot in makusog nga alipuros ha lanaw, sanglit ginsasakayan na hira han mga balod, ngan haros na malunod an sakayan, kundi nakaturog hi Jesus.

en: They came and woke him, saying, “Lord, rescue us! We’re going to drown!”
war: Gindaop hiya han mga tinun-an ngan ginsiring hin pagpukaw ha iya, “Talwasa kami, Ginoo! Malulunod kita!”

en: He said to them, “ Why are you afraid, you people of weak faith? ” Then he got up and gave orders to the winds and the lake, and there was a great calm.
war: Ginsiring hira ni Jesus, “Kay ano nga nahadlok man kamo? Kagutiay han iyo pagtoo!” Niyan binmuhat hiya ngan ginsaway an hangin ngan an balod, ngan nagmalinaw an dagat.

en: The people were amazed and said, “What kind of person is this? Even the winds and the lake obey him!”
war: Nahipausa hira ngatanan ngan may hinsiring, “Hin-o ini nga tawo? Nasugot ha iya bisan an hangin ug balod!”

en: When Jesus arrived on the other side of the lake in the country of the Gadarenes, two men who were demon-possessed came from among the tombs to meet him. They were so violent that nobody could travel on that road.
war: Han pag-abot ni Jesus ha tabok han lanaw, ha tuna han mga taga-Gadara, gintapo hiya hin duha ka tawo nga tikang han mga lubnganan. Sinasangkayan hira hin yawa, ngan mga magisog, sanglit waray nagpapasipara hin pag-agi hadto nga dalan.

en: They cried out, “What are you going to do with us, Son of God? Have you come to torture us before the time of judgment?”
war: Sinminggit hira dayon, “Ano an imo karuyag ha amon, Anak han Dyos? Kinmanhi ka ba hin pagkastigo ha amon nga diri pa man igo nga panahon?”

en: Far off in the distance a large herd of pigs was feeding.
war: May dako nga panon hin kababoyan nga naniningaon hirani hini nga dapit.

en: The demons pleaded with him, “If you throw us out, send us into the herd of pigs.”
war: Nakimalooy kan Jesus an mga yawa, “Kon pagagawson mo man kami, pasudla kami ngadto hito nga panon hin kababoyan.”

en: Then he said to the demons, “ Go away, ” and they came out and went into the pigs. The whole herd rushed down the cliff into the lake and drowned.
war: Ginsiring hira ni Jesus, “Kadto na kamo.” Sanglit ginmawas hira ngan sinmulod han kababoyan. Tigda nga nagdadlagan an bug-os nga panon han kababoyan ngadto ha ligid han umpas, nagkahuglog ngadto ha lanaw, ngan nagkalulumos.

en: Those who tended the pigs ran into the city and told everything that had happened to the demon-possessed men.
war: Nagdadlagan an mga magmarangno han kababoyan, ngan pag-abot nira ha bungto, iginsumat an ngatanan ngan an nahinabo han mga tawo nga sinasangkayan hin yawa.

en: Then the whole city came out and met Jesus. When they saw him, they pleaded with him to leave their region.
war: Sanglit nagkagawas an ngatanan nga tawo han bungto hin pagtapo kan Jesus; ngan han paghikit-i nira ha iya nakimalooy hira nga bumaya hiya han ira tuna.

en: Boarding a boat, Jesus crossed to the other side of the lake and went to his own city.
war: Sinmakay hi Jesus han sakayan, binmalik pagtabok han lanaw, ngan kinmadto han iya kalugaringon nga bungto.

en: People brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a cot. When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the man who was paralyzed, “ Be encouraged, my child, your sins are forgiven. ”
war: Gindara ngada ha iya hin pira ka tawo in usa nga lulid nga nahigda. Hinkit-an ni Jesus an kadako han ira pagtoo, ngan ginsiring niya an lulid, “Tapod na la, anak ko! Ginpasaylo na an imo mga sala.”

en: Some legal experts said among themselves, “This man is insulting God.”
war: Ngan may hinsiring hin pira han mga magturutdo han Balaod, “Nagpanamastamas ini nga tawo!”

en: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said, “ Why do you fill your minds with evil things?
war: Nakasantop hi Jesus han ira nahunahunaan, sanglit nagsiring hiya, “Kay ano nga nakahunahuna kamo hin sugad kamaraot nga mga butang?

en: Which is easier—to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk’?
war: Hain in masarusayon, an pagsiring, ‘An imo mga sala ginpasaylo,’ o an pagsiring, ‘Buhat ngan lakat’?

en: But so you will know that the Human One has authority on the earth to forgive sins ”—he said to the man who was paralyzed—“ Get up, take your cot, and go home. ”
war: Ipakikita ko ha iyo nga may gahom an Anak han Tawo hin pagpasaylo han mga sala dinhe ha tuna.” Ngan ginsiring niya an lulid, “Buhat, dad-a an imo higdaan, ngan oli ngadto ha imo balay.”

en: The man got up and went home.
war: Binmuhat an tawo ngan inmoli.

en: When the crowds saw what had happened, they were afraid and praised God, who had given such authority to human beings.
war: Pakakita hini han mga tawo kinulba hira ngan nagdayaw hira han Dyos nga naghatag hin sugad nga gahom ngadto han mga tawo.

en: As Jesus continued on from there, he saw a man named Matthew sitting at a kiosk for collecting taxes. He said to him, “ Follow me, ” and he got up and followed him.
war: Binmaya hi Jesus hadto nga dapit. Han naglalakat hiya ha dalan, hinkit-an niya in tawo nga parasukot hin buhis nga ginngaranan kan Mateo nga nalingkod didto han iya buhatan. Ginsiring hiya ni Jesus, “Sunod ha akon.” Ngan binmuhat hi Mateo ngan sinmunod ha iya.

en: As Jesus sat down to eat in Matthew’s house, many tax collectors and sinners joined Jesus and his disciples at the table.
war: Han nangangaon na hira Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an didto han balay ni Mateo, inmabot in damo nga mga parasukot hin buhis ngan mga tinamay, ngan tinmangka upod ha ira.

en: But when the Pharisees saw this, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
war: Hinkit-an ini hin mga Parisiyo ngan nagpakiana hira han iya mga tinun-an, “Kay ano nga nakikigsaro an iyo magturutdo han mga parasukot hin buhis ngan mga tinamay?”

en: When Jesus heard it, he said, “ Healthy people don’t need a doctor, but sick people do.
war: Hinbatian hira ni Jesus ngan ginbaton hira, “Diri nagkikinahanglan hin magtarambal an waray sakit nga mga tawo, kundi an mga magsakit la.

en: Go and learn what this means: I want mercy and not sacrifice . I didn’t come to call righteous people, but sinners. ”
war: Lakat ngan panginanoa kon ano an kahulogan hini nga kasuratan nga nasiring, ‘Naungara ako hin kalooy, diri hin halad nga mga hayop.’ Kay kinmanhi ako pagtawag han mga makasasala, diri han mga magtadong.”

en: At that time John’s disciples came and asked Jesus, “Why do we and the Pharisees frequently fast, but your disciples never fast?”
war: Dinmaop kan Jesus an mga sakop ni Juan nga Parabunyag ngan nagpakiana, “Kay ano nga agsob magpuasa kami ngan an mga Parisiyo, kundi diri man nagpupuasa an imo mga tinun-an?”

en: Jesus responded, “The wedding guests can’t mourn while the groom is still with them, can they? But the days will come when the groom will be taken away from them, and then they’ll fast.
war: Binmaton hiya, “Magmamasulob-on ba an mga dinapit ngadto hin pakasal samtang upod pa nira an lalake nga kinasal? Diri gud! Kundi maabot an panahon nga mabaya ha ira an kinasal nga lalake, ngan amo na an pagpuasa nira.

en: “ No one sews a piece of new, unshrunk cloth on old clothes because the patch tears away the cloth and makes a worse tear.
war: “Waray nagamit hin bag-o nga dugnit para hin pagtangkop hin daan nga panapton; kay nakakagisi han daan nga panapton in sugad nga tangkop, ngan mahiluag lugod an tarangkopan.

en: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. If they did, the wineskins would burst, the wine would spill, and the wineskins would be ruined. Instead, people pour new wine into new wineskins so that both are kept safe. ”
war: Waray liwat naipis hin bag-o nga bino ngadto hin daan na nga anit nga surudlan. Kon buhaton ini, mabuburit an surudlan, kay magigisi man an anit, ngan makakarag an bino. Lugod, isinusulod an bag-o nga bino ngadto hin bag-o nga anit nga surudlan ngan waray may nakakarag.”

en: While Jesus was speaking to them, a ruler came and knelt in front of him, saying, “My daughter has just died. But come and place your hand on her, and she’ll live.”
war: Han nagyayakan pa hi Jesus hini, hinmarani ha iya in usa nga Judiyo, linmuhod ha iya atubangan, ngan naghangyo: “Kamamatay pa la yana han akon anak nga babayehay, kundi upod gad ha akon ngan ipadapat an imo kamot ha iya, ngan mabubuhi hiya.”

en: So Jesus and his disciples got up and went with him.
war: Sanglit, binmuhat hi Jesus ngan sinmunod ha iya ngan inmupod ha iya an iya mga tinun-an.

en: Then a woman who had been bleeding for twelve years came up behind Jesus and touched the hem of his clothes.
war: May usa nga babaye nga gindidinogoan sulod hin dose na ka tuig, ngan pinmaluyo hiya kan Jesus. Kinamkam niya an sidsid han bado ni Jesus.

en: She thought, If I only touch his robe I’ll be healed.
war: Nagsiring hiya ha iya kalugaringon, “Kon makakamkam la ako han iya bado, mauupay gud ako.”

en: When Jesus turned and saw her, he said, “ Be encouraged, daughter. Your faith has healed you. ” And the woman was healed from that time on.
war: Linmingi hi Jesus ngan hinkit-an niya an babaye, ngan ginsiring niya, “Ayaw kahadlok, anak! Nakaupay ha imo an imo pagtoo.” Ngan dida dayon naupay an babaye.

en: When Jesus went into the ruler’s house, he saw the flute players and the distressed crowd.
war: Sanglit, kinmadto hi Jesus ha balay han opisyal. Han pakakita niya han mga magtotokar para han paglubong ngan han nagkarigumok nga mga tawo,

en: He said, “ Go away, because the little girl isn’t dead but is asleep ”; but they laughed at him.
war: nagsiring hiya, “Kagawas kamo ngatanan! Diri patay an bata; nakaturog la hiya!” Ngan gintinawaan hiya nira.

en: After he had sent the crowd away, Jesus went in and touched her hand, and the little girl rose up.
war: Han pagkagawas la han mga tawo, sinmulod hi Jesus han kwarto han babayehay, kinaptan ni Jesus an kamot han bata, ngan binmuhat an bata.

en: News about this spread throughout that whole region.
war: Ngan nahisangyaw ini nga nahinabo ha ngatanan nga dapit didto hito nga tuna.

en: As Jesus departed, two blind men followed him, crying out, “Show us mercy, Son of David.”
war: Binmaya hi Jesus hadto nga dapit ngan han naglalakat hiya, ginsunod hiya hin duha nga lalake nga buta. Ginmuliat hira, “Kaluoyi intawon kami, Anak ni David!”

en: When he came into the house, the blind men approached him. Jesus said to them, “ Do you believe I can do this? ” “Yes, Lord,” they replied.
war: Han pagsulod na ni Jesus hin balay, dinmaop ha iya an duha nga buta, ngan nagpakiana hiya ha ira, “Natoo ba kamo nga mahihimo ko ini?” Binmaton hira, “Oo, Ginoo.”
