war: Kundi nagdara an mga may buot hin mga surudlan nga puno hin lana upod han ira mga suga.

en: “When the groom was late in coming, they all became drowsy and went to sleep.
war: Nalangan pag-abot an karaslon nga lalake, sanglit pinamiraw ini nga mga daraga, ngan nanhingaturog.

en: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Look, the groom! Come out to meet him.’
war: “Han katutnga na, may ginmoliat ‘Aadi na an karaslon? Pakadi na kamo ngan tapoa niyo hiya!’

en: “Then all those bridesmaids got up and prepared their lamps.
war: Nagkamata an napulo nga kadaragan-an ngan gin-andam nira an ira mga suga.

en: But the foolish bridesmaids said to the wise ones, ‘Give us some of your oil, because our lamps have gone out.’
war: Niyan sinmiring an mga waray buot ngadto han mga may buot, ‘Tagi gad kami han iyo lana kay nagtitikaparong na an amon mga suga.’

en: “But the wise bridesmaids replied, ‘No, because if we share with you, there won’t be enough for our lamps and yours. We have a better idea. You go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.’
war: Binmaton an mga may buot, ‘Ayaw, bangin diri masadang an lana para ha iyo ngan ha amon. Kadto lugod kamo ha tindahan ngan palit kamo para ha iyo.’

en: But while they were gone to buy oil, the groom came. Those who were ready went with him into the wedding. Then the door was shut.
war: Sanglit linmakat an mga waray buot hin pagpalit hin lana, ngan han paghilakat nira, inmabot man an karaslon nga lalake. Sinmakob upod ha iya ngadto han kombite han pagkasal an lima nga mga daraga nga andam, ngan ginsadhan an porta.

en: “Later the other bridesmaids came and said, ‘Lord, lord, open the door for us.’
war: “Waray pag-iha, inmabot an mga waray buot nga kadaragan-an, ‘Pasudla kami!’ ginmoliat hira.

en: “But he replied, ‘I tell you the truth, I don’t know you.’
war: Kundi binmaton an karaslon, ‘Nasiring ako ha iyo: diri gud ako nakilala ha iyo.’”

en: “Therefore, keep alert, because you don’t know the day or the hour.
war: Gintapos ni Jesus an pananglitan hin pagsiring, “Sanglit pagbantay kamo, kay diri kamo maaram han adlaw o han takna.”

en: “The kingdom of heaven is like a man who was leaving on a trip. He called his servants and handed his possessions over to them.
war: “An Ginhadian han Langit masusugad hini: may-ada hadto usa ka tawo nga nakahunahuna hin paglakat ngadto hin langyaw nga dapit. Gintawag niya an iya mga surugoon ngan igintapod ha ira an iya mga hiagi.

en: To one he gave five valuable coins, and to another he gave two, and to another he gave one. He gave to each servant according to that servant’s ability. Then he left on his journey.
war: Gintagan niya an tagsa ha ira hin puhonan sumala han iya pagkatakos: gintagan niya hin singko mil pesos an usa, dos mil pesos an ikaduha, ngan mil pesos an ikatulo. Kahuman, linmakat hiya.

en: “After the man left, the servant who had five valuable coins took them and went to work doing business with them. He gained five more.
war: Linmakat dayon an surugoon nga kinmarawat hin singko mil pesos ngan iginpatigayon an iya kwarta, ngan nakadugang pa hiya hin singko mil pesos.

en: In the same way, the one who had two valuable coins gained two more.
war: Ha amo man nga paagi, nakadugang pa hin dos mil pesos an kinmarawat hin dos mil pesos.

en: But the servant who had received the one valuable coin dug a hole in the ground and buried his master’s money.
war: Kundi linmakat an surugoon nga kinmarawat hin mil pesos, nagbuho hiya ngan tagoon an kwarta han iya agaron.

en: “Now after a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them.
war: “Paghagos hin maiha nga panahon, inmoli an agaron hini nga mga surugoon ngan nakigtuhay ha ira.

en: The one who had received five valuable coins came forward with five additional coins. He said, ‘Master, you gave me five valuable coins. Look, I’ve gained five more.’
war: Dinmaop an surugoon nga kinmarawat hin singko mil pesos dara an dugang nga singko mil pesos pa. Nagsiring hiya, ‘Agaron, naghatag ka ha akon hin singko mil pesos. Kitaa! Aadi liwat in lain nga singko mil pesos nga akon pinakabuhian.’

en: “His master replied, ‘Excellent! You are a good and faithful servant! You’ve been faithful over a little. I’ll put you in charge of much. Come, celebrate with me.’
war: Nagsiring an iya agaron, ‘Maupay an imo ginbuhat, ikaw nga maupay ngan katataporan nga surugoon! Tungod kay nasasarigan ka hin pagpakabuhi hin gutiay nga kwarta, itatapod ko ha imo in damo nga salapi. Pakadi ha sulod ngan pakiangbit han akon kalipayan!’

en: “The second servant also came forward and said, ‘Master, you gave me two valuable coins. Look, I’ve gained two more.’
war: Niyan sinmulod an surugoon nga gintagan hin dos mil pesos ngan nagsiring, ‘Agaron, gintagan mo ako hin dos mil pesos. Kitaa! Aadi liwat in dugang nga dos mil pesos nga akon pinakabuhian.’

en: “His master replied, ‘Well done! You are a good and faithful servant. You’ve been faithful over a little. I’ll put you in charge of much. Come, celebrate with me.’
war: Nagsiring an iya agaron, ‘Maupay an imo ginbuhat, ikaw nga maupay ngan katataporan nga surugoon! Tungod kay nasasarigan ka hin pagpakabuhi hin gutiay nga kwarta, itatapod ko ha imo in damo nga salapi. Pakadi ha sulod ngan pakiangbit han akon kalipayan!’

en: “Now the one who had received one valuable coin came and said, ‘Master, I knew that you are a hard man. You harvest grain where you haven’t sown. You gather crops where you haven’t spread seed.
war: Niyan sinmulod an surugoon nga kinmarawat hin mil pesos ngan nagsiring, ‘Agaron, maaram ako nga makuri ka nga tawo: nag-aani ka han waray mo igtanom, ngan nagtitirok ka han abot han uma nga waray mo igpugas.

en: So I was afraid. And I hid my valuable coin in the ground. Here, you have what’s yours.’
war: Nahadlok ako, sanglit linmakat ako ngan gintago ko ha tuna an imo kwarta. Kitaa, iini an kwarta. Waray ito kaibani.’

en: “His master replied, ‘You evil and lazy servant! You knew that I harvest grain where I haven’t sown and that I gather crops where I haven’t spread seed?
war: Nagsiring an iya agaron, ‘Maraot ngan hubya ka nga surugoon! Maaram ka man kunta nga nag-aani ako han waray ko igtanom, ngan nagtitirok ako han abot han uma nga waray ko igpugas,

en: In that case, you should have turned my money over to the bankers so that when I returned, you could give me what belonged to me with interest.
war: kay ano man nga waray mo igbutang ha bangko an akon kwarta, basi ha akon pag-oli, karawton ko an puhonan, upod an patubo?

en: Therefore, take from him the valuable coin and give it to the one who has ten coins.
war: Yana, kuhaa niyo an kwarta ha iya ngan ihatag ngadto han surugoon nga may napulo ka yukot ka pesos.

en: Those who have much will receive more, and they will have more than they need. But as for those who don’t have much, even the little bit they have will be taken away from them.
war: Kay tatagan hin labaw pa an ngatanan nga may-ada na, ngan mamamay-ada hiya labaw han kasadangan; kundi kukuhaon tikang ha iya nga waray bisan pa an gutiay nga aada ha iya.

en: Now take the worthless servant and throw him out into the farthest darkness.’ “People there will be weeping and grinding their teeth.
war: Mahitungod hini nga waray gamit nga surugoon—ilabog hiya ngadto ha kasisidman ha gawas; didto magtatangis hiya ngan manliligot hiya han iya mga ngipon.’

en: “Now when the Human One comes in his majesty and all his angels are with him, he will sit on his majestic throne.
war: “Kon makanhi na an Anak han Tawo sugad nga Hadi ngan upod niya an ngatanan nga mga anghel, malingkod hiya dida han iya hadianon nga trono,

en: All the nations will be gathered in front of him. He will separate them from each other, just as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
war: ngan pagtitirokon niya ha iya atubangan an ngatanan nga katawhan han tuna. Niyan, pagbabahinon niya hira hin duha nga pundok, sugad hin magmarangno hin mga karnero kon ginlalain niya ha mga karnero an mga kanding.

en: He will put the sheep on his right side. But the goats he will put on his left.
war: Ibubutang niya an mga karnero ha iya tuo, ngan an mga kanding ha iya wala.

en: “Then the king will say to those on his right, ‘Come, you who will receive good things from my Father. Inherit the kingdom that was prepared for you before the world began.
war: Niyan masiring an hadi ngadto han mga tawo ha iya tuo, ‘Pakadi kamo nga ginpakaupay han akon Amay, ngan karawta niyo an ginhadian nga igin-andam para ha iyo tikang pa han kahimo han kalibutan.

en: I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me a drink. I was a stranger and you welcomed me.
war: Ginutom ako, ngan iyo ako ginpakaon; inuhaw ako, ngan iyo ako ginpainom; waray nakilala ha akon, ngan iyo ako kinarawat ha iyo mga balay;

en: I was naked and you gave me clothes to wear. I was sick and you took care of me. I was in prison and you visited me.’
war: lubas ako, ngan iyo ako ginpanaptonan; nasakit ako, ngan iyo ako ginmangnoan; napriso ako, ngan iyo ako ginbisita.’

en: “Then those who are righteous will reply to him, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you a drink?
war: Niyan mabaton ha iya an mga magtadong, ‘Ginoo, kakan-o ngani kami kita ha imo nga ginugutom ngan ginpakaon ka, o inuuhaw ngan ginpainom ka?

en: When did we see you as a stranger and welcome you, or naked and give you clothes to wear?
war: Kakan-o kami kita ha imo nga diri ka kinikilala ngan ginkarawat ka ngadto han amon mga panimalay o lubas ngan ginpanaptonan ka?

en: When did we see you sick or in prison and visit you?’
war: Kakan-o kami kita ha imo nga masakit o priso, ngan ginbisita ka namon?’

en: “Then the king will reply to them, ‘I assure you that when you have done it for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you have done it for me.’
war: Niyan mabaton ha ira an Hadi, ‘Nasiring ako ha iyo nga kada pagbuhat niyo hini para han usa han giuubosi hini nga akon kabugtoan, ginbuhat niyo ito para ha akon!’

en: “Then he will say to those on his left, ‘Get away from me, you who will receive terrible things. Go into the unending fire that has been prepared for the devil and his angels.
war: “Niyan masiring hiya ngadto han mga tawo ha iya wala: ‘Iwas kamo nga ginpanhimaraot han Dyos! Pakadto kamo han kalayo nga diri mapaparong nga gin-andam para han Yawa ngan han iya mga anghel!

en: I was hungry and you didn’t give me food to eat. I was thirsty and you didn’t give me anything to drink.
war: Kay ginutom ako, kundi waray ako niyo pakaona; inuhaw ako, kundi waray ako niyo paimna.

en: I was a stranger and you didn’t welcome me. I was naked and you didn’t give me clothes to wear. I was sick and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’
war: Waray nakilala ha akon, ngan waray ako niyo karawata ngadto han iyo mga panimalay; lubas ako, kundi waray ako niyo pagpanaptoni; nasakit ako ngan napriso, kundi waray ako niyo bisitaha.’

en: “ Then they will reply, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison and didn’t do anything to help you?’
war: Niyan mabaton hira ha iya: ‘Ginoo, kakan-o kami kumita ha imo nga ginutom o inuhaw, o diri kinikilala, o hubo, o masakit, o napriso, ngan waray kami bumulig ha imo?’

en: Then he will answer, ‘I assure you that when you haven’t done it for one of the least of these, you haven’t done it for me.’
war: Mabaton ha ira an Hadi, ‘Nasiring ako ha iyo, kada pagdumiri niyo hin pagbulig han usa hini nga mga giuubosi, nagdumiri kamo hin pagbulig ha akon.’

en: And they will go away into eternal punishment. But the righteous ones will go into eternal life. ”
war: Sanglit ikakadto ini hira ha sirot nga waray kataposan; kundi mapakadto an mga magtadong ha dayon nga kinabuhi.”

en: When Jesus finished speaking all these words, he said to his disciples,
war: Katapos ni Jesus pagtutdo hini ngatanan, nagsiring hiya ha iya mga tinun-an,

en: “ You know that the Passover is two days from now. And the Human One will be handed over to be crucified. ”
war: “Maaram na kamo nga duha na la ka adlaw ngan sasaurogon an Pyesta han Paglabay, ngan itutubyan an Anak han Tawo basi igraysang ha kros.”

en: Then the chief priests and elders of the people gathered in the courtyard of Caiaphas the high priest.
war: Niyan nagtirok an mga puno han kapadian ngan an katigurangan nga mga Judiyo didto han palasyo ni Caifas, an Labaw nga Padi.

en: They were plotting to arrest Jesus by cunning tricks and to kill him.
war: Nagsarabot hira hin hilom la nga pagdakop kan Jesus, ngan pagpatay ha iya.

en: But they agreed that it shouldn’t happen during the feast so there wouldn’t be an uproar among the people.
war: Nagsiring hira, “Kinahanglan diri ta buhaton ini ha panahon han pyesta, kay bangin magkasaramok an mga tawo.”

en: When Jesus was at Bethany visiting the house of Simon, who had a skin disease,
war: Han nakadto hi Jesus ha Betania didto han balay ni Simon nga sanlahon,

en: a woman came to him with a vase made of alabaster containing very expensive perfume. She poured it on Jesus’ head while he was sitting at dinner.
war: hinmarani ha iya in babaye nga may dara nga tibod nga alabastro nga puno hin mahal nga pahamot. Ginbubo ini niya ha ulo ni Jesus samtang nakaon hi Jesus.

en: Now when the disciples saw it they were angry and said, “Why this waste?
war: Hinkit-an ini han mga tinun-an ni Jesus, ngan nasina hira. “Kay ano hin pagkaragi hini nga pahamot?” nagpakiana hira.

en: This perfume could have been sold for a lot of money and given to the poor.”
war: “Mababaligya unta hin mahal ini nga pahamot ngan an kwarta mahahatag ha mga kablas!”

en: But Jesus knew what they were thinking. He said, “ Why do you make trouble for the woman? She’s done a good thing for me.
war: Nasayod hi Jesus han ira ginyinakan, ngan nagsiring ha ira, “Kay ano nga ginsasamok man niyo an babaye? Maupay ngan makaruruyag an iya ginbuhat ha akon.

en: You always have the poor with you, but you won’t always have me.
war: Dayuday kaupod niyo an mga kablas, kundi diri ako dayuday kaupod niyo.

en: By pouring this perfume over my body she’s prepared me to be buried.
war: Iginbubo niya ha akon lawas ini nga pahamot para pag-andam han paglubong ha akon.

en: I tell you the truth that wherever in the whole world this good news is announced, what she’s done will also be told in memory of her. ”
war: Hinumdomi niyo ini: bisan diin igwali ini nga Maupay nga Sumat ha bug-os nga kalibutan, hinanabihan manta an iya ginbuhat nga usa nga hinumdoman ha iya.”

en: Then one of the Twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests
war: Kinmadto han mga puno han kapadian in usa han dose nga mga tinun-an, nga ginngangaranan kan Judas Iscariote,

en: and said, “What will you give me if I turn Jesus over to you?” They paid him thirty pieces of silver.
war: ngan nagsiring, “Ano man an ihahatag niyo ha akon kon itubyan ko ha iyo hi Jesus?” Nag-ihap hira hin 30 ka salapi ngan iginhatag nira ha iya.

en: From that time on he was looking for an opportunity to turn him in.
war: Tikang hadto nga takna naghingita na hi Judas hin maupay nga higayon hin paglingo kan Jesus.

en: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus and said, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover meal?”
war: Ha syahan nga adlaw han Pyesta han Tinapay nga Waray Patubo, hinmarani kan Jesus an iya mga tinun-an ngan nagpakiana, “Diin an imo karuyag nga amon pag-aandaman para ha imo han kanan Paglabay nga pangaon?”

en: He replied, “ Go into the city, to a certain man, and say, ‘The teacher says, “ My time is near. I’m going to celebrate the Passover with my disciples at your house. ” ’ ”
war: Binmaton hiya, “Pakadto kamo hin usa ka tawo didto ha syudad, ngan sidnga hiya: ‘Nasiring an Magturutdo. Inmabot na an akon takna; magsasaurog ako ngan an akon mga tinun-an han Paglabay dida ha imo balay.’”

en: The disciples did just as Jesus instructed them. They prepared the Passover.
war: Gintuman han mga tinun-an an iginsugo ha ira ni Jesus, ngan gin-andam an kanan Paglabay nga pangaon.

en: That evening he took his place at the table with the twelve disciples.
war: Han pagkagab-i na, linmingkod hin pagkaon hi Jesus ngan an dose niya nga mga tinun-an.

en: As they were eating he said, “ I assure you that one of you will betray me. ”
war: Samtang nangangaon hira, nagsiring hi Jesus, “Susumatan ta kamo, usa ha iyo in maglilingo ha akon.”

en: Deeply saddened, each one said to him, “I’m not the one, am I, Lord?”
war: Duro an kabido han mga tinun-an ngan an tagsatagsa nagpakiana ha iya, “Ako ba, Ginoo?”

en: He replied, “ The one who will betray me is the one who dips his hand with me into this bowl.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “An madungan ha akon hin pagtunlob han iya tinapay ha plato, amo hiya an maglilingo ha akon.

en: The Human One goes to his death just as it is written about him. But how terrible it is for that person who betrays the Human One! It would have been better for him if he had never been born. ”
war: Mapatay an Anak han Tawo sumala han iginsiring han Kasuratan, kundi kamakaharadlok para han tawo nga maglilingo han Anak han Tawo! Mauruupay pa unta kon waray ini hiya matawo!”

en: Now Judas, who would betray him, replied, “It’s not me, is it, Rabbi?” Jesus answered, “ You said it. ”
war: Nagpakiana hi Judas, an malingo nga tawo, “Magturutdo, ako ba an karuyag mo sidngon?” Binmaton hi Jesus, “Ginyakan mo ini.”

en: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, blessed it, broke it, and gave it to the disciples and said, “ Take and eat. This is my body. ”
war: Han nangangaon hira, kinuha ni Jesus an tinapay, nag-ampo hin pagpasalamat, ginpinitpinit ini niya, ngan iginhatag ha iya mga tinun-an upod an pagsiring, “Karawata niyo ngan kaon kamo. Amo ini an akon lawas.”

en: He took a cup, gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, “ Drink from this, all of you.
war: Ngan kinuha niya an kupa, nagpasalamat sa Dyos, ngan iginhatag ini ha ira upod an pagsiring, “Inom kamo ngatanan hini.

en: This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many so that their sins may be forgiven.
war: Amo ini an akon dugo nga nagpapadig-on han ginsaaran han Dyos, an akon dugo nga gin-ula para han kadam-an, basi mapasaylo an mga sala.

en: I tell you, I won’t drink wine again until that day when I drink it in a new way with you in my Father’s kingdom. ”
war: Nasiring ako ha iyo nga diri na gud ako mainom hini nga bino tubtob han adlaw nga imnon ko an bag-o nga bino upod ha iyo didto han Ginhadian han akon Amay.”

en: Then, after singing songs of praise, they went to the Mount of Olives.
war: Ngan nagkanta hira hin usa nga imno ngan nagpasingadto hira ha Bukid han mga Olibo.

en: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “ Tonight you will all fall away because of me. This is because it is written, I will hit the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will go off in all directions .
war: Niyan nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Yana gud nga gab-i mapalagiw kamo ngatanan ngan babayaan ako niyo kay nasiring an Kasuratan, ‘Papatayon han Dyos an magbarantay ngan magsasarang an mga karnero.’

en: But after I’m raised up, I’ll go before you to Galilee. ”
war: Kundi kon mabanhaw na ako, mag-uuna ako ha iyo ngadto ha Galilea.”

en: Peter replied, “If everyone else stumbles because of you, I’ll never stumble.”
war: Nagsiring hi Pedro kan Jesus, “Diri gud ako mabaya ha imo bisan pa kon bayaan ka han ngatanan!”

en: Jesus said to him, “ I assure you that, before the rooster crows tonight, you will deny me three times. ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus kan Pedro, “Tigamni ini: diri pa matugaok an manok yana nga gab-i iglilirong mo na ako makatulo.”

en: Peter said, “Even if I must die alongside you, I won’t deny you.” All the disciples said the same thing.
war: Binmaton hi Pedro, “Diri gud ako maglilirong ha imo bisan kon patayon ako upod ha imo!” Ngan amo man an iginsiring han ngatanan nga mga tinun-an.

en: Then Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane. He said to the disciples, “ Stay here while I go and pray over there. ”
war: Niyan kinmadto hi Jesus upod an iya mga tinun-an hin dapit nga ginngangaranan nga Getsemane, ngan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Pangalingkod kamo dinhe samtang makadto ako ha unhan hin pag-ampo.”

en: When he took Peter and Zebedee’s two sons, he began to feel sad and anxious.
war: Igin-upod niya hira Pedro ngan an duha nga mga anak ni Sebedeo. Binmati hiya hin dako nga kasakit ngan kabido,

en: Then he said to them, “ I’m very sad. It’s as if I’m dying. Stay here and keep alert with me. ”
war: ngan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Tugob hin kabidoan an akon kasingkasing nga haros ko ikamatay. Pabilin kamo dinhe ngan pagbantay upod ha akon.”

en: Then he went a short distance farther and fell on his face and prayed, “ My Father, if it’s possible, take this cup of suffering away from me. However—not what I want but what you want. ”
war: Napakadto hiya ha unhan, hinmapa ha tuna, ngan nag-ampo, “Amay ko, kon mahimo, kuhaa gad ha akon ini nga kupa! Kundi matuman an imo pagbuot, diri an akon.”

en: He came back to the disciples and found them sleeping. He said to Peter, “ Couldn’t you stay alert one hour with me?
war: Niyan binmalik hiya ngadto han tulo nga mga tinun-an ngan hin-agian niya hira nga nangangaturog. Nagsiring hiya kan Pedro, “Naunan-o nga kamo nga tulo waray makahimo hin pag-agma upod ha akon bisan hin usa la ka oras?

en: Stay alert and pray so that you won’t give in to temptation. The spirit is eager, but the flesh is weak. ”
war: Pagbantay ngan pag-ampo kamo, basi diri kamo mahulog ngadto hin kasulay. Andam an espritu, kundi maluya an lawas.”

en: A second time he went away and prayed, “ My Father, if it’s not possible that this cup be taken away unless I drink it, then let it be what you want. ”
war: Binmaya ha ira hi Jesus ngan nag-ampo, “Amay ko, kon diri man makukuha ini nga kupa labot kon imnon ko, matuman an imo kaburut-on.”

en: Again he came and found them sleeping. Their eyes were heavy with sleep.
war: Binmalik liwat hiya ngan hin-agian niya an mga tinun-an nga nangangaturog kay piraw na gud hira hin duro.

en: But he left them and again went and prayed the same words for the third time.
war: Sanglit binayaan liwat hira ni Jesus, pinmaharayo hiya, ngan nag-ampo hin ikatulo, hin amo gihapon nga mga pulong.

en: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “ Will you sleep and rest all night? Look, the time has come for the Human One to be betrayed into the hands of sinners.
war: Niyan binmalik hiya ngadto han mga tinun-an ngan nagsiring, “Nangangaturog ngan namamahuway la gihapon kamo? Kitaa! Inmabot na an takna nga itutubyan an Anak han Tawo ngadto han gahom han mga makasasala.

en: Get up. Let’s go. Look, here comes my betrayer. ”
war: Pagkabuhat kamo, pagkalakat na kita. Kitaa, aanhi na an tawo nga maglilingo ha akon!”

en: While Jesus was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, came. With him was a large crowd carrying swords and clubs. They had been sent by the chief priests and elders of the people.
war: Nagyiyinakan pa hi Jesus han pag-abot ni Judas nga usa han dose nga mga tinun-an. Upod niya in damo nga mga tawo nga may dara nga mga espada ngan mga balbag. Ginsugo hira han mga puno han kapadian ngan han katigurangan han mga Judiyo.

en: His betrayer had given them a sign: “Arrest the man I kiss.”
war: Naghatag an malingo hin usa nga tigaman ngadto han mga tawo: “An tawo nga akon hadkan amo an iyo ginbibiling. Dakpa niyo hiya!”

en: Just then he came to Jesus and said, “Hello, Rabbi.” Then he kissed him.
war: Han pag-abot ni Judas, kinmadto dayon hiya kan Jesus ngan sinmiring, “Magturutdo, an kalinaw maada ha imo,” ngan ginhadkan hiya.

en: But Jesus said to him, “ Friend, do what you came to do. ” Then they came and grabbed Jesus and arrested him.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Sangkay, tumana dayon an imo karuyag pagbuhaton!” Ngan dinmaop hira, gindakop nira hi Jesus, ngan gintalo hiya.

en: One of those with Jesus reached for his sword. Striking the high priest’s slave, he cut off his ear.
war: Hinmulbot ha iya espada in usa han mga kaupod ni Jesus, ngan tigbason an oripon han Labaw nga Padi, ngan napalong an usa niya nga talinga.

en: Then Jesus said to him, “ Put the sword back into its place. All those who use the sword will die by the sword.
war: Sinmiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Ibalik ha takob an imo espada, kay adton magamit hin espada, mapatay pinaagi hin espada.

en: Or do you think that I’m not able to ask my Father and he will send to me more than twelve battle groups of angels right away?
war: Diri ka ba maaram nga makakaaro ako hin bulig tikang han akon Amay, ngan ha gilayon magpapadara hiya ha akon hin sobra dose nga mga hugpo hin kasondalohan nga mga anghel?

en: But if I did that, how would the scriptures be fulfilled that say this must happen? ”
war: Kundi kon buhaton ini, ano man hin katuman han Kasuratan nga nasiring nga kinahanglan ini mahinabo?”

en: Then Jesus said to the crowds, “ Have you come with swords and clubs to arrest me, like a thief? Day after day, I sat in the temple teaching, but you didn’t arrest me.
war: Niyan nagyakan hi Jesus ngadto han mga tawo, “Tulisan ba ako nga kinmanhi man kamo dara in mga espada ngan mga balbag hin pagdakop ha akon? Kada adlaw nalingkod ngan nagtutdo ako didto ha Templo, ngan waray ako niyo dakpa.

en: But all this has happened so that what the prophets said in the scriptures might be fulfilled. ” Then all the disciples left Jesus and ran away.
war: Kundi nahinabo ini ngatanan basi matuman an iginsurat han mga manaragna dida han Kasuratan.” Niyan an ngatanan nga mga tinun-an binmaya ha iya ngan nangalagiw.

en: Those who arrested Jesus led him to Caiaphas the high priest. The legal experts and the elders had gathered there.
war: Gindara hi Jesus han mga tawo nga nagdakop ha iya ngadto han balay ni Caifas, an Labaw nga Padi, diin nagkatirok an mga magturutdo han Balaod ngan an katigurangan.

en: Peter followed him from a distance until he came to the high priest’s courtyard. He entered that area and sat outside with the officers to see how it would turn out.
war: Sinmunod ha iya hin antaw hi Pedro tubtob han libong han balay han Labaw nga Padi. Niyan sinmulod hi Pedro han libong ngan linmingkod upod han mga bantay, basi mahibaroan niya kon ano man an mahinanabo.

en: The chief priests and the whole council were looking for false testimony against Jesus so that they could put him to death.
war: An mga puno han kapadian ngan an bug-os nga konseho nagtalinguha hin pagbiling hin sadang igbutangbutang kan Jesus basi patayon nira.

en: They didn’t find anything they could use from the many false witnesses who were willing to come forward. But finally they found two
war: Kundi waray gud nira hin-agian, bisan kon damo in dinmaop ngan nagsumat hin mga buwa mahitungod ha iya. Ha kataposan dinmaop in duha ka tawo

en: who said, “This man said, ‘I can destroy God’s temple and rebuild it in three days.’”
war: ngan nagsiring, “Nagsiring ini nga tawo, ‘Makakahimo ako hin pagruba han Templo han Dyos, ngan akon liwat titindogon sulod hin tulo ka adlaw.’”

en: Then the high priest stood and said to Jesus, “Aren’t you going to respond to the testimony these people have brought against you?”
war: Tinmindog an Labaw nga Padi ngan nagpakiana kan Jesus, “Waray ba nimo sadang ibaton hini nga sumbong kontra ha imo?”

en: But Jesus was silent. The high priest said, “By the living God, I demand that you tell us whether you are the Christ, God’s Son.”
war: Kundi hinmilom la hi Jesus. Nagsiring liwat ha iya an Labaw nga Padi, “Ha ngaran han Dyos nga buhi, pinapagsumpa ko ikaw: pagsumati kami kon amo ka ba an Mesiyas, an Anak han Dyos.”

en: “ You said it, ” Jesus replied. “ But I say to you that from now on you’ll see the Human One sitting on the right side of the Almighty and coming on the heavenly clouds . ”
war: Binmaton ha iya hi Jesus, “Imo ito ginyakan. Kundi susumatan ko kamo ngatanan: tikang yana hikikit-an niyo an Anak han Tawo nga nalingkod ha tuo han Labi Kamakagarahum ngan maabot dida ha bawbaw hin mga dampog han langit!”

en: Then the high priest tore his clothes and said, “He’s insulting God! Why do we need any more witnesses? Look, you’ve heard his insult against God.
war: Han pakabati hini han Labaw nga Padi, ginggisi niya an iya panapton ngan nagsiring, “Dako nga pagpanamastamas han Dyos! Waray na kita kinahanglan hin mga testigo! Hinbatian na niyo dinhe an iya pagpanamastamas han Dyos!

en: What do you think?” And they answered, “He deserves to die!”
war: Ano an iyo ighuhukom?” Binmaton hira, “Salaan hiya ngan kinahanglan mamatay.”

en: Then they spit in his face and beat him. They hit him
war: 67-68 Niyan gintuprahan nira an iya bayhon ngan ginlatob hiya. Nagsiring an mga nagtampalo ha iya, “Pagtagna ha amon, Mesiyas, tigoha kon hin-o an nagtampalo ha imo!”

en: and said, “Prophesy for us, Christ! Who hit you?”
war: Nalingkod hi Pedro didto han libong ha gawas. Hinmarani ha iya in usa han mga babaye nga surugoon han Labaw nga Padi ngan sinmiring, “Upod ka liwat ni Jesus nga taga-Galilea.”

en: Meanwhile, Peter was sitting outside in the courtyard. A servant woman came and said to him, “You were also with Jesus the Galilean.”
war: Kundi iginlirong niya ini ha atubangan nira ngatanan. “Diri ako maaram han imo ginyayakan,” binmaton hiya,

en: But he denied it in front of all of them, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”
war: ngan ginmawas hiya ngadto han ganghaan han libong. Hinkit-an hiya hin lain nga surugoon nga babaye, ngan nagsumat hiya han mga tawo didto, “Kaupod hiya ni Jesus nga taga-Nazaret.”

en: When he went over to the gate, another woman saw him and said to those who were there, “This man was with Jesus, the man from Nazareth.”
war: Kundi naglirong liwat hi Pedro ngan binmaton, “Iginsusumpa ko nga diri ako nakilala hito nga tawo!”

en: With a solemn pledge, he denied it again, saying, “I don’t know the man.”
war: Waray pag-iha hinmarani kan Pedro an kalalaken-an nga nakadto. Nagsiring hira, “Waray ruhaduha usa ka ha ira, kay hinsasabutan namon pinaagi han imo pagyakan!”

en: A short time later those standing there came and said to Peter, “You must be one of them. The way you talk gives you away.”
war: Niyan nagsumpa hi Pedro ngan nagsiring, “Mamatay pa ako kon buwa an akon siring! Diri gud ako nakilala hito nga tawo!” Dida dayon tinmugaok in manok,

en: Then he cursed and swore, “I don’t know the man!” At that very moment the rooster crowed.
war: ngan nahinumdom hi Pedro han iginsiring ha iya ni Jesus, “Iglilirong mo ako makatulo nga diri pa matugaok an manok.” Ngan ginmawas hiya ngan nagtangis upod an pagbasol.

en: Early in the morning all the chief priests and the elders of the people reached the decision to have Jesus put to death.
war: Timprano pa han aga nagsarabot na an ngatanan nga mga puno han kapadian ngan katigurangan han mga Judiyo kon uunanhon nira hin pagpatay kan Jesus.

en: They bound him, led him away, and turned him over to Pilate the governor.
war: Ginggapos nira hiya, gindara, ngan igintubyan kan Pilato, an gobernador nga Romano.

en: When Judas, who betrayed Jesus, saw that Jesus was condemned to die, he felt deep regret. He returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders, and
war: Han pakasabot ni Judas, an malingo, nga ira hi Jesus papatayon, nagbasol hiya ngan igin-oli an 30 ka salapi nga sensilyo ngadto han mga puno han kapadian ngan katigurangan han mga Judiyo.

en: said, “I did wrong because I betrayed an innocent man.” But they said, “What is that to us? That’s your problem.”
war: Nagsiring hiya, “Nakasala ako kay akon igintubyan ha kamatayon an tawo nga waray sala!” Binmaton hira, “Ano man an amon labot hini? Imo na ito baratonon!”

en: Judas threw the silver pieces into the temple and left. Then he went and hanged himself.
war: Ipinilak ni Judas an kwarta ngadto han ruwang han Templo ngan ginmawas hiya. Katapos, linmakat hiya ngan naghikog.

en: The chief priests picked up the silver pieces and said, “According to the Law it’s not right to put this money in the treasury. Since it was used to pay for someone’s life, it’s unclean.”
war: Ginpurot han mga puno han kapadian an kwarta ngan sinmiring hira, “Kwarta ini nga naunongan hin kinabuhi, ngan supak han aton Balaod nga ini ibutang didto han hiriposan han Templo.”

en: So they decided to use it to buy the potter’s field where strangers could be buried.
war: Ira ginkatarangdoan nga gamiton an kwarta hin pagpalit han Uma han Maghirimo hin Daba, basi himoon nga lubnganan hin mga lumalangyaw.

en: That’s why that field is called “Field of Blood” to this very day.
war: Sanglit ginngaranan an uma nga “Uma hin Dugo” ngada yana nga adlaw.

en: This fulfilled the words of Jeremiah the prophet: And I took the thirty pieces of silver, the price for the one whose price had been set by some of the Israelites,
war: Sanglit natuman an iginsiring ni Jeremias nga manaragna: “Ginkuha nira an 30 ka bug-os nga salapi, an ginkatangdoan han mga tawo han Israel hin pagpalit ha iya,

en: and I gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me .
war: ngan ginamit nira hin pagpalit han uma han maghirimo hin daba, sumala han sugo ha akon han Ginoo.”

en: Jesus was brought before the governor. The governor said, “Are you the king of the Jews?” Jesus replied, “ That’s what you say. ”
war: Tinmindog hi Jesus ha atubangan han gobernador nga Romano ngan ginpakianhan hiya. “Ikaw ba an hadi han mga Judiyo?” “Imo ito ginyakan,” nagbaton hi Jesus.

en: But he didn’t answer when the chief priests and elders accused him.
war: Kundi waray hiya magbaton han mga sumbong han mga puno han kapadian ngan katigurangan.

en: Then Pilate said, “Don’t you hear the testimony they bring against you?”
war: Sanglit nagsiring hi Pilato ha iya, “Diri ka ba nabati han ngatanan nga ira sumbong ha imo?”

en: But he didn’t answer, not even a single word. So the governor was greatly amazed.
war: Kundi waray gud hi Jesus magbaton bisan na man la usa ka pulong, sanglit duro gud an paghipausa han gobernador.

en: It was customary during the festival for the governor to release to the crowd one prisoner, whomever they might choose.
war: Kada Pyesta han Paglabay may batasan han gobernador hin pagbuhi hin bisan hin-o nga priso nga pangaroon han mga tawo.

en: At that time there was a well-known prisoner named Jesus Barabbas.
war: Hadto nga panahon may kilala kaupay nga preso nga Jesus Barabas an ngaran.

en: When the crowd had come together, Pilate asked them, “Whom would you like me to release to you, Jesus Barabbas or Jesus who is called Christ?”
war: Sanglit han pagkatirok na han mga tawo, nagpakiana hi Pilato ha ira, “Hin-o man an iyo karuyag nga akon buhian? Hi Jesus Barabas ba o hi Jesus nga ginngangaranan nga Cristo?”

en: He knew that the leaders of the people had handed him over because of jealousy.
war: Nasayod hi Pilato nga igintubyan nira hi Jesus ha iya tungod la hin kaawa.

en: While he was serving as judge, his wife sent this message to him, “Leave that righteous man alone. I’ve suffered much today in a dream because of him.”
war: Han nalingkod hi Pilato didto han hukmanan, ginpatugonan hiya han iya asawa nga nasiring: “Ayaw gud paghilabot hito nga tawo nga waray sala, kay kagab-i, pinaagi hin inop, nag-antos ako hin duro tungod ha iya.”

en: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowds to ask for Barabbas and kill Jesus.
war: Ginhugay han mga puno han kapadian ngan katigurangan an mga tawo nga pangaroon nira kan Pilato nga buhian niya hi Barabas ngan patayon hi Jesus.

en: The governor said, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” “Barabbas,” they replied.
war: Kundi ginpakianhan hira han gobernador, “Hin-o man hini nga duha an iyo karuyag nga akon buhian?” “Hi Barabas!” nagbaton hira.

en: Pilate said, “Then what should I do with Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said, “Crucify him!”
war: “Kon sugad, ano man an akon bubuhaton kan Jesus nga ginngangaranan nga Cristo?” nagpakiana hi Pilato ha ira. Nagbaton hira ngatanan, “Igraysang hiya ha kros!”

en: But he said, “Why? What wrong has he done?” They shouted even louder, “Crucify him!”
war: Kundi nagpakiana hi Pilato, “Ano nga sala an iya nabuhat?” Ngan hira ha makusog nga tingog nagdurungan hin paggoliat, “Igraysang hiya ha kros!”

en: Pilate saw that he was getting nowhere and that a riot was starting. So he took water and washed his hands in front of the crowd. “I’m innocent of this man’s blood,” he said. “It’s your problem.”
war: Han pakasabot ni Pilato nga kawang la an pagpadayon, ngan bangin la mahinabo in kasamok, kinmuha hiya hin tubig, naghunaw hiya ha atubangan han mga tawo, ngan nagsiring, “Waray ko labot han kamatayon hini nga tawo! Iyo ini karuyag!”

en: All the people replied, “Let his blood be on us and on our children.”
war: Binmaton an ngatanan nga mga tawo, “Kami ngan han amon mga anak an mabaton han kamatayon hini nga tawo!”

en: Then he released Barabbas to them. He had Jesus whipped, then handed him over to be crucified.
war: Niyan ginbuhian ni Pilato hi Barabas, iginpalatob niya hi Jesus, ngan igintubyan hiya ha ira basi igraysang ha kros.

en: The governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the governor’s house, and they gathered the whole company of soldiers around him.
war: Niyan gindara hi Jesus han mga sondalo ni Pilato ngadto han palasyo han gobernador ngan gin-alirongan hiya han bug-os nga hugpo han mga sondalo.

en: They stripped him and put a red military coat on him.
war: Ginlubasan hiya han iya panapton ngan ginsul-otan hiya hin hilawig nga pula nga bado.

en: They twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on his head. They put a stick in his right hand. Then they bowed down in front of him and mocked him, saying, “Hey! King of the Jews!”
war: Naghimo hira hin tunokon nga korona, iginbutang ini ha iya ulo, ngan ginpakapot hin sipak ha iya tuo nga kamot. Nagluhodluhod hira ha atubangan niya ngan nag-ooyan-oyan hira ha iya, “Mabuhi an hadi han mga Judiyo!” sinmiring hira.

en: After they spit on him, they took the stick and struck his head again and again.
war: Ginludhan hiya ngan kinuha nira an sipak han iya kamot ngan ginbalbag an iya ulo.

en: When they finished mocking him, they stripped him of the military coat and put his own clothes back on him. They led him away to crucify him.
war: Kahuman na nira pag-oyan-oyan ha iya, ginlubas nira an hilawig nga bado, iginsul-ot an iya kalugaringon nga panapton, ngan gindara hiya ha gawas basi igraysang ha kros.

en: As they were going out, they found Simon, a man from Cyrene. They forced him to carry his cross.
war: Han tigawas na hira han bungto, iginkatapo nira in tawo nga ginngaranan kan Simon nga taga Cirene, ngan ginpirit ini hiya nira hin pagpas-an han kros ni Jesus.

en: When they came to a place called Golgotha, which means Skull Place,
war: Inmabot hira ha usa nga dapit nga ginngangaranan nga Golgota, nga an kahulogan, “An Dapit han Klabera.”

en: they gave Jesus wine mixed with vinegar to drink. But after tasting it, he didn’t want to drink it.
war: Didto gintagan nira hi Jesus hin bino nga sinaktan hin apdo basi niya imnon. Kundi han pakatilaw ni Jesus, waray hiya uminom.

en: After they crucified him, they divided up his clothes among them by drawing lots.
war: Niyan iginraysang hiya nira ha kros ngan ginbahinbahin nira an iya mga panapton pinaagi hin ripa.

en: They sat there, guarding him.
war: Pagkatapos, linmingkod hira ngan ginbantayan nira hiya.

en: They placed above his head the charge against him. It read, “This is Jesus, the king of the Jews.”
war: Iginpaskin nira ha igbaw han iya ulo an sinurat nga sumbong kontra ha iya: “Amo ini hi Jesus, an hadi han mga Judiyo.”

en: They crucified with him two outlaws, one on his right side and one on his left.
war: Ngan iginraysang liwat nira ha kros in duha nga mga tulisan upod kan Jesus, an usa ha iya tuo ngan an usa ha iya wala.

en: Those who were walking by insulted Jesus, shaking their heads
war: An mga tawo nga nangangagi nagpilingpiling han ira ulo ngan nagyubit kan Jesus hin pagsiring,

en: and saying, “So you were going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days, were you? Save yourself! If you are God’s Son, come down from the cross.”
war: “Ikaw man ngay-an an magruruba han Templo ngan magtitindog liwat hini sulod hin tulo ka adlaw! Pagtalwas na ha imo ngahaw kon Anak ka manggud han Dyos! Lusad dida ha kros!”

en: In the same way, the chief priests, along with the legal experts and the elders, were making fun of him, saying,
war: Ha amo man nga paagi ginyubitan hiya han mga puno han kapadian, han mga magturutdo han Balaod, ngan han katigurangan nga nasiring:

en: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. He’s the king of Israel, so let him come down from the cross now. Then we’ll believe in him.
war: “Gintalwas niya an iba, kundi diri hiya nakakatalwas han iya kalugaringon! Diri ba hiya amo an hadi han Israel? Kon lumusad hiya yana ha kros, matoo kita ha iya!

en: He trusts in God, so let God deliver him now if he wants to. He said, ‘I’m God’s Son.’”
war: Nasarig hiya han Dyos ngan nasiring nga amo hiya an Anak han Dyos. Kitaon ta kon karuyag man han Dyos hin pagtalwas ha iya yana!”

en: The outlaws who were crucified with him insulted him in the same way.
war: Bisan pa ngani an mga tulisan nga iginraysang upod ha iya nagbiaybiay ha iya.

en: From noon until three in the afternoon the whole earth was dark.
war: Han pagka-udto, nagsirom an bug-os nga tuna sulod hin tulo ka oras.

en: At about three Jesus cried out with a loud shout, “ Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani ,” which means, “ My God, my God, why have you left me? ”
war: Han mga alas tres na, ginmoliat hi Jesus hin dako nga tingog, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?” nga an karuyag sidngon, “Dyos ko, Dyos ko, kay ano nga ginpabay-an mo ako?”

en: After hearing him, some standing there said, “He’s calling Elijah.”
war: Nakabati ha iya an iba nga mga tawo nga nagkakatukdaw didto ngan nagsiring hira, “Nagtatawag hiya kan Elias!”

en: One of them ran over, took a sponge full of vinegar, and put it on a pole. He offered it to Jesus to drink.
war: Dinmalagan dayon in usa ha ira, kinmuha hin espongha nga hinumog hin bino, igintaod ini ha kataposan hin sipak, ngan iginhungit ngadto kan Jesus hin pagpainom ha iya.

en: But the rest of them said, “Let’s see if Elijah will come and save him.”
war: Kundi nagsiring an iba, “Hulat anay, kikitaon ta kon kumanhi manggud hi Elias hin pagtalwas ha iya!”

en: Again Jesus cried out with a loud shout. Then he died.
war: Hin makusog nga tingog ginmuliat hi Jesus, ngan nabunosan hiya han iya kinabuhi.

en: Look, the curtain of the sanctuary was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook, the rocks split,
war: Tigda la nga nagisi ha butnga an biray han Templo, tikang ha igbaw ngadto ha ubos. Nabay-og an tuna, nagkabubuka an mga bato,

en: and the bodies of many holy people who had died were raised.
war: nagkaabre an mga lubnganan, ngan damo nga mga patay na nga magtinuohon han Dyos an nabanhaw.

en: After Jesus’ resurrection they came out of their graves and went into the holy city where they appeared to many people.
war: Ginmawas hira han mga lubnganan; ngan katapos mabanhaw hi Jesus, kinmadto hira han Syudad nga Baraan, ngan didto hinkit-an hira hin damo nga mga tawo.

en: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and what had just happened, they were filled with awe and said, “This was certainly God’s Son.”
war: Nahadlok an kapitan ngan an mga sondalo nga kaupod niya nga nagbabantay kan Jesus, han pag-abat nira han linog ngan pagkita nira han ngatanan nga nahinabo. Nagsiring hira, “Matuod gud nga hiya amo an Anak han Dyos!”

en: Many women were watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to serve him.
war: Damo in kababayen-an nga nagkikinita tikang ha hirayo. Nagsinunod ini hira kan Jesus tikang pa ha Galilea, ngan nagbulig ha iya.

en: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedee’s sons.
war: Upod ha ira, amo hira Maria Magdalena, Maria nga iroy nira Santiago ug Jose, ngan an asawa ni Sebedeo.

en: That evening a man named Joseph came. He was a rich man from Arimathea who had become a disciple of Jesus.
war: Han kulopay na, inmabot in usa nga taga-Arimatea nga ginngaranan kan Jose. Usa hiya nga tinun-an ni Jesus.

en: He came to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission to take it.
war: Nakigkita hiya kan Pilato ngan gin-aro niya an lawas ni Jesus. Nagsugo hi Pilato nga ihatag an lawas kan Jose.

en: Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
war: Sanglit gindara ni Jose an lawas ngan ginputos hin bag-o nga taklap nga lino.

en: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had carved out of the rock. After he rolled a large stone at the door of the tomb, he went away.
war: Iginbutang ini niya didto han iya kalugaringon nga lubnganan nga bag-o pa la nga gin-ukab dida hin bato. Niyan ginpakaliding niya in dako nga bato ngadto han ganggang hin pagtakop han porta han lubnganan, ngan linmakat hiya.

en: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were there, sitting in front of the tomb.
war: Nakadto hira Maria Magdalena ngan an usa pa nga Maria, nalingkod ha atubangan han lubnganan.

en: The next day, which was the day after Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered before Pilate.
war: Han pagkasunod nga adlaw, nga amo an Adlaw nga Iparahuway, nakigkita kan Pilato an mga puno han kapadian ngan an mga Parisiyo,

en: They said, “Sir, we remember that while that deceiver was still alive he said, ‘After three days I will arise.’
war: ngan nagsiring hira, “Nahinunumdom kami nga han buhi pa adto nga buwaon, nagsiring hiya, ‘Mababanhaw ako katapos hin tulo ka adlaw.’

en: Therefore, order the grave to be sealed until the third day. Otherwise, his disciples may come and steal the body and tell the people, ‘He’s been raised from the dead.’ This last deception will be worse than the first.”
war: Sanglit pabantayi hin maupay an lubnganan tubtob han ikatulo ka adlaw, basi diri makakadto an iya mga tinun-an pagkawat ha iya, ngan katapos, igpabantog nira ha mga tawo nga nabanhaw hiya. Ini nga orhe nga buwa labaw pa hin kamaraot kay han syahan.”

en: Pilate replied, “You have soldiers for guard duty. Go and make it as secure as you know how.”
war: Ngan nagsiring hi Pilato ha ira, “Kuha kamo hin magbarantay ngan pabantayi ha iya hin maupay an lubnganan.”

en: Then they went and secured the tomb by sealing the stone and posting the guard.
war: Sanglit nagkalakat hira ngan basi masiguro nga waray gud maglabot han lubnganan, ira gintimrehan an lubnganan, ngan ginpabantayan pa.

en: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to look at the tomb.
war: Katapos han Adlaw nga Iparahuway, han nagmamanagbanag na ha aga han Domingo nga adlaw, kinmadto hin panginano han lubnganan hira Maria Magdalena ngan usa pa nga Maria.

en: Look, there was a great earthquake, for an angel from the Lord came down from heaven. Coming to the stone, he rolled it away and sat on it.
war: Tigda la nga linminog hin makusog; kinmunsad tikang ha langit in usa nga anghel han Ginoo, ginkaliding niya an sada nga bato, ngan iya ini ginlingkoran.

en: Now his face was like lightning and his clothes as white as snow.
war: Sugad hin kikidlat an iya dagway, ngan duro kamabusag an iya panapton.

en: The guards were so terrified of him that they shook with fear and became like dead men.
war: Duro an pangurog tungod hin kahadlok an mga bantay, ngan waray hira makakiwa, sugad hira hin mga patay.

en: But the angel said to the women, “Don’t be afraid. I know that you are looking for Jesus who was crucified.
war: Ginsiring han anghel an kababayen-an, “Ayaw kamo kahadlok. Maaram ako nga ginbibiling niyo hi Jesus nga iginraysang ha kros.

en: He isn’t here, because he’s been raised from the dead, just as he said. Come, see the place where they laid him.
war: Waray hiya dinhe; nabanhaw hiya sugad han siring niya. Kadi ngan kitaa niyo an dapit nga ginhigdaan niya.

en: Now hurry, go and tell his disciples, ‘He’s been raised from the dead. He’s going on ahead of you to Galilee. You will see him there.’ I’ve given the message to you.”
war: Kadtoa niyo dayon yana an iya mga tinun-an ngan sumati, ‘Nabanhaw hiya ngan mag-uuna hiya ha iyo ngadto ha Galilea; makakakita kamo ha iya didto!’ Hinumdomi an akon iginsumat ha iyo.”

en: With great fear and excitement, they hurried away from the tomb and ran to tell his disciples.
war: Sanglit ha kadagmitan, binmaya hira han lubnganan. Nakada pa ha ira an kahadlok, kundi puno hin kalipay, ngan nagdadlagan hira hin pagsumat han iya mga tinun-an.

en: But Jesus met them and greeted them. They came and grabbed his feet and worshipped him.
war: Tigda la nga gintapo hira ni Jesus ngan ginsiring, “An kalinaw maada ha iyo.” Dinmaop hira ha iya, kinaptan an iya mga tiil, ngan nagsingba ha iya.

en: Then Jesus said to them, “ Don’t be afraid. Go and tell my brothers that I am going into Galilee. They will see me there. ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Ayaw kamo kahadlok. Kadtoa niyo an akon kabugtoan ngan sumati hira nga mapakadto hira ha Galilea, ngan didto makita hira ha akon.”

en: Now as the women were on their way, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests everything that had happened.
war: Han pagkalakat na han kababayen-an, binmalik ha syudad in pira han mga sondalo nga nagbantay han lubnganan, ngan nagsumat han mga puno han kapadian han ngatanan nga nahinabo.

en: They met with the elders and decided to give a large sum of money to the soldiers.
war: Nakigkita han katigurangan an mga puno han kapadian ngan nagsarabot hira kon ano an maupay buhaton. Ginhukipan nira an mga sondalo hin damo nga kwarta,

en: They told them, “Say that Jesus’ disciples came at night and stole his body while you were sleeping.
war: ngan ginsiring, “Igsumat niyo nga kinmadto an iya mga tinun-an kagab-i ngan ginkawat an iya lawas, samtang nangangaturog kamo.

en: And if the governor hears about this, we will take care of it with him so you will have nothing to worry about.”
war: Ngan kon makabati hini an Gobernador, kami na an labi nga maaram hin pagbaton ha iya ngan waray niyo sadang kabarak-an.”

en: So the soldiers took the money and did as they were told. And this report has spread throughout all Judea to this very day.
war: Ginkarawat han mga sondalo an kwarta, ngan ginbuhat nira an iginsugo ha ira. Amo ini nga sumat an iginpabantog han mga Judiyo tubtob ngada yana nga adlaw.

en: Now the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus told them to go.
war: Kinmadto ha Galilea an onse nga mga tinun-an, ha bukid nga ginpakadtoan ha ira ni Jesus.

en: When they saw him, they worshipped him, but some doubted.
war: Han pakakita nira ha iya, ginsingba hiya nira, bisan kon may-ada ha ira nagruhaduha.

en: Jesus came near and spoke to them, “ I’ve received all authority in heaven and on earth.
war: Hinmarani hi Jesus ngan ginsiring hira, “Iginhatag ha akon an ngatanan nga gahom ha langit ngan ha tuna.

en: Therefore, go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
war: Sanglit pakadto kamo ha ngatanan nga mga katawhan ha bug-os nga kalibutan ngan himoa niyo hira nga akon mga tinun-an. Bunyagi hira ha ngaran han Amay, ngan han Anak, ngan han Espiritu Santo,

en: teaching them to obey everything that I’ve commanded you. Look, I myself will be with you every day until the end of this present age. ”
war: ngan tutdoi hira hin pagtuman han ngatanan nga akon iginsugo ha iyo. Ngan hinumdomi! Dayuday ako maupod ha iyo ha ngatanan nga katuigan tubtob ha katapos han kalibutan.”

en: The beginning of the good news about Jesus Christ, God’s Son,
war: Amo ini an Maupay nga Sumat mahitungod kan Jesu-Cristo nga Anak han Dyos.

en: happened just as it was written about in the prophecy of Isaiah: Look, I am sending my messenger before you . He will prepare your way,
war: Nagtikang ini sumala han iginsurat ni Isaias nga manaragna: “Nagsiring an Dyos, ‘Iini an akon magsarangyaw, nga akon ipadadara hin pag-una ha imo, basi andamon niya an imo aagian.’

en: a voice shouting in the wilderness: “ Prepare the way for the Lord; make his paths straight .”
war: May-ada usa nga naggiginoliat ha kamingawan, ‘Andama an dalan para han Ginoo; ngan tadonga an iya aagian!’”

en: John the Baptist was in the wilderness calling for people to be baptized to show that they were changing their hearts and lives and wanted God to forgive their sins.
war: Pinmakita hi Juan didto ha kamingawan, diin namunyag hiya hin mga tawo ngan nagwali. Ginsiring niya an mga tawo, “Bayai an iyo mga sala ngan pabunyag kamo, ngan mapasaylo an Dyos ha iyo.”

en: Everyone in Judea and all the people of Jerusalem went out to the Jordan River and were being baptized by John as they confessed their sins.
war: Kinmadto an ngatanan nga mga tawo tikang ha katunaan han Judea ngan ha syudad han Jerusalem pamati kan Juan. Nagkompisal hira han ira mga sala ngan nabunyagan hira didto han Salog Jordan.

en: John wore clothes made of camel’s hair, with a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.
war: Hinimo hin buhok hin kamelyo an bado ni Juan, ngan anit an iya bakos ha hawak. Mga duron ug dugos ha kagurangan an pagkaon niya.

en: He announced, “One stronger than I am is coming after me. I’m not even worthy to bend over and loosen the strap of his sandals.
war: Ginsiring niya an mga tawo, “Labaw pa hin gahom ha akon an tawo nga masunod ha akon. Diri ngani ako takos maghubad han higot han iya mga sandalyas.

en: I baptize you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.”
war: Nagbubunyag ako ha iyo hin tubig, kundi magbubunyag hiya ha iyo han Espiritu Santo.”

en: About that time, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and John baptized him in the Jordan River.
war: Waray pag-iha, inmabot hi Jesus tikang ha Nazaret nga bungto ha Galilea, ngan ginbunyagan hiya ni Juan didto ha Salog han Jordan.

en: While he was coming up out of the water, Jesus saw heaven splitting open and the Spirit, like a dove, coming down on him.
war: Paghaw-as ni Jesus tikang ha tubig, kinmita hiya nga nabuksan an langit ngan kinmunsad an Espiritu Santo sugad hin sarapati.

en: And there was a voice from heaven: “You are my Son, whom I dearly love; in you I find happiness.”
war: Hinbatian in tingog tikang ha langit nga nasiring, “Ikaw an akon hinigugma nga Anak. Nalilipay gud ako ha imo.”

en: At once the Spirit forced Jesus out into the wilderness.
war: Ha gilayon hi Jesus ginpakadto han Espiritu ha kamingawan.

en: He was in the wilderness for forty days, tempted by Satan. He was among the wild animals, and the angels took care of him.
war: Nag-ukoy hiya didto hin 40 ka adlaw ngan didto ginsulay hiya ni Satanas. Didto hito nga dapit damo in ihalas nga kamanampan, kundi inmabot in mga anghel ngan nagtimangno ha iya.

en: After John was arrested, Jesus came into Galilee announcing God’s good news,
war: Han kabilanggo ni Juan, kinmadto hi Jesus ha Galilea ngan nagwali hiya didto han Maupay nga Sumat tikang sa Dyos.

en: saying, “ Now is the time! Here comes God’s kingdom! Change your hearts and lives, and trust this good news! ”
war: “Inmabot na an igo nga panahon,” nasiring hiya, “ngan haraniay na an Ginhadian han Dyos. Bayai an iyo mga sala ngan tuohi niyo an Maupay nga Sumat.”

en: As Jesus passed alongside the Galilee Sea, he saw two brothers, Simon and Andrew, throwing fishing nets into the sea, for they were fishermen.
war: Samtang nalabay hi Jesus ha tabi han Lanaw Galilea, hinkit-an niya in duha nga mangirisda, hi Simon ngan an iya bugto, hi Andres nga nagtutunod han ira pukot hin pagdakop hin isda.

en: “ Come, follow me, ” he said, “ and I’ll show you how to fish for people. ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Bunyog kamo ha akon ngan tututdoan ta kamo hin pangisda hin mga tawo.”

en: Right away, they left their nets and followed him.
war: Binayaan nira dayon an ira mga pukot ngan binmunyog hira kan Jesus.

en: After going a little farther, he saw James and John, Zebedee’s sons, in their boat repairing the fishing nets.
war: Nagtipaunhan hiya ngan hinkit-an niya in duha pa nga magbugto, hira Santiago ug Juan, an mga anak ni Sebedeo. Nakadto hira han sakayan, nag-aandam han ira mga pukot.

en: At that very moment he called them. They followed him, leaving their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired workers.
war: Pakakita ni Jesus ha ira, gintawag hira. Ginbayaan nira an ira amay, hi Sebedeo, nga nakadto ha sakayan upod in mga sinuholan nga mga tawo, ngan binmunyog hira kan Jesus.

en: Jesus and his followers went into Capernaum. Immediately on the Sabbath Jesus entered the synagogue and started teaching.
war: Inmabot hira ha bungto han Capernaum ngan han pagkasunod nga Adlaw nga Iparahuway, sinmakob hi Jesus han ira sinagoga ngan nagtikang hin pagtutdo.

en: The people were amazed by his teaching, for he was teaching them with authority, not like the legal experts.
war: Nahipausa an mga tawo han iya pagtutdo, kay diri man hiya sugad han mga magturutdo han Balaod ni Moises; lugod, an iya pagtutdo may-ada gahom.

en: Suddenly, there in the synagogue, a person with an evil spirit screamed,
war: Hito nga takna, sinmakob han sinagoga in tawo nga may maraot nga espiritu ngan ginmoliat,

en: “What have you to do with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are. You are the holy one from God.”
war: “Ano an imo karuyag buhaton ha amon, Jesus nga taga-Nazaret? Pupuohon mo ba kami? Nakilala ako kon hin-o ka: Ikaw an baraan nga sinugo han Dyos!”

en: “ Silence! ” Jesus said, speaking harshly to the demon. “ Come out of him! ”
war: Ginsaway ni Jesus an maraot nga espiritu, “Ayaw hin aringasa. Gawas dida hito nga tawo!”

en: The unclean spirit shook him and screamed, then it came out.
war: Binuntog an tawo, ginmoliat hin dako nga tingog, ngan ginmawas an maraot nga espiritu dida ha iya.

en: Everyone was shaken and questioned among themselves, “What’s this? A new teaching with authority! He even commands unclean spirits and they obey him!”
war: Nahipausa an ngatanan, ngan may hinsiring, “Ano ini nga nahinabo? Usa ba ini nga bag-o nga pagturon-an? May gahom ini nga tawo hin pagsugo han mga magraot nga espiritu ngan nasugot hira ha iya!”

en: Right away the news about him spread throughout the entire region of Galilee.
war: Nahisangyaw dayon ha bisan diin nga dapit han katunaan ha Galilea ini nga hinabo nga ginbuhat ni Jesus.

en: After leaving the synagogue, Jesus, James, and John went home with Simon and Andrew.
war: Ginmawas han sinagoga hira Jesus ug an iya mga tinun-an, upod hira Santiago ug Juan ngan nagpadayon hira ngadto han balay nira Simon ug Andres.

en: Simon’s mother-in-law was in bed, sick with a fever, and they told Jesus about her at once.
war: Nahigda an ugangan nga babaye ni Simon kay hinihirantan. Pag-abot ni Jesus, ginsumatan hiya mahitungod hini nga masakit.

en: He went to her, took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her, and she served them.
war: Gindaop ni Jesus an masakit, kinaptan an kamot, ngan binuligan niya hin pagbuhat. Nalungasan an masakit han iya hiranat ngan nagdurot ha ira hin pagkaon.

en: That evening, at sunset, people brought to Jesus those who were sick or demon-possessed.
war: Pagkagab-i, katunod na han adlaw, gindara han mga tawo ngadto kan Jesus an mga magsakit ngan an mga sinasangkayan hin yawa.

en: The whole town gathered near the door.
war: Nagtirok an mga tawo ha atubangan han balay.

en: He healed many who were sick with all kinds of diseases, and he threw out many demons. But he didn’t let the demons speak, because they recognized him.
war: Gintambal ni Jesus in damo kalain nga mga sakit ngan ginpagawas niya in damo nga mga yawa. Waray niya tugoti nga makagyakan an mga yawa, kay nakilala ini nga mga yawa kon hin-o hiya.

en: Early in the morning, well before sunrise, Jesus rose and went to a deserted place where he could be alone in prayer.
war: Han temprano pa han aga, han waray pa sisidlit an adlaw,, binmuhat hi Jesus ngan linmakat. Ginmawas hiya han bungto ngan kinmadto hin mamingaw nga dapit ngan didto nag-ampo hiya.

en: Simon and those with him tracked him down.
war: Kundi ginmawas liwat han bungto hi Simon ngan an iya mga kaurupod hin pamiling kan Jesus.

en: When they found him, they told him, “Everyone’s looking for you!”
war: Paghiagii nira ha iya, ginsiring nira hiya, “An mga tawo nagpipinamiling ha imo.”

en: He replied, “ Let’s head in the other direction, to the nearby villages, so that I can preach there too. That’s why I’ve come. ”
war: Kundi binmaton hi Jesus, “Pakadto kita ha iba nga mga baryo nga hiraniay dinhe hini nga dapit. Kinahanglan magwali liwat ako didto, kay amo ini an tuyo han akon pagkanhi.”

en: He traveled throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and throwing out demons.
war: Sanglit nagsudoy hiya han bug-os nga Galilea, nagwali hiya ha mga sinagoga ngan nagpagawas hiya hin mga yawa.

en: A man with a skin disease approached Jesus, fell to his knees, and begged, “If you want, you can make me clean.”
war: Dinmaop kan Jesus in usa nga sanlahon, linmuhod ha iya atubangan, ngan nakimalooy nga buligan hiya. “Kon imo karuyag,” nagsiring an sanlahon, “makakalinis ka ha akon.”

en: Incensed, Jesus reached out his hand, touched him, and said, “ I do want to. Be clean. ”
war: Nalooy hi Jesus ha iya. Gindun-an hiya ni Jesus ngan sidngon, “Karuyag ko. Magmalinis ka!”

en: Instantly, the skin disease left him, and he was clean.
war: Nakuha dayon an sanla ngan naupay an tawo.

en: Sternly, Jesus sent him away,
war: Ginpaoli hiya upod an hugot nga pagtugon ha iya,

en: saying, “ Don’t say anything to anyone. Instead, go and show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifice for your cleansing that Moses commanded. This will be a testimony to them. ”
war: “Pamati, ayaw pagsumat bisan kan kanay. Pakadto dayon ha padi ngan pakita ha iya; kahuman, paghalad sugad han sugo ni Moises basi hisabtan nga upay ka na.”

en: Instead, he went out and started talking freely and spreading the news so that Jesus wasn’t able to enter a town openly. He remained outside in deserted places, but people came to him from everywhere.
war: Linmakat an tawo ngan iginpasarang ini nga hinabo ha ngatanan nga dapit. Ha pagkamatuod damo an nahibaro; sanglit makuri na hi Jesus makasakob hin dayag han bungto; lugod, didto hiya hin mamingaw nga mga dapit ngan an mga tawo na la tikang ha magkalainlain nga dapit an napakadto ha iya.

en: After a few days, Jesus went back to Capernaum, and people heard that he was at home.
war: Paglabay hin pira ka adlaw, binmalik hi Jesus ha Capernaum ngan nahibantog nga inmoli na hiya.

en: So many gathered that there was no longer space, not even near the door. Jesus was speaking the word to them.
war: Damo in mga tawo nga kinmadto, sanglit napuno an balay, bisan pa ngani an bungasaran ha atubangan han portahan. Han nagwawali hi Jesus ha ira,

en: Some people arrived, and four of them were bringing to him a man who was paralyzed.
war: gindara ngada ha iya in usa nga lulid nga ginpasag hin upat ka tawo.

en: They couldn’t carry him through the crowd, so they tore off part of the roof above where Jesus was. When they had made an opening, they lowered the mat on which the paralyzed man was lying.
war: Tungod han kadamo han mga tawo, waray hira makahirani kan Jesus. Sanglit gin-ukban nira an atop nga tungod ni Jesus. Ira gintonton tikang ha atop an lulid nga nakada ha iya higdaan.

en: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, “ Child, your sins are forgiven! ”
war: Nakasabot hi Jesus han ira dako nga pagtoo, ngan ginsiring niya an lulid, “Anak, ginpasaylo na an imo mga sala.”

en: Some legal experts were sitting there, muttering among themselves,
war: May-ada mga magturutdo han Balaod nga nagkakalingkod didto nga nagsiring ha ira ngahaw,

en: “Why does he speak this way? He’s insulting God. Only the one God can forgive sins.”
war: “Kay ano nga ginmahom man hiya pagyakan hin sugad hini? Usa ini nga pagpanamastamas han Dyos? Waray tawo nga makakapasaylo hin sala; an Dyos la in makakahimo.”

en: Jesus immediately recognized what they were discussing, and he said to them, “ Why do you fill your minds with these questions?
war: Nakasabot dayon hi Jesus han ira mga ginhuhunahuna. Sanglit nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Kay ano nga nakahunahuna man kamo hin sugad?

en: Which is easier—to say to a paralyzed person, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, take up your bed, and walk’?
war: Hain in masarosayon: an pagsiring ngada hini nga lulid, ‘An imo sala ginpasaylo,’ kon an pagsiring, ‘Buhat, dad-a an imo higdaan ngan lakat?’

en: But so you will know that the Human One has authority on the earth to forgive sins ” —he said to the man who was paralyzed,
war: Ipapakita ko ha iyo nga may gahom dinhe ha tuna an Anak han Tawo hin pagpasaylo han mga sala.” Sanglit ginsiring niya an lulid,

en: “ Get up, take your mat, and go home. ”
war: “Nasiring ako ha imo, buhat, dad-a an imo higdaan ngan uli ha iyo balay!”

en: Jesus raised him up, and right away he picked up his mat and walked out in front of everybody. They were all amazed and praised God, saying, “We’ve never seen anything like this!”
war: Ha atubangan han mga tawo, binmuhat an lulid, gindara an iya higdaan, ngan linmakat dayon. Nahipausa hira ngatanan, ngan nagdayaw hira han Dyos hin pagsiring, “Waray pa kami kumita hin sugad hini nga hinabo!”

en: Jesus went out beside the lake again. The whole crowd came to him, and he began to teach them.
war: Binmalik hi Jesus ngadto ha baybayon han Lanaw Galilea. Dinmaop in mga tawo ha iya ngan nagtikang hiya hin pagtutdo ha ira.

en: As he continued along, he saw Levi, Alphaeus’ son, sitting at a kiosk for collecting taxes. Jesus said to him, “ Follow me. ” Levi got up and followed him.
war: Samtang naglalakat hiya, nakita niya in usa nga parasukot hin buhis, hi Levi, nga anak ni Alfeo, nga nalingkod didto han iya buhatan. Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Sunod ha akon.” Binmuhat hi Levi nga sinmunod kan Jesus.

en: Jesus sat down to eat at Levi’s house. Many tax collectors and sinners were eating with Jesus and his disciples. Indeed, many of them had become his followers.
war: Tinmangka hi Jesus hin pagkaon didto han balay ni Levi. Damo an mga parasukot hin buhis ngan mga tinamay nga nagsunodsunod kan Jesus. Damo ha ira in nakigsaro ha iya ngan han iya mga tinun-an.

en: When some of the legal experts from among the Pharisees saw that he was eating with sinners and tax collectors, they asked his disciples, “Why is he eating with sinners and tax collectors?”
war: Pinmakiana hira han mga tinun-an ni Jesus, “Kay ano nga nakikigsaro man hiya han mga parasukot hin buhis ngan han mga tinamay?”

en: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “ Healthy people don’t need a doctor, but sick people do. I didn’t come to call righteous people, but sinners. ”
war: Nakabati hi Jesus ha ira ngan ginbaton hira niya, “Diri nagkikinahanglan hin magtarambal an waray sakit nga tawo, kundi adton may-ada la sakit. Waray ako makanhi hin pagtawag hadton mga magtadong, kundi hadton mga magpakasasala.”

en: John’s disciples and the Pharisees had a habit of fasting. Some people asked Jesus, “Why do John’s disciples and the Pharisees’ disciples fast, but yours don’t?”
war: Ha usa ka higayon, nagpuasa an mga tinun-an ni Juan nga Parabunyag ngan an mga Parisiyo. May-ada mga tawo nga kinmadto kan Jesus ngan pinmakiana ha iya, “Kay ano nga nagpupuasa an mga tinun-an ni Juan nga Parabunyag ngan an mga Parisiyo, kundi diri man an imo mga tinun-an?”

en: Jesus said, “The wedding guests can’t fast while the groom is with them, can they? As long as they have the groom with them, they can’t fast.
war: Nagbaton hi Jesus, “Matugot ba kamo nga diri mangaon an mga dinapit ngadto hin pakasal? Maaram ako nga diri kamo matugot. Samtang nga upod pa an kinasal ha ira, mangangaon manta hira.

en: But the days will come when the groom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.
war: Kundi maabot an panahon nga mabaya ha ira an kinasal; ngan amo na an ira diri pagkaon.

en: “ No one sews a piece of new, unshrunk cloth on old clothes; otherwise, the patch tears away from it, the new from the old, and makes a worse tear.
war: “Waray tawo nga nagamit hin bag-o nga dugnit hin pagtangkop hin daan nga bado. Kay kon iya ini buhaton, magigisi an dumog nga bado ngan mahiluag an tarangkopan.

en: No one pours new wine into old leather wineskins; otherwise, the wine would burst the wineskins and the wine would be lost and the wineskins destroyed. But new wine is for new wineskins. ”
war: Waray liwat naipis hin bag-o nga bino ngada hin daan na nga anit nga surudlan. Kon iya ini buhaton, mabuburit an surudlan kay magigisi an anit ngan makakarag an bino.”

en: Jesus went through the wheat fields on the Sabbath. As the disciples made their way, they were picking the heads of wheat.
war: Nahinabo nga naglatas hi Jesus ha kaumhan hin trigo ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway. Samtang naglalakat hira, nangutos hin mga uhay an mga tinun-an nga upod niya.

en: The Pharisees said to Jesus, “Look! Why are they breaking the Sabbath law?”
war: Nagsiring an mga Parisiyo kan Jesus, “Diri tugot han aton Balaod nga mangutos an imo mga tinun-an ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway.”

en: He said to them, “ Haven’t you ever read what David did when he was in need, when he and those with him were hungry?
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Waray ba kamo makabati han ginbuhat ni David han nagkikinahanglan hiya hin pagkaon? Ginutom hi David ngan an iya mga sakop;

en: During the time when Abiathar was high priest, David went into God’s house and ate the bread of the presence, which only the priests were allowed to eat. He also gave bread to those who were with him. ”
war: sanglit, sinmulod hiya han balay han Dyos ngan kinmaon han tinapay nga iginhalad ha Dyos. Nahinabo ini ha panahon nga hi Abiatar amo an Labaw nga padi. Subay han aton Balaod, an makakakaon la hini nga tinapay amo an mga padi, kundi kinmaon hi David ngan tinagan niya an iya mga sakop.”

en: Then he said, “ The Sabbath was created for humans; humans weren’t created for the Sabbath.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Ginhimo an Adlaw nga Iparahuway tungod han tawo; diri an tawo tungod han Adlaw nga Iparahuway.

en: This is why the Human One is Lord even over the Sabbath. ”
war: Sanglit an Anak han Tawo Ginoo bisan han Adlaw nga Iparahuway.”

en: Jesus returned to the synagogue. A man with a withered hand was there.
war: Binmalik hi Jesus ngadto ha sinagoga diin nakadto in tawo nga patay an kamot.

en: Wanting to bring charges against Jesus, they were watching Jesus closely to see if he would heal on the Sabbath.
war: May-ada didto mga tawo nga karuyag magbutangbutang hin sayop kan Jesus, sanglit nag-inaw hira kon magtambal ba hiya ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway.

en: He said to the man with the withered hand, “ Step up where people can see you. ”
war: Ginsiring ni Jesus an tawo nga patay an kamot, “Pakadi ha atubangan.”

en: Then he said to them, “ Is it legal on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil, to save life or to kill? ” But they said nothing.
war: Pinmakiana hi Jesus han mga tawo, “Ano an tugot han aton Balaod nga sadang buhaton ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway? Pagbulig ba, o pagdaot? Pagtalwas ba hin kinabuhi, o pagkuha ba hin kinabuhi?” Kundi waray hira mag-aringasa.

en: Looking around at them with anger, deeply grieved at their unyielding hearts, he said to the man, “ Stretch out your hand. ” So he did, and his hand was made healthy.
war: Nangalas hi Jesus han pagkita niya hini nga mga tawo, kundi inalpan hiya hin kalooy tungod han katig-a han ira kasingkasing ngan kasayop nira. Ginsiring niya an tawo, “Unata an imo kamot.” Gin-unat han tawo an iya kamot ngan naupay.

en: At that, the Pharisees got together with the supporters of Herod to plan how to destroy Jesus.
war: Sanglit ginmawas an mga Parisiyo han sinagoga, ngan nakigkita dayon han iba nga mga kaapi han hugpo ni Herodes. Ngan nagkasarabot hira hin pagpatay kan Jesus.

en: Jesus left with his disciples and went to the lake. A large crowd followed him because they had heard what he was doing. They were from Galilee,
war: Kinmadto hi Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an ha lanaw han Galilea. Binmunyog ha iya in damo nga mga tawo nga tikang ha Galilea, ha Judea,

en: Judea, Jerusalem, Idumea, beyond the Jordan, and the area surrounding Tyre and Sidon.
war: ha Jerusalem, ha tuna han Idumea, ha tuna tabok han Jordan ngan ha mga higrani nga dapit han mga bungto han Tiro ug Sidon. Nagsinunod kan Jesus ini nga mga tawo kay nakabati hira han mga ginbuhat niya.

en: Jesus told his disciples to get a small boat ready for him so the crowd wouldn’t crush him.
war: Damo kaupay an mga tawo, sanglit ginsugo niya an iya mga tinun-an nga mag-andam hin sakayan basi diri hiya mapiit han mga tawo.

en: He had healed so many people that everyone who was sick pushed forward so that they could touch him.
war: Damo an iya mga gintambal, sanglit nagpirit gud an mga magsakit nga makaduok kan Jesus, basi la makakamkam ha iya.

en: Whenever the evil spirits saw him, they fell down at his feet and shouted, “You are God’s Son!”
war: Nahapa ha iya atubangan an mga tawo nga sinasangkayan hin yawa kon nakita ha iya, ngan nagoliat, “Ikaw an Anak han Dyos!”

en: But he strictly ordered them not to reveal who he was.
war: Gintugon hin maupay ni Jesus an mga yawa nga diri magsumat kon hin-o hiya.

en: Jesus went up on a mountain and called those he wanted, and they came to him.
war: Sinmagka hi Jesus hin pungtod ngan ginpadaop niya an mga kalalaken-an nga kinaruyag niya. Dinmaop hira

en: He appointed twelve and called them apostles. He appointed them to be with him, to be sent out to preach,
war: ngan nagpili hiya hin dose nga iya ginngaranan nga mga apostoles. “Ginpili ko kamo basi umupod kamo ha akon,” nagsiring hiya, “ngan susugoon ko kamo hin pagwali

en: and to have authority to throw out demons.
war: ngan tatagan ko kamo hin gahom hin pagpaiwas hin mga yawa.”

en: He appointed twelve: Peter, a name he gave Simon;
war: Amo ini an dose nga ginpili niya: hi Simon (ginngaranan hiya ni Jesus nga Pedro);

en: James and John, Zebedee’s sons, whom he nicknamed Boanerges, which means “sons of Thunder”;
war: hi Santiago ngan an iya bugto, hi Juan, mga anak ni Sebedeo (ginngaranan hira ni Jesus nga “Boanerges,” an karuyag sidngon, “Mga Tawo hin Dalugdog”);

en: and Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, Alphaeus’ son; Thaddaeus; Simon the Cananaean;
war: hira Andres, Felipe, Bartolome, Mateo, Tomas, Santiago nga anak ni Alfeo, Tadeo, Simon, an bayani,

en: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus.
war: ngan hi Judas Iscariote nga naglingo kan Jesus.

en: Jesus entered a house. A crowd gathered again so that it was impossible for him and his followers even to eat.
war: Inmuli hi Jesus ngan gin-alirongan na liwat hiya hin damo nga mga tawo nga waray na ngani hiya ngan an iya mga tinun-an panahon hin pagkaon.

en: When his family heard what was happening, they came to take control of him. They were saying, “He’s out of his mind!”
war: Pakabati han iya kauropdan mahitungod hini, kinmadto hira hin pagkuha ha iya, kay nasumatan hira nga nawad-an na hiya hin maupay nga panmurubuot.

en: The legal experts came down from Jerusalem. Over and over they charged, “He’s possessed by Beelzebul. He throws out demons with the authority of the ruler of demons.”
war: May-ada mga magturutdo han Balaod nga tikang ha Jerusalem nga nagsiring: “Hinkakaptan hiya ni Beelsebul!” Nagsiring an iba, “Naghatag ha iya hin gahom an puno hin mga yawa hin pagpagawas ha ira.”

en: When Jesus called them together he spoke to them in a parable: “ How can Satan throw Satan out?
war: Sanglit gintawag ni Jesus an mga tawo ngan nagsumat hiya hin mga pananglitan: “Uunanhon man ni Satanas hin pagpaiwas ha iya ngahaw?

en: A kingdom involved in civil war will collapse.
war: Kon magkabahinbahin in usa nga nasod ngan mag-aruaraway hira, mapupukan ito nga nasod.

en: And a house torn apart by divisions will collapse.
war: Kon makabahinbahin in usa nga panimalay ngan mag-aruaraway hira, mabubungkag ito nga panimalay.

en: If Satan rebels against himself and is divided, then he can’t endure. He’s done for.
war: Sanglit kon magkabahinbahin an ginhadian ni Satanas, diri ito mag-iiha, kundi mabubungkag ngan mapupukan.

en: No one gets into the house of a strong person and steals anything without first tying up the strong person. Only then can the house be burglarized.
war: “Waray makakasulod hin balay hin kusgan nga tawo hin pangawat, kon diri anay niya gaposon an kusgan nga tawo. Kon magapos na niya, amo na an pakapangawat niya.

en: I assure you that human beings will be forgiven for everything, for all sins and insults of every kind.
war: “Tigamni ini niyo: Mapapasaylo an mga tawo han ira mga sala ngan han magraot nga ira mga ginyakan.

en: But whoever insults the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven. That person is guilty of a sin with consequences that last forever. ”
war: Kundi diri mapapasaylo an tawo nga magpasipara hin pagyakan supak han Espiritu Santo.” (

en: He said this because the legal experts were saying, “He’s possessed by an evil spirit.”
war: Ginyakan ini ni Jesus kay may-ada nasiring nga may-ada hiya maraot nga espiritu.)

en: His mother and brothers arrived. They stood outside and sent word to him, calling for him.
war: Inmabot an iroy ni Jesus ngan an iya kabugtoan. Waray hira sumakob han balay, kundi nagpatugon la hira nga may-ada tuyo nira ha iya.

en: A crowd was seated around him, and those sent to him said, “Look, your mother, brothers, and sisters are outside looking for you.”
war: Nabubutnga hi Jesus hin mga nagkakalingkod nga mga tawo, ngan nagsiring hira ha iya, “Aadto ha gawas an iroy ngan kabugtoan mo, may-ada tuyo ha imo.”

en: He replied, “ Who is my mother? Who are my brothers? ”
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Hin-o an akon iroy? Hin-o an akon kabugtoan?”

en: Looking around at those seated around him in a circle, he said, “ Look, here are my mother and my brothers.
war: Sinmiplat hiya han mga nagkakalingkod nga mga tawo nga naglilibot ha iya ngan nagsiring, “Amo ini an akon iroy ngan an akon kabugtoan.

en: Whoever does God’s will is my brother, sister, and mother. ”
war: Akon kabugtoan ngan akon iroy an bisan hin-o nga nagtutuman han iginpapabuhat ha iya han Dyos.”

en: Jesus began to teach beside the lake again. Such a large crowd gathered that he climbed into a boat there on the lake. He sat in the boat while the whole crowd was nearby on the shore.
war: Nagtikang liwat hi Jesus hin pagtutdo didto ha tabi han Lanaw han Galilea. Damo kaupay an mga tawo nga nag-alirong ha iya; sanglit sinmakay hiya hin sakayan ngan linmingkod hiya. Nakadto ha dagat an sakayan ngan nagkakatukdaw an mga tawo didto ha tabi.

en: He said many things to them in parables. While teaching them, he said,
war: Damo an igintutdo niya pinaagi hin mga pananglitan. Dida han iya pagtutdo nagsiring hiya ha ira:

en: “ Listen to this! A farmer went out to scatter seed.
war: “Pamati kamo! May-ada tawo nga kinmadto han iya uma hin pagsabod.

en: As he was scattering seed, some fell on the path; and the birds came and ate it.
war: Han nagsasabod hiya, may mga binhe nga nagkataktak ha dalan ngan pinanuktok han mga tamsi.

en: Other seed fell on rocky ground where the soil was shallow. They sprouted immediately because the soil wasn’t deep.
war: May-ada nahulog ngada hin batoon nga tuna. Tinmurok gad an binhe kay may-ada man manipis nga tuna.

en: When the sun came up, it scorched the plants; and they dried up because they had no roots.
