war: Kundi han pagsirak han adlaw, nalaya an mga tanom kay waray makagamot hin maupay, ngan nagkauuga.

en: Other seed fell among thorny plants. The thorny plants grew and choked the seeds, and they produced nothing.
war: May mga binhe nga nahulog ha mga tunokon nga kabanwaan. Han pagtubo han kabanwaan, naambongan an mga tanom; sanglit waray mamunga.

en: Other seed fell into good soil and bore fruit. Upon growing and increasing, the seed produced in one case a yield of thirty to one, in another case a yield of sixty to one, and in another case a yield of one hundred to one. ”
war: Kundi may mga binhe nga nahulog ha maupay nga tuna. Tinmurok an binhe, tinmubo ngan namunga: may-ada namunga hin 30 ka pilo, 60 ka pilo an iba, ngan 100 ka pilo an iba liwat.”

en: He said, “ Whoever has ears to listen should pay attention! ”
war: Ngan nagsiring hi Jesus, “Kon hin-o ha iyo an may durunggan, mamati hin maupay!”

en: When they were alone, the people around Jesus, along with the Twelve, asked him about the parables.
war: Han nag-uusaan na la hi Jesus, dinmaop ha iya adton iba nga nakabati ha iya upod an dose nga mga tinun-an, ngan naghangyo nga igsaysay niya an mga pananglitan.

en: He said to them, “The secret of God’s kingdom has been given to you, but to those who are outside everything comes in parables.
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Iginhatag ha iyo an pakasabot han mga natatago nga butang han Ginhadian han Dyos; kundi nakakasabot la adton diri kausa niyo pinaagi hin mga pananglitan,

en: This is so that they can look and see but have no insight, and they can hear but not understand. Otherwise, they might turn their lives around and be forgiven.
war: basi ‘Ha ira paniguro hin pagkita, diri lugod hira nakakakita, ha ira paniguro hin pamati, diri lugod hira makakasabot; kay kon makahimo hira, bangin hira bumalik sa Dyos ngan pasasayloon hira niya.’”

en: “ Don’t you understand this parable? Then how will you understand all the parables?
war: Ngan nagpakiana hi Jesus ha ira, “Diri ba kamo nakakasabot hini nga pananglitan? Uunanhon man ngay-an niyo hin pakasabot hin bisan ano nga pananglitan?

en: The farmer scatters the word.
war: An magsarabod nagsabod han mensahe han Dyos.

en: This is the meaning of the seed that fell on the path: When the word is scattered and people hear it, right away Satan comes and steals the word that was planted in them.
war: May-ada mga tawo nga sugad han mga binhe nga nahulog ha dalan. Pakakabati nira han mensahe, naabot dayon hi Satanas ngan inaagaw an mensahe ha ira.

en: Here’s the meaning of the seed that fell on rocky ground: When people hear the word, they immediately receive it joyfully.
war: An iba nga mga tawo sugad hin mga binhe nga nataktak ha batoon nga tuna. Pakakabati nira han mensahe, kinakarawat dayon nira nga malipayon.

en: Because they have no roots, they last for only a little while. When they experience distress or abuse because of the word, they immediately fall away.
war: Kundi diri gud napabilin ha ira kasingkasing, ngan diri nag-iiha. Sanglit kon naabot in kakurian ngan pag-antos tungod han mensahe, nabaya hira dayon.

en: Others are like the seed scattered among the thorny plants. These are the ones who have heard the word;
war: An iba nga mga tawo sugad hin mga binhe nga ginsabod dida hin tunokon nga kabanwaan. Nakakabati ini hira han mensahe,

en: but the worries of this life, the false appeal of wealth, and the desire for more things break in and choke the word, and it bears no fruit.
war: kundi natatabonan an mensahe han mga kabaraka hiunong hin nga kinabuhi, an paghigugma han manggad, ngan an iba nga mga karuyagon, sanglit diri nakakabunga.

en: The seed scattered on good soil are those who hear the word and embrace it. They bear fruit, in one case a yield of thirty to one, in another case sixty to one, and in another case one hundred to one. ”
war: Kundi an iba nga mga tawo sugad hin mga binhe nga ginsabod ha maupay nga tuna. Namamati hira han pulong, ira kinakarawat ngan namumunga. May-ada nabunga hin 30 ka pilo, an iba 60 ka pilo, ngan an iba na man, 100 ka pilo.”

en: Jesus said to them, “ Does anyone bring in a lamp in order to put it under a basket or a bed? Shouldn’t it be placed on a lampstand?
war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus, “Kon may-ada nagdadara hin suga, tinatakloban ba niya ini, o ibinubutang ba ha sirong hin higdaan? Diri ba ikinakadto ha iya burutangan?

en: Everything hidden will be revealed, and everything secret will come out into the open.
war: Ipadadayag an natatago; bubuksan an natatahoban.

en: Whoever has ears to listen should pay attention! ”
war: Kon hin-o an may mga durunggan, mamati hin maupay!”

en: He said to them, “ Listen carefully! God will evaluate you with the same standard you use to evaluate others. Indeed, you will receive even more.
war: Nagsiring pa hiya ha ira, “Tigamni an iyo hinbabatian. An amo ngahaw nga mga lagda nga ginagamit niyo hin paghukom han iba, amo man an gagamiton han Dyos hin paghukom ha iyo, ngan bangin labaw pa hin kamakuri.

en: Those who have will receive more, but as for those who don’t have, even what they don’t have will be taken away from them. ”
war: Tatagan pa adton may-ada na; kukuhaan adton waray, bisan han gutiay nga aada ha iya.”

en: Then Jesus said, “ This is what God’s kingdom is like. It’s as though someone scatters seed on the ground,
war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus hin pagsiring: “Alid-agid an Ginhadian han Dyos hin tawo nga nagsabod hin binhe ha iya uma.

en: then sleeps and wakes night and day. The seed sprouts and grows, but the farmer doesn’t know how.
war: Kahuman niya pagsabod han binhe, nagpapadayon hiya han iya ikina-adlaw nga mga buruhaton, samtang naturok ngan natubo an binhe. Kundi diri hiya maaram kon ano an kasugad hini.

en: The earth produces crops all by itself, first the stalk, then the head, then the full head of grain.
war: An tuna ngahaw an nakakapatubo ngan nakakapabunga: syahan, nananahon; niyan, namumukad; kahuman, namumunga.

en: Whenever the crop is ready, the farmer goes out to cut the grain because it’s harvesttime. ”
war: Kon hinog na an bunga, gin-aani han tag-iya, kay inmabot na an takna hin panguha.

en: He continued, “ What’s a good image for God’s kingdom? What parable can I use to explain it?
war: “Ano ba an aton ikatatanding han Ginhadian han Dyos?” nagpakiana hi Jesus. “Ano nga pananglitan an sadang naton gamiton hin pagsaysay hini?

en: Consider a mustard seed. When scattered on the ground, it’s the smallest of all the seeds on the earth;
war: Amo ini nga pananglitan: Usa ka tawo nagtanom ha tuna hin liso hin mustasa, an gigugutiayi nga liso dinhe ha tuna.

en: but when it’s planted, it grows and becomes the largest of all vegetable plants. It produces such large branches that the birds in the sky are able to nest in its shade. ”
war: Natubo ini ngan nahihimo nga gidadakoi nga kahoy. Narampag an iya mga sanga ngan nahapon an katamsihan ngan dito nagsasalag.”

en: With many such parables he continued to give them the word, as much as they were able to hear.
war: Nagwali hi Jesus ha mga tawo pinaagi hin alid-agid hini nga mga pananglitan. Ginsumatan niya hira sugad han ira hinsasabotan.

en: He spoke to them only in parables, then explained everything to his disciples when he was alone with them.
war: Waray gud hiya magyakan ha ira kon diri pinaagi hin mga pananglitan; kundi kon an iya mga tinun-an la an iya kahimangraw, iya iginsasaysay an ngatanan ha ira.

en: Later that day, when evening came, Jesus said to them, “ Let’s cross over to the other side of the lake. ”
war: Han pagkagab-i hito manta nga adlaw, nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Talabok kita ngadto ha luyo han lanaw.”

en: They left the crowd and took him in the boat just as he was. Other boats followed along.
war: Sanglit binayaan nira an kadam-an nga mga tawo. Sinmakay han sakayan an mga tinun-an diin nakadto na hi Jesus, ngan tinmalabok hira. May iba nga mga sakayan didto.

en: Gale-force winds arose, and waves crashed against the boat so that the boat was swamped.
war: Inmabot in makusog nga alipuros ngan ginsasakayan na an ira sakayan hin mga balod nga haros mapuno na hin tubig an sakayan.

en: But Jesus was in the rear of the boat, sleeping on a pillow. They woke him up and said, “Teacher, don’t you care that we’re drowning?”
war: Nakaturog hi Jesus didto ha may ulin; nakakaulon hiya ha iya paghigda. Ginpukaw hiya han mga tinun-an, “Magturutdo, diri ka ba nababaraka nga magkakamatay na kita?”

en: He got up and gave orders to the wind, and he said to the lake, “ Silence! Be still! ” The wind settled down and there was a great calm.
war: Binmuhat hi Jesus ngan ginsaway niya an hangin, “Hugpoy na!” ngan an mga balod, “Pagmalinaw kamo!” Hinmugpoy an hangin ngan nagmalinaw.

en: Jesus asked them, “ Why are you frightened? Don’t you have faith yet? ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Kay ano nga nahahadlok man kamo? Waray la gihapon kamo pagtoo?”

en: Overcome with awe, they said to each other, “Who then is this? Even the wind and the sea obey him!”
war: Kundi duro gud an ira paghipausa, ngan may hinsiring ha ira: “Hin-o ini nga tawo nga nasugot man ha iya bisan an hangin ngan an mga balod?”

en: Jesus and his disciples came to the other side of the lake, to the region of the Gerasenes.
war: Inmabot hira ha tabok han Lanaw han Galilea, didto han tuna han mga taga-Gadara.

en: As soon as Jesus got out of the boat, a man possessed by an evil spirit came out of the tombs.
war: Han paghaw-as gud la ni Jesus han sakayan, gintapo hiya hin tawo nga tikang ha mga lungib nga lubnganan.

en: This man lived among the tombs, and no one was ever strong enough to restrain him, even with a chain.
war: May-ada ini nga tawo maraot nga espiritu, ngan didto hiya pag-iinukoy han mga lubnganan. Waray na gud nakakagapos ha iya hin kadena.

en: He had been secured many times with leg irons and chains, but he broke the chains and smashed the leg irons. No one was tough enough to control him.
war: Makadamo na gaposa an iya mga kamot ngan mga tiil, kundi nauutod la an mga kadena ha kamot ngan an pandog ha iya tiil. Makusog hiya hin duro nga waray gud nakakahawid ha iya.

en: Night and day in the tombs and the hills, he would howl and cut himself with stones.
war: Adlaw gab-i nagsusudoysudoy hiya han mga linubngan ngan han mga pungtod, naggiginoliat ngan nag-uunay hin pagsamad ha iya ngahaw pinaagi han mga bato.

en: When he saw Jesus from far away, he ran and knelt before him,
war: Tay-aw hiya han pakakita niya kan Jesus. Sanglit dinmalagan hiya, hinmapa ha atubangan ni Jesus,

en: shouting, “What have you to do with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? Swear to God that you won’t torture me!”
war: ngan ginmoliat hin dako nga tingog: “Jesus, Anak han Gilalabawi nga Dyos! Ano an imo karuyag buhaton ha akon? Nakikimalooy ako ha imo, ayaw ako pagkastigoha!” (

en: He said this because Jesus had already commanded him, “ Unclean spirit, come out of the man! ”
war: Ginyakan ini niya kay nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya: “Maraot nga espiritu, gawas dida hini nga tawo!”)

en: Jesus asked him, “ What is your name? ” He responded, “Legion is my name, because we are many.”
war: Sanglit ginpakianhan hiya ni Jesus, “Hin-o an imo ngaran?” Binmaton an tawo, “‘Panon’ an akon ngaran, kay damo kami.”

en: They pleaded with Jesus not to send them out of that region.
war: Waray hiya humunong pakimalooy kan Jesus nga diri pagawson an maraot nga mga espiritu dida hito nga tuna.

en: A large herd of pigs was feeding on the hillside.
war: May-ada dako nga panon hin kababoyan nga naniningaon dida hin hirani nga pungtod.

en: “Send us into the pigs!” they begged. “Let us go into the pigs!”
war: Naghangyo kan Jesus an magraot nga mga espiritu, “Pasudla kami ngadto han kababoyan.”

en: Jesus gave them permission, so the unclean spirits left the man and went into the pigs. Then the herd of about two thousand pigs rushed down the cliff into the lake and drowned.
war: Gintugotan hira ni Jesus. Ginmawas han tawo an maraot nga mga espiritu ngan kinmadto han kababoyan. May mga duha ka yukot an mga baboy nga nandadlagan ngadto han umpas; nahulog ngadto han lanaw ngan nagkalulumos.

en: Those who tended the pigs ran away and told the story in the city and in the countryside. People came to see what had happened.
war: Nandadlagan dayon an magmarangno han kababoyan ngadto ha bungto ngan kaumhan hin pagsumat han nahinabo. Kinmadto an mga tawo pagkita han nahinabo.

en: They came to Jesus and saw the man who used to be demon-possessed. They saw the very man who had been filled with many demons sitting there fully dressed and completely sane, and they were filled with awe.
war: Dinmaop hira kan Jesus ngan kinmita hira han tawo nga may-ada anay mga yawa. Nalingkod hiya, diri na lubas ngan maupay na igkahimangraw. Ngan nahadlok hira ngatanan.

en: Those who had actually seen what had happened to the demon-possessed man told the others about the pigs.
war: Nagsumat han mga tawo adton nakakita kon ano an nahinabo han tawo nga sinangkayan hin yawa ngan han kababoyan.

en: Then they pleaded with Jesus to leave their region.
war: Sanglit ginhangyo nira hi Jesus nga gumawas han ira tuna.

en: While he was climbing into the boat, the one who had been demon-possessed pleaded with Jesus to let him come along as one of his disciples.
war: Han naisarakay na hi Jesus, nakimalooy an tawo nga iniwasan hin mga yawa, nga paupdon hiya.

en: But Jesus wouldn’t allow it. “ Go home to your own people, ” Jesus said, “ and tell them what the Lord has done for you and how he has shown you mercy. ”
war: Kundi waray tumugot hi Jesus. Lugod, ginsiring hiya ni Jesus, “Uli ngadto ha imo panimalay ngan sumati hira han ginbuhat ha imo han Ginoo ngan han iya kalooy ha imo.”

en: The man went away and began to proclaim in the Ten Cities all that Jesus had done for him, and everyone was amazed.
war: Inmoli an tawo ngan nagsudoy hiya han Decapolis nga nagsinumat han ginbuhat ni Jesus ha iya. Dako an paghipausa hadton nagpakabati ha iya.

en: Jesus crossed the lake again, and on the other side a large crowd gathered around him on the shore.
war: Binmalik hi Jesus ngadto ha tabok han lanaw. Nag-alirong ha iya in damo nga mga tawo didto ha ligid han lanaw.

en: Jairus, one of the synagogue leaders, came forward. When he saw Jesus, he fell at his feet
war: Dinmaop ha iya hi Jairo, usa nga tinaporan han sinagoga. Pakakita niya kan Jesus hinmapa hiya

en: and pleaded with him, “My daughter is about to die. Please, come and place your hands on her so that she can be healed and live.”
war: ngan duro an iya pakimalooy ha iya hin pagsiring, “Masakit hin duro an akon anak nga babayehay. Kadtoa gud ngan ipadapat an imo kamot ha iya basi maupay hiya ngan diri mamatay!”

en: So Jesus went with him. A swarm of people were following Jesus, crowding in on him.
war: Ngan inmupod hi Jesus ha iya. Damo liwat nga mga tawo an binmunyog kan Jesus ngan gindadaisog hiya han mga tawo.

en: A woman was there who had been bleeding for twelve years.
war: May-ada babaye nga makalilisang na an gin-antos tungod hin duro nga pagdinugoi ha iya hin dose na ka tuig,

en: She had suffered a lot under the care of many doctors, and had spent everything she had without getting any better. In fact, she had gotten worse.
war: bisan kon damo na in nagtambal ha iya. Naubos na an iya kwarta, kundi waray hiya mag-upay; magtikadugang la lugod an iya sakit.

en: Because she had heard about Jesus, she came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.
war: Nasumatan hiya mahitungod kan Jesus; sanglit nagpirit hiya hin pagtampo han kadam-an, ngan pinmaluyo hiya kan Jesus.

en: She was thinking, If I can just touch his clothes, I’ll be healed.
war: Nagsiring hiya ha iya ngahaw, “Kon makakapot la ako bisan la han iya bado, mauupay gud ako.”

en: Her bleeding stopped immediately, and she sensed in her body that her illness had been healed.
war: Kinaptan niya an bado ni Jesus, ngan inmukoy dayon an pagdinugoi ha iya; inabat niya nga naupay hiya han iya sakit.

en: At that very moment, Jesus recognized that power had gone out from him. He turned around in the crowd and said, “ Who touched my clothes? ”
war: Nakasabot dayon hi Jesus nga ginmawas ha iya in gahom. Linmingi hiya hin pagkita han kadam-an nga mga tawo ngan nagpakiana, “Hin-o in nagkapot han akon bado?”

en: His disciples said to him, “Don’t you see the crowd pressing against you? Yet you ask, ‘Who touched me?’”
war: Nagbaton an iya mga tinun-an, “Nakita ka nga ginlilibotan ka han mga tawo. Kay ano nga nagpapakiana ka pa man?”

en: But Jesus looked around carefully to see who had done it.
war: Kundi gin-osisa gud ni Jesus kon hin-o an kinapot han iya bado.

en: The woman, full of fear and trembling, came forward. Knowing what had happened to her, she fell down in front of Jesus and told him the whole truth.
war: Nakasabot an babaye han nahinabo ha iya; sanglit dinmaop hiya kan Jesus nga nangungurog hin kahadlok. Hinmapa hiya ha atubangan ni Jesus ngan nagsumat han bug-os nga kamatuoran.

en: He responded, “ Daughter, your faith has healed you; go in peace, healed from your disease. ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Anak ko, nakaupay ha imo an imo pagtoo. Lakat nga malinawon, ngan mauupay ka han imo sakit.”

en: While Jesus was still speaking with her, messengers came from the synagogue leader’s house, saying to Jairus, “Your daughter has died. Why bother the teacher any longer?”
war: Han nagyiyinakan pa hi Jesus, may-ada mga surugoon nga inmabot tikang ha balay ni Jairo. Ginsumatan nira hi Jairo, “Patay na an imo anak nga babaye. Ayaw na pagsinamoka an Magturutdo.”

en: But Jesus overheard their report and said to the synagogue leader, “ Don’t be afraid; just keep trusting. ”
war: Waray la makigbali hi Jesus han ira ginsumat, kundi ginsiring hi Jairo, “Ayaw kahadlok. Too la.”

en: He didn’t allow anyone to follow him except Peter, James, and John, James’ brother.
war: Ngan waray ginpaupod ni Jesus, labot kan Pedro ngan han magbugto, hira Santiago ug Juan.

en: They came to the synagogue leader’s house, and he saw a commotion, with people crying and wailing loudly.
war: Inmabot hira ha balay ni Jairo diin hinkit-an ni Jesus an kasamok ngan hinbatian niya an mga pagnguyngoy ngan pagtangis.

en: He went in and said to them, “ What’s all this commotion and crying about? The child isn’t dead. She’s only sleeping. ”
war: Sinmakob hiya ngan nagsiring hiya ha ira, “Ano ini nga kasamok? Kay ano nga nagtitinangis man kamo? Diri patay an bata; nakaturog la hiya.”

en: They laughed at him, but he threw them all out. Then, taking the child’s parents and his disciples with him, he went to the room where the child was.
war: Gintinawaan la hiya han mga tawo; sanglit, ginpagawas niya hira. Pinaupod ni Jesus an amay ngan an iroy han bata ngan an iya tulo nga mga tinun-an, ngan kinmadto hira han sulod diin naghigda an bata.

en: Taking her hand, he said to her, “ Talitha koum ,” which means, “Young woman, get up.”
war: Kinaptan ni Jesus an kamot han bata ngan sidngon, “Talitha, koum,” kon ha aton pa, “Babayehay, pinapabuhat ko ikaw!”

en: Suddenly the young woman got up and began to walk around. She was 12 years old. They were shocked!
war: Binmuhat dayon an bata ngan nagtikang hin paglakat. (Dose na an edad han bata.) Dako gud an ira paghipausa hini nga nahinabo.

en: He gave them strict orders that no one should know what had happened. Then he told them to give her something to eat.
war: Kundi gindid-an hira ni Jesus hin pagsumat hini bisan kan kanay, ngan nagsiring hiya, “Tagi hiya hin pagkaon.”

en: Jesus left that place and came to his hometown. His disciples followed him.
war: Binmaya hi Jesus hito nga dapit ngan inmoli ngadto han iya kalugaringon nga bungto ngan an iya mga tinun-an sinmunod ha iya.

en: On the Sabbath, he began to teach in the synagogue. Many who heard him were surprised. “Where did this man get all this? What’s this wisdom he’s been given? What about the powerful acts accomplished through him?
war: Nagtutdo hiya ha sinagoga ha Adlaw nga Iparahuway. Damo an nakadto nga mga tawo, ngan nanhipausa hira han pakabati nira ha iya. “Diin ba hiya kuha hini nga hibaro?” nagpakiana hira. “Ano ini nga hibaro nga ihinatag ha iya? Inuunan-o ba niya hin pagbuhat hin mga milagro?

en: Isn’t this the carpenter? Isn’t he Mary’s son and the brother of James, Joses, Judas, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” They were repulsed by him and fell into sin.
war: Diri ba hiya an panday nga anak ni Maria ngan bugto nira Santiago, Jose, Judas ug Simon? Diri ba nag-uokoy dinhe an kababayen-an nga iya kabugtoan?” Sanglit iginsalikway hiya nira.

en: Jesus said to them, “ Prophets are honored everywhere except in their own hometowns, among their relatives, and in their own households. ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Tinatahod an manaragna bisan diin nga dapit labot la dida han iya kalugaringon nga bungto, han iya kauropdan ngan han iya panimalay.”

en: He was unable to do any miracles there, except that he placed his hands on a few sick people and healed them.
war: Waray hiya makahimo hin pagbuhat hin mga milagro didto, labot la nga gindun-an ngan gintambal niya in pira nga mga magsakit.

en: He was appalled by their disbelief. Then Jesus traveled through the surrounding villages teaching.
war: Dako an iya paghipausa tungod han kawaray nira pagtoo. Nagsudoy hi Jesus han mga baryo didto hito nga dapit ngan nagtutdo han mga tawo.

en: He called for the Twelve and sent them out in pairs. He gave them authority over unclean spirits.
war: Gintirok niya an dose nga mga tinun-an, ngan iya ginsugo hin padispadis. Tinagan niya hira hin gahom hin pakadaog han mga yawa

en: He instructed them to take nothing for the journey except a walking stick—no bread, no bags, and no money in their belts.
war: ngan gintugon hira niya, “Ayaw kamo pagdara hin bisan ano ha iyo paglakaton, labot hin tungkod; ayaw pagdara hin pagkaon, hin supot ngan hin kwarta ha iyo mga bulsa.

en: He told them to wear sandals but not to put on two shirts.
war: Pagsul-ot kamo hin sandalyas kundi ayaw pagdara hin liliwanan.”

en: He said, “ Whatever house you enter, remain there until you leave that place.
war: Gintugon pa hira, “Kon diin kamo nga balay karawata ngan pasak-a pabilin kamo dida ngahaw tubtob han iyo pagbaya hito nga dapit.

en: If a place doesn’t welcome you or listen to you, as you leave, shake the dust off your feet as a witness against them. ”
war: Kon diri kamo karawaton ha usa nga dapit o diri kamo pamatian, bayai ito nga dapit katapos niyo padpara an tapotapo ha iyo mga tiil. Usa ini nga pahimangno ha ira.”

en: So they went out and proclaimed that people should change their hearts and lives.
war: Sanglit nagkalakat ngan nagwali hira nga kinahanglan bumaya an mga tawo han ira mga sala.

en: They cast out many demons, and they anointed many sick people with olive oil and healed them.
war: Nagpaiwas hira hin damo nga mga yawa, ngan nagdihog hira hin lana ha damo nga mga magsakit, ngan gin-upay nira hira.

en: Herod the king heard about these things, because the name of Jesus had become well-known. Some were saying, “John the Baptist has been raised from the dead, and this is why miraculous powers are at work through him.”
war: Niyan nakabati hi Hadi Herodes hiunong hini ngatanan kay nahisamwak man an bantog ni Jesus ha ngatanan nga dapit. May-ada mga tawo nga nasiring, “Nabuhi na liwat hi Juan nga Parabunyag! Sanglit nakikita ta ini nga mga gahom dida ha iya.”

en: Others were saying, “He is Elijah.” Still others were saying, “He is a prophet like one of the ancient prophets.”
war: Kundi nagsiring an iba, “Hi Elias hiya.” Nagsiring liwat an iba, “Manaragna hiya sugad hin usa nga bantogan nga manaragna hadton mga una pa nga panahon.”

en: But when Herod heard these rumors, he said, “John, whom I beheaded, has been raised to life.”
war: Han pakabati hini ni Herodes, nagsiring hiya, “Amo hiya hi Juan nga Parabunyag! Ginpapugotan ko na hiya, kundi nabuhi liwat!”

en: He said this because Herod himself had arranged to have John arrested and put in prison because of Herodias, the wife of Herod’s brother Philip. Herod had married her,
war: Hi Herodes ngahaw an nagpadakop kan Juan; iya iginpagapos ngan iginsulod ha bilanggoan. Ginbuhat ini ni Herodes tungod kan Herodias nga iya gin-asawa. Hi Herodias asawa ni Felipe nga bugto ngahaw ni Herodes.

en: but John told Herod, “It’s against the law for you to marry your brother’s wife!”
war: Waray hunong hin pagsinaway ni Juan kan Herodes, “Diri matadong nga buhat an pag-asawa mo han asawa han imo bugto!”

en: So Herodias had it in for John. She wanted to kill him, but she couldn’t.
war: Sanglit nagdumot hi Herodias kan Juan ngan karuyag niya patayon, kundi waray hiya makahimo tungod kan Herodes.

en: This was because Herod respected John. He regarded him as a righteous and holy person, so he protected him. John’s words greatly confused Herod, yet he enjoyed listening to him.
war: Nahadlok hi Herodes kan Juan kay maaram hiya nga maupay ngan baraan nga tawo hi Juan, sanglit ginpabantayan hiya niya. Karuyag niya mamati kan Juan, bisan kon nagugupong hiya ha kada pakakabati niya kan Juan.

en: Finally, the time was right. It was on one of Herod’s birthdays, when he had prepared a feast for his high-ranking officials and military officers and Galilee’s leading residents.
war: Ha kataposan nakahigayon hi Herodias hin pagpatay kan Juan. Naghatag hi Herodes hin dako nga kombite dida han iya kaadlawan, han mga punoan han kasondalohan, ngan han mga dagko nga pagkatawo ha Galilea.

en: Herod’s daughter Herodias came in and danced, thrilling Herod and his dinner guests. The king said to the young woman, “Ask me whatever you wish, and I will give it to you.”
war: Sinmakob ngan sinmayaw an anak nga babaye ni Herodias Nakalipay hiya kan Herodes ngan han mga dinapit ngada han kombite. Nagpakiana han daragita an hadi, “Ano an imo karuyag aroon? Ihahatag ko ha imo in bisan ano nga imo karuyag.”

en: Then he swore to her, “Whatever you ask I will give to you, even as much as half of my kingdom.”
war: Pinaagi hin damo nga panumpa, nagsiring ha iya na hadi, “Nagsasaad ako nga tatagan ta ikaw han imo karuyag aroon, bisan pa an katunga han akon ginhadian.”

en: She left the banquet hall and said to her mother, “What should I ask for?” “John the Baptist’s head,” Herodias replied.
war: Ginmawas an daragita ngan pinmakiana han iroy niya kon ano an iya aaroon. Binmaton an iroy niya, “An ulo ni Juan nga Parabunyag.”

en: Hurrying back to the ruler, she made her request: “I want you to give me John the Baptist’s head on a plate, right this minute.”
war: Kinmadto dayon han hadi an daragita ngan nangaro, “Karuyag ko nga ihatag mo ha akon an ulo ni Juan nga Parabunyag nga sinangga hin plato!”

en: Although the king was upset, because of his solemn pledge and his guests, he didn’t want to refuse her.
war: Nabido kaupay an hadi; kundi waray hiya makabaribad, kay nagsaad hiya ha atubangan han iya nga dinapit.

en: So he ordered a guard to bring John’s head. The guard went to the prison, cut off John’s head,
war: Sanglit ginsugo niya in gwardya han bilanggoan nga dad-on an ulo ni Juan. Linmakat an gwardya, kinmadto ha bilanggoan, ngan ginpugotan hi Juan.

en: brought his head on a plate, and gave it to the young woman, and she gave it to her mother.
war: Gindara niya an ulo nga sinangga hin plato, ngan iginhatag niya han daragita, ngan ihinatag han daragita ngadto han iroy niya.

en: When John’s disciples heard what had happened, they came and took his dead body and laid it in a tomb.
war: Pakabati hini han mga tinun-an ni Juan, kinmadto hira pagkuha han iya lawas ngan iginlubong nira.

en: The apostles returned to Jesus and told him everything they had done and taught.
war: Binmalik ngan nakigkita kan Jesus an mga apostoles ngan ginsumatan hiya nira han ngatanan nga ira ginbuhat ngan gintutdo.

en: Many people were coming and going, so there was no time to eat. He said to the apostles, “Come by yourselves to a secluded place and rest for a while.”
war: Abotkiabot an mga tawo, sanglit waray na ngani panahon pagkaon hi Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an. Sanglit nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an, “Tana, pahirayo kita han mga tawo, ngadto hin mamingaw nga dapit, basi makapahuway anay kamo.”

en: They departed in a boat by themselves for a deserted place.
war: Sanglit sinmakay hira hin sakayan ngadto hin dapit nga mamingaw.

en: Many people saw them leaving and recognized them, so they ran ahead from all the cities and arrived before them.
war: Kundi damo nga mga tawo an kinmita han ira paggikan ngan nahibaro dayon hira kon hin-o an mga sakay. Sanglit, linmanat hira tikang han mga kaburubungtohan. Tungod nga darodalagan man an ira pagbaktas, nahiuna hira pag-abot kanda Jesus ngan han iya mga tinun-an.

en: When Jesus arrived and saw a large crowd, he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd. Then he began to teach them many things.
war: Han paghaw-as ni Jesus han sakayan hinkit-an niya ini nga kadam-an nga mga tawo ngan nalooy hiya ha ira kay sugad hira hin mga karnero nga waray magmarangno. Ngan nagtikang hiya hin pagtutdo ha ira hin damo nga mga butang.

en: Late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This is an isolated place, and it’s already late in the day.
war: Han kulopay na, dinmaop an iya mga tinun-an ngan nagsiring, “Tikagab-i na, ngan tay-aw ini nga dapit.

en: Send them away so that they can go to the surrounding countryside and villages and buy something to eat for themselves.”
war: Palakta na an mga tawo ngan pakadtoa na la hira ha mga higrani nga kaumhan ngan kabaryohan, basi makapalit hira hin sadang makaon.”

en: He replied, “ You give them something to eat. ” But they said to him, “Should we go off and buy bread worth almost eight months’ pay and give it to them to eat?”
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Kamo ngahaw in hatag ha ira hin pagkaon.” Nagpakiana hira, “Karuyag ba nimo nga lumakat kami pagpalit hin kanan 400.00 nga tinapay ngan ipakaon ha ira?”

en: He said to them, “ How much bread do you have? Take a look. ” After checking, they said, “Five loaves of bread and two fish.”
war: Pinmakiana hi Jesus ha ira, “Pipira la an iyo tinapay? Panginanoa daw niyo.” Han kasayod na nira, ginsumatan hiya, “Lima la ka bug-os ngan duha nga isda.”

en: He directed the disciples to seat all the people in groups as though they were having a banquet on the green grass.
war: Ginsugo ni Jesus an iya mga tinun-an nga pagpurupundokon hira hin pagkalingkod dida han kabanwaan.

en: They sat down in groups of hundreds and fifties.
war: Sanglit nagpurupundok an mga tawo hin tinag 100 ngan tinag 50.

en: He took the five loaves and the two fish, looked up to heaven, blessed them, broke the loaves into pieces, and gave them to his disciples to set before the people. He also divided the two fish among them all.
war: Niyan kinuha ni Jesus an lima ka bug-os nga tinapay ngan an duha nga isda, hinmangad hiya ha langit, ngan nagpasalamat sa Dyos. Ginpinitpinit niya an tinapay ngan iginhatag ha iya mga tinun-an basi igdurot ha mga tawo. Iya liwat ginbahinbahin an duha nga isda ha ira ngatanan.

en: Everyone ate until they were full.
war: Nanngaon an ngatanan ngan nagkabubusog.

en: They filled twelve baskets with the leftover pieces of bread and fish.
war: Kahuman, nakatirok pa an mga tinun-an hin dose ka alat han nahisalin nga mga tinapay ngan isda.

en: About five thousand had eaten.
war: Lima ka yukot nga kalalaken-an an nangaon han tinapay.

en: Right then, Jesus made his disciples get into a boat and go ahead to the other side of the lake, toward Bethsaida, while he dismissed the crowd.
war: Samtang ginpapaoli ni Jesus an mga tawo, ginpasakay dayon niya an iya mga tinun-an basi mag-una ha iya ngadto ha Betsaida, ha tabok han lanaw.

en: After saying good-bye to them, Jesus went up onto a mountain to pray.
war: Kahuman niya manamilit han iya mga tinun-an, kinmadto hiya hin usa nga pungtod basi hiya mag-ampo.

en: Evening came and the boat was in the middle of the lake, but he was alone on the land.
war: Han pagkagab-i na, nakadto na an sakayan ha butnga han lanaw, samtang nag-uusaan la hi Jesus didto ha sagka.

en: He saw his disciples struggling. They were trying to row forward, but the wind was blowing against them. Very early in the morning, he came to them, walking on the lake. He intended to pass by them.
war: Nakita niya nga nagkukuri an iya mga tinun-an pagginaod kay songsong hira kaupay han hangin. Sanglit, ha mga alas tres ngadto ha alas seis na an kaagahon, kinmadto hi Jesus ha ira nga naglalakat ha bawbaw han tubig. Nakahunahuna la hiya hin paglabay ha ira.

en: When they saw him walking on the lake, they thought he was a ghost and they screamed.
war: Kundi kinmita hira nga naglalakat hiya ha bawbaw han tubig. Hunahuna nira nga murto adto, sanglit ginmoliat hira

en: Seeing him was terrifying to all of them. Just then he spoke to them, “ Be encouraged! It’s me. Don’t be afraid. ”
war: hin kahadlok han pakakita nira ngatanan ha iya. Nagyakan dayon hi Jesus ha ira, “Ayaw kamo kahadlok! Hi ako ini!”

en: He got into the boat, and the wind settled down. His disciples were so baffled they were beside themselves.
war: Sinmakay hiya han sakayan upod ha ira ngan hinmugpoy dayon an hangin. Duro an paghipausa han mga tinun-an,

en: That’s because they hadn’t understood about the loaves. Their minds had been closed so that they resisted God’s ways.
war: kay waray nira hisabti an kahulogan han pagpadamo han mga tinapay; makuri pa adto matugkad han ira mga hunahuna.

en: When Jesus and his disciples had crossed the lake, they landed at Gennesaret, anchored the boat,
war: Tinmabok hira han lanaw ngan inmabot hira ha Genesaret diin iginhigot nira an ira sakayan.

en: and came ashore. People immediately recognized Jesus
war: Han nabaya na hira han sakayan, kinmilala dayon kan Jesus an mga tawo.

en: and ran around that whole region bringing sick people on their mats to wherever they heard he was.
war: Sanglit nagdagmit hira hin pagsudoy ngan pagsumat han mga tawo ha bug-os nga dapit, ngan gindara an mga magsakit nga nahigda ha banig ngadto kan Jesus.

en: Wherever he went—villages, cities, or farming communities—they would place the sick in the marketplaces and beg him to allow them to touch even the hem of his clothing. Everyone who touched him was healed.
war: Bisan diin hi Jesus kakadto—ha mga baryo, mga bungto, o kaumhan, gindadara han mga tawo an ira mga magsakit ngadto ha mga taboan ngan nakikimalooy hira ha iya nga tugotan an mga magsakit hin pagkamkam bisan na manla han sidsid han iya panapton. An ngatanan nga nakakamkam nagkauopay.

en: The Pharisees and some legal experts from Jerusalem gathered around Jesus.
war: Nag-alirong kan Jesus an mga Parisiyo ngan in pira han mga magturutdo han Balaod nga nagkaabot tikang ha Jerusalem.

en: They saw some of his disciples eating food with unclean hands. (They were eating without first ritually purifying their hands through washing.
war: Kinita nira nga nangangaon an iba han iya mga tinun-an nga mahugaw an ira mga kamot—karuyag sidngon nga waray hira manhunaw sugad han paagi nga igintutdo han mga Parisiyo nga angay buhaton han mga tawo.

en: The Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat without first washing their hands carefully. This is a way of observing the rules handed down by the elders.
war: Nagsusunod an mga Parisiyo, sugad man an iba nga mga Judiyo han pagturon-an nga nababatasan han ira mga kaapoy-apoyan. Diri hira nakaon kon diri anay manhunaw han amo nga paagi,

en: Upon returning from the marketplace, they don’t eat without first immersing themselves. They observe many other rules that have been handed down, such as the washing of cups, jugs, pans, and sleeping mats.)
war: ngan diri liwat nira kinakaon an bisan ano nga tikang ha taboan kon diri anay nahuhugasan. Ngan ginsusunod nira in damo pa nga mga sugo nga ira nababatasan sugad han mga irimnan, mga lutoan, mga surudlan nga tumbaga, ngan mga higdaan.

en: So the Pharisees and legal experts asked Jesus, “Why are your disciples not living according to the rules handed down by the elders but instead eat food with ritually unclean hands?”
war: Sanglit, nagpakiana kan Jesus an mga Parisiyo ngan an mga magturutdo han Balaod, “Kay ano nga diri nagsusunod an imo mga tinun-an han pagturon-an han aton mga ginikanan, kundi nangangaon bisan kon mahugaw an ira mga kamot?”

en: He replied, “ Isaiah really knew what he was talking about when he prophesied about you hypocrites. He wrote, This people honors me with their lips, but their hearts are far away from me.
war: Binaton hira ni Jesus, “Waray gud magsayop hi Isaias han iya ginpanagna mahitungod ha iyo! Mga salingkapaw kamo, sugad gud han iya iginsurat: ‘Nagdadayaw ha akon ha ira mga pulong ini nga mga tawo, nasiring an Dyos, kundi ha pagkamatuod, hirayo ha akon an ira mga kasingkasing.

en: Their worship of me is empty since they teach instructions that are human words.
war: Kawang la an ira pagsingba ha akon, kay gintututdo nira an kanan tawo kasugoanan nga daw sugad hin kanan Dyos mga lagda!’

en: You ignore God’s commandment while holding on to rules created by humans and handed down to you. ”
war: “Sinasalikway niyo an sugo han Dyos ngan asay niyo gintutuman an mga pagturon-an han mga tawo.”

en: Jesus continued, “ Clearly, you are experts at rejecting God’s commandment in order to establish these rules.
war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus pagsiring ha ira, “Listo gud kamo lumikay han kanan Dyos balaod basi la igpadayon niyo an iyo kalugaringon nga pagturon-an.

en: Moses said, Honor your father and your mother, and The person who speaks against father or mother will certainly be put to death .
war: Kay hi Moises nagsugo, ‘Tahoron mo an amay ngan iroy nimo ngan kinahanglan patayon adton magpapakaraot han amay ngan iroy niya.’

en: But you say, ‘If you tell your father or mother, “ Everything I’m expected to contribute to you is corban (that is, a gift I’m giving to God), ”
war: Kundi nagtututdo kamo nga kon may-ada sadang ikabulig in tawo han amay ngan iroy niya, kundi kon sumiring hiya, ‘Corban ini’ (karuyag sidngon, kanan Dyos ito),

en: then you are no longer required to care for your father or mother.’
war: waray na niya labot pagbulig han amay o iroy niya.

en: In this way you do away with God’s word in favor of the rules handed down to you, which you pass on to others. And you do a lot of other things just like that. ”
war: Kon sugad, gindidiwara niyo an pulong han Dyos pinaagi han pagturon-an nga igintututdo niyo ha iba nga mga tawo. Ngan ginbubuhat niyo in damo pa nga mga butang nga alid-agid hini.”

en: Then Jesus called the crowd again and said, “ Listen to me, all of you, and understand.
war: Gintawag ngahaw ni Jesus an kadam-an ngada ha iya ngan ginsiring hira, “Pamati kamo ngatanan ngan sabta niyo.

en: Nothing outside of a person can enter and contaminate a person in God’s sight; rather, the things that come out of a person contaminate the person. ”
war: Waray bisan ano nga nasulod ha tawo tikang ha gawas nga nakakapahugaw ha iya, kundi adton nagawas tikang han tawo amo lugod an nakakapahugaw ha iya. [

en: After leaving the crowd, he entered a house where his disciples asked him about that riddle.
war: Sanglit, mamati an may-ada durunggan.”]

en: He said to them, “ Don’t you understand either? Don’t you know that nothing from the outside that enters a person has the power to contaminate?
war: Han pagbaya na niya han kadam-an ngan pagsulod na niya han balay, nagpakiana an iya mga tinun-an ha iya mahitungod hini nga pananglitan.

en: That’s because it doesn’t enter into the heart but into the stomach, and it goes out into the sewer. ” By saying this, Jesus declared that no food could contaminate a person in God’s sight.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Sugad la kamo han iba hin kamahinay makasabot! Diri ba kamo nasabot nga waray bisan ano nga nasulod ha tawo tikang ha gawas nga nakakapahugaw ha iya?

en: “ It’s what comes out of a person that contaminates someone in God’s sight, ” he said.
war: Kay diri ito nasulod ha iya kasingkasing kundi ha iya tiyan, ngan onina, iginuguwa.” (Dida hini iginpahayag ni Jesus nga mahihimo kaonon an ngatanan nga pagkaon.)

en: “ It’s from the inside, from the human heart, that evil thoughts come: sexual sins, thefts, murders,
war: Ngan nagpadayon hiya pagsiring, “An naguwa tikang ha tawo amo an nakakapahugaw ha iya.

en: adultery, greed, evil actions, deceit, unrestrained immorality, envy, insults, arrogance, and foolishness.
war: Kay tikang ha sakob, tikang ha kasingkasing, naguwa an magraot nga mga panhunahuna nga nakakaaghat hin panikas, pamatay,

en: All these evil things come from the inside and contaminate a person in God’s sight. ”
war: pakighilawas, kaipa han kanan iba butang, paglimbong, kamalaw-ay, pangabugho, pakaraot, pagparayaw ngan tinuyaw nga buhat.

en: Jesus left that place and went into the region of Tyre. He didn’t want anyone to know that he had entered a house, but he couldn’t hide.
war: Natikang ha sakob han tawo ini ngatanan ngan amo an nakakapahugaw ha iya.”

en: In fact, a woman whose young daughter was possessed by an unclean spirit heard about him right away. She came and fell at his feet.
war: Binmaya hi Jesus ngan kinmadto han tuna hirani han syudad han Tiro. Sinmulod hiya hin balay, ngan diri niya karuyag nga may mahibaro nga nakadto hiya; kundi diri gud hiya natatago.

en: The woman was Greek, Syrophoenician by birth. She begged Jesus to throw the demon out of her daughter.
war: Nahibaroan an iya pag-abot hin usa nga babaye, kanay anak nga babayehay may maraot nga espiritu. Kinmadto dayon hiya kan Jesus ngan hinmapa ha iya tiilan.

en: He responded, “ The children have to be fed first. It isn’t right to take the children’s bread and toss it to the dogs. ”
war: Langyaw ini nga babaye nga natawo ha Fenicia, didto ha Siria. Nakimalooy hiya kan Jesus nga pagawson an yawa tikang han iya anak.

en: But she answered, “Lord, even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
war: Kundi nagbaton hi Jesus, “Pakaona ta anay an mga anak; diri maupay nga kuhaon an pagkaon han mga anak, ngan ilabog ngadto han mga ayam.”

en: “ Good answer! ” he said. “ Go on home. The demon has already left your daughter. ”
war: “Matuod gad ini,” binmaton an babaye, “kundi bisan an mga ayam ha sirong han lamesa ngangangaon man han mga salin han mga anak!”

en: When she returned to her house, she found the child lying on the bed and the demon gone.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha iya, “Tungod hini nga imo baton, makakaoli ka na. Ginmawas na an yawa tikang han imo anak!”

en: After leaving the region of Tyre, Jesus went through Sidon toward the Galilee Sea through the region of the Ten Cities.
war: Inmoli an babaye ngan hin-agian niya an iya anak nga nahigda ngan ginmawas na tikang ha iya an yawa.

en: Some people brought to him a man who was deaf and could hardly speak, and they begged him to place his hand on the man for healing.
war: Binmaya hi Jesus han tuna nga hirani ha Tiro ngan inmagi ha Sidon ngadto han lanaw han Galilea, ngan naglatas han mga tuna han Decapolis.

en: Jesus took him away from the crowd by himself and put his fingers in the man’s ears. Then he spit and touched the man’s tongue.
war: Gindara ha iya in tawo nga bungol ngan makuri makayakan, ngan nakimalooy kan Jesus an mga nagdara nga dun-an niya ini nga tawo.

en: Looking into heaven, Jesus sighed deeply and said, “ Ephphatha, ” which means, “Open up.”
war: Ibinulag hiya anay ni Jesus han kadam-an, ngan ibinutang ni Jesus an iya mga tudlo dida han kanan tawo nga talinga. Linmura hiya ngan iya kinamkam an dila han tawo.

en: At once, his ears opened, his twisted tongue was released, and he began to speak clearly.
war: Hinmangad hi Jesus ha langit ngan nangaraba ngan ginsiring an tawo, “ Ephphatha” , karuyag sidngon, “Mabuksan ka!”

en: Jesus gave the people strict orders not to tell anyone. But the more he tried to silence them, the more eagerly they shared the news.
war: Nakabati dayon an tawo, nawara na an iya kangula, ngan maupay na an iya pagyakan.

en: People were overcome with wonder, saying, “He does everything well! He even makes the deaf to hear and gives speech to those who can’t speak.”
war: Gindid-an hira ni Jesus pagsumat hini bisan kan kanay; kundi dinmugang lugod hira hin pagsinumat.

en: In those days there was another large crowd with nothing to eat. Jesus called his disciples and told them,
war: Waray pag-iha nagkatirok na liwat in kadam-an nga mga tawo. Han waray na nira pagkaon, gintawag ni Jesus an iya mga tinun-an ngan ginsiring hira,

en: “ I feel sorry for the crowd because they have been with me for three days and have nothing to eat.
war: “Nalolooy ako hini nga mga tawo kay upod hira nakon sulod hin tulo na ka adlaw, ngan waray na nira pagkaon.

en: If I send them away hungry to their homes, they won’t have enough strength to travel, for some have come a long distance. ”
war: Kon paolion ko hira nga mga gutom, manhihiraptay hira ha dalan kay hirayo an oolian an iba ha ira.”

en: His disciples responded, “How can anyone get enough food in this wilderness to satisfy these people?”
war: Nagpakiana ha iya an iya mga tinun-an, “Hain man kita pakakaagi dinhe hini nga kamingawan hin igo kadamo nga pagkaon nga igdudurot hini ngatanan nga mga tawo?”

en: Jesus asked, “ How much bread do you have? ” They said, “Seven loaves.”
war: “Pipira pa man an iyo tinapay?” nagpakiana hi Jesus ha ira. “Pipito na la,” binmaton hira.

en: He told the crowd to sit on the ground. He took the seven loaves, gave thanks, broke them apart, and gave them to his disciples to distribute; and they gave the bread to the crowd.
war: Pinapanlingkod ni Jesus ha tuna an mga tawo. Kinuha niya an pito nga tinapay ngan nagpasalamat sa Dyos. Iya ginpinitpinit an tinapay ngan ipanhatag ngadto han iya mga tinun-an basi igdurot ngadto han mga tawo. Ngan ipinanhatag ini han iya mga tinun-an.

en: They also had a few fish. He said a blessing over them, then gave them to the disciples to hand out also.
war: May-ada liwat nira pira ka bug-os nga gudtiay nga mga isda. Nagpasalamat ngahaw hi Jesus tungod hini ngan nagsugo hiya han iya mga tinun-an nga ipanhatag liwat.

en: They ate until they were full. They collected seven baskets full of leftovers.
war: Nangaon ngan nagkabubusog an ngatanan—may mga upat ka yukot adto nga mga tawo.

en: This was a crowd of about four thousand people! Jesus sent them away,
war: Gintirok han mga tinun-an an mga nanhisalin, ngan nakapuno pa hira hin pito ka alat. Pinapangoli ni Jesus an mga tawo,

en: then got into a boat with his disciples and went over to the region of Dalmanutha.
war: ngan sinmakay dayon hiya han sakayan upod an iya mga tinun-an, ngan kinmadto hira han tuna han Dalmanuta.

en: The Pharisees showed up and began to argue with Jesus. To test him, they asked for a sign from heaven.
war: Nagkaabot in mga Parisiyo ngan nagtikang pakiglantugi kan Jesus. Karuyag nira pagbitik ha iya sanglit nangaro hira nga magbuhat hiya hin milagro nga magpapakita nga uyon ha iya an Dyos.

en: With an impatient sigh, Jesus said, “ Why does this generation look for a sign? I assure you that no sign will be given to it. ”
war: Baga ginminhawa hin hilawig hi Jesus ngan nagsiring, “Kay ano nga nangangaro hin milagro an mga tawo hini nga katulinan? Diri, nasiring ako ha iyo! Waray milagro nga ipakikita hini nga mga tawo!”

en: Leaving them, he got back in the boat and crossed to the other side of the lake.
war: Binayaan niya hira, sinmakay hiya han sakayan, ngan tinmabok han lanaw.

en: Jesus’ disciples had forgotten to bring any bread, so they had only one loaf with them in the boat.
war: Nanhingalimot an mga tinun-an pagdara hin igo kadamo nga tinapay, ngan usa la ka bug-os an ira balon ha sakayan.

en: He gave them strict orders: “ Watch out and be on your guard for the yeast of the Pharisees as well as the yeast of Herod. ”
war: “Panginano ngan pagbantay kamo han patubo han mga Parisiyo ngan han patubo ni Herodes,” nagpahimangno hi Jesus ha ira.

en: The disciples discussed this among themselves, “He said this because we have no bread.”
war: Naghirohimangraw an mga tinun-an ha ira la ngahaw: “Nasiring hiya hini kay waray man kita dara nga tinapay.”

en: Jesus knew what they were discussing and said, “ Why are you talking about the fact that you don’t have any bread? Don’t you grasp what has happened? Don’t you understand? Are your hearts so resistant to what God is doing?
war: Nakasabot hi Jesus han ira ginkakarokayakan, sanglit nagpakiana hiya ha ira, “Kay ano nga naghihirohimangraw man kamo mahitungod han kawaray niyo dara nga tinapay? Diri pa ba kamo maaram o nakakasabot? Makuri ba masabot ini han iyo mga hunahuna?

en: Don’t you have eyes? Why can’t you see? Don’t you have ears? Why can’t you hear? Don’t you remember?
war: May-ada niyo mga mata—diri ba kamo nakita? May-ada niyo mga talinga—diri ba kamo nabati? Hinngalimtan na ba niyo

en: When I broke five loaves of bread for those five thousand people, how many baskets full of leftovers did you gather? ” They answered, “Twelve.”
war: an pagpinitpinit ko han lima nga mga tinapay para han lima ka yukot ngan mga tawo? Pira ka alat an natirok niyo han nanhisalin pa nga mga tinapay?” “Dose,” nagbaton hira.

en: “ And when I broke seven loaves of bread for those four thousand people, how many baskets full of leftovers did you gather? ” They answered, “Seven.”
war: “Ngan han pagpinitpinit ko han pito nga tinapay para han upat ka yukot nga mga tawo, pira man ka alat an natirok niyo han nanhisalin pa nga mga tinapay?” nagpakiana hi Jesus. “Pito,” binmaton hira.

en: Jesus said to them, “ And you still don’t understand? ”
war: “Diri la kamo gihapon nakakasabot?” nagpakiana hiya ha ira.

en: Jesus and his disciples came to Bethsaida. Some people brought a blind man to Jesus and begged him to touch and heal him.
war: Inmabot hira ha Betsaida. Gindara hin pira nga mga tawo ngadto kan Jesus in buta, ngan nakimalooy hira nga kaptan hiya ni Jesus.

en: Taking the blind man’s hand, Jesus led him out of the village. After spitting on his eyes and laying his hands on the man, he asked him, “ Do you see anything? ”
war: Ginkaptan ni Jesus an kamot han buta ngan iya gintugwayan ngadto ha gawas han baryo. Kahuman niya pagbutangi hin laway an mga mata han tawo, gindun-an niya ngan ginpakianhan, “May nakikita mo na ba?”

en: The man looked up and said, “I see people. They look like trees, only they are walking around.”
war: Hinmangad an tawo ngan binmaton, “Oo, nakita ako hin mga tawo, kundi sugad hira hin mga kahoy nga nagkakalakat.”

en: Then Jesus placed his hands on the man’s eyes again. He looked with his eyes wide open, his sight was restored, and he could see everything clearly.
war: Idinuon liwat ni Jesus an iya mga kamot dida han mga mata han tawo. Tinmutok hin maupay an buta; nahibalik an iya pagkita, ngan klaro na gud an iya pagkita han ngatanan.

en: Then Jesus sent him home, saying, “ Don’t go into the village! ”
war: Ginpaoli hiya ni Jesus ngan ginsiring, “Ayaw na pagbalik ngadto ha baryo.”

en: Jesus and his disciples went into the villages near Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “ Who do people say that I am? ”
war: Niyan kinmadto hi Jesus ngan an iya mga tinun-an ha mga baryo han Cesarea Filipo. Ginpakianhan niya hira dida ha dalan, “Pagsumati daw ako niyo; hin-o man kuno ako sumala han siring han mga tawo?”

en: They told him, “Some say John the Baptist, others Elijah, and still others one of the prophets.”
war: Binmaton hira, “May nasiring nga ikaw amo hi Juan nga Parabunyag. Nasiring an iba, hi Elias ka; samtang nasiring naman an iba, usa ka han mga manaragna.”

en: He asked them, “ And what about you? Who do you say that I am? ” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”
war: “Hi kamo—ano man an isisiring niyo? Hin-o gud ako?” nagpakiana hi Jesus ha ira. Binmaton hi Pedro, “Ikaw an Mesiyas.”

en: Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone about him.
war: Ngan nagsugo hi Jesus ha ira, “Ayaw kamo pagsumat bisan kan kanay mahitungod ha akon.”

en: Then Jesus began to teach his disciples: “ The Human One must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and the legal experts, and be killed, and then, after three days, rise from the dead. ”
war: Niyan nagtikang hi Jesus pagtutdo han iya mga tinun-an, “Kinahanglan mag-antos an Anak han Tawo, ngan igsalikway hiya han katigurangan ngan han mga puno han kapadian ngan han mga magturutdo han Balaod. Pagpapatayon hiya, kundi mababanhaw hiya katapos hin tulo ka adlaw.”

en: He said this plainly. But Peter took hold of Jesus and, scolding him, began to correct him.
war: Iginsumat niya ini hin waray lipodlipod ha ira. Ibinulag anay ni Pedro hi Jesus ngan nakiglantugi ha iya.

en: Jesus turned and looked at his disciples, then sternly corrected Peter: “ Get behind me, Satan. You are not thinking God’s thoughts but human thoughts. ”
war: Kundi linmingi hi Jesus, sinmiplat ha iya mga tinun-an, ngan ginbusaan hi Pedro, “Iwas ha akon, Satanas! Kanan tawo la an imo panhunahuna, diri kanan Dyos!”

en: After calling the crowd together with his disciples, Jesus said to them, “ All who want to come after me must say no to themselves, take up their cross, and follow me.
war: Ngan gintawag ni Jesus an mga tawo, pati an iya mga tinun-an, ngan ginsiring hira, “Kon hin-o an karuyag bumunyog ha akon, kinahanglan limoton niya an iya kalugaringon, magpas-an han iya kros, ngan sumunod ha akon.

en: All who want to save their lives will lose them. But all who lose their lives because of me and because of the good news will save them.
war: Kay adton karuyag matalwas han iya kinabuhi, ini mawawara ha iya; kundi adton mamatay tungod ha akon ngan han Maupay nga Sumat, mabubuhi hiya.

en: Why would people gain the whole world but lose their lives?
war: May-ada ba kaupayan nga makukuha hin tawo kon maangkon niya an bug-os nga kalibutan, kundi kawad-an hiya han iya kinabuhi? Waray gud!

en: What will people give in exchange for their lives?
war: Waray gud sadang ikahatag hin tawo basi mabawi an iya kinabuhi.

en: Whoever is ashamed of me and my words in this unfaithful and sinful generation, the Human One will be ashamed of that person when he comes in the Father’s glory with the holy angels. ”
war: Sanglit an tawo nga maawod ha akon ngan han akon pagturon-an dida hini nga makasasala nga kalibutan ikakaawod man han Anak han Tawo kon kumanhi na hiya ha kagamhanan han Amay niya, kaupod an iya baraan nga mga anghel.”

en: Jesus continued, “ I assure you that some standing here won’t die before they see God’s kingdom arrive in power. ”
war: Nagpadayon hi Jesus hin pagsiring ha ira, “Tigamni ini niyo: May-ada pipira dinhe nga diri pa mapatay ngada han pakakita nira han pag-abot han Ginhadian han Dyos nga puno hin gahom.”

en: Six days later Jesus took Peter, James, and John, and brought them to the top of a very high mountain where they were alone. He was transformed in front of them,
war: Paglabay hin unom ka adlaw, sinmagka hi Jesus hin hitaas nga bukid. Waray iba nga igin-upod niya labot kanda Pedro, Santiago ug Juan. Samtang nagkikinita hira, nabalhin an panagway ni Jesus.

en: and his clothes were amazingly bright, brighter than if they had been bleached white.
war: Nagsilaw an iya panapton ngan nagmabusag hin duro. Waray bisan hin-o dinhe ha tuna in makakapabusag hin sugad hini.

en: Elijah and Moses appeared and were talking with Jesus.
war: Hinkit-an han tulo nga mga tinun-an nga nakikighimangraw kan Jesus hira Elias ug Moises.

en: Peter reacted to all of this by saying to Jesus, “Rabbi, it’s good that we’re here. Let’s make three shrines—one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
war: Nagsiring hi Pedro kan Jesus, “Magturutdo, maupay nga hahani na la kita. Maghihimo kami hin tulo nga tulda: usa ha imo, usa kan Moises, ngan usa kan Elias.”

en: He said this because he didn’t know how to respond, for the three of them were terrified.
war: Tungod han kahadlok ni Pedro ngan han iba nga mga tinun-an, waray hira sabot han iya iginyakan.

en: Then a cloud overshadowed them, and a voice spoke from the cloud, “This is my Son, whom I dearly love. Listen to him!”
war: Linambongan hira hin dampog ngan hinbatian nira in tingog tikang ha dampog, “Amo ini an hinigugma ko nga Anak. Pamatii niyo hiya!”

en: Suddenly, looking around, they no longer saw anyone with them except Jesus.
war: Nanginano hira dayon, kundi waray nira hinkit-an nga iba labot kan Jesus nga kaupod nira.

en: As they were coming down the mountain, he ordered them not to tell anyone what they had seen until after the Human One had risen from the dead.
war: Han pagkalugsong nira han bukid nagtugon hi Jesus ha ira, “Ayaw kamo pagsumat bisan kan kanay han nakita niyo ngada han kabanhaw han Anak han Tawo.”

en: So they kept it to themselves, wondering, “What’s this ‘rising from the dead’?”
war: Gintuman nira an iya tugon, kundi naggiparopakiana hira kon ano an karuyag sidngon han pagkabanhaw han mga minatay.

en: They asked Jesus, “Why do the legal experts say that Elijah must come first?”
war: Nagpakiana hira kan Jesus, “Kay ano nga nasiring an mga magturutdo han Balaod nga kinahanglan kumanhi anay hi Elias?”

en: He answered, “ Elijah does come first to restore all things. Why was it written that the Human One would suffer many things and be rejected?
war: Binmaton hiya, “Makanhi man ngani anay hi Elias basi mag-andam han ngatanan nga mga butang. Kundi kay ano nga nasiring an Kasuratan nga mag-aantos hin duro an Anak han Tawo ngan igsasalikway?

en: In fact, I tell you that Elijah has come, but they did to him whatever they wanted, just as it was written about him. ”
war: Nasiring ako ha iyo nga kinmanhi na hi Elias, ngan ginbuhat han mga tawo an ira karuyag buhaton ha iya, sumala han iginsiring han Kasuratan mahitungod ha iya.”

en: When Jesus, Peter, James, and John approached the other disciples, they saw a large crowd surrounding them and legal experts arguing with them.
war: Han paghitampo nira han iba nga mga tinun-an, hinkit-an nira in damo nga mga tawo. May mga magturutdo han Balaod nga nakiglantugi han mga tinun-an.

en: Suddenly the whole crowd caught sight of Jesus. They ran to greet him, overcome with excitement.
war: Dako an paghipausa han mga tawo han pakakita nira kan Jesus, ngan nagdadlagan hira hin pagsugat ha iya.

en: Jesus asked them, “ What are you arguing about? ”
war: Nagpakiana hi Jesus han iya mga tinun-an, “Ano ba an iyo ginkalantugian ha ira?”

en: Someone from the crowd responded, “Teacher, I brought my son to you, since he has a spirit that doesn’t allow him to speak.
war: Binmaton in usa ka tawo dida han kadam-an, “Magturutdo, gindara ko an akon anak nganhi ha imo, kay sinasangkayan hiya hin yawa, ngan diri hiya nakakayakan.

en: Wherever it overpowers him, it throws him into a fit. He foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and stiffens up. So I spoke to your disciples to see if they could throw it out, but they couldn’t.”
war: Kon tinutulos hiya, binubuntog hiya ha tuna, nagbubura an iya baba, nangingigot an iya mga ngipon, ngan natikig an bug-os niya nga lawas. Pinangaro ko han imo nga tinun-an nga pagawson an espiritu, kundi waray man hira pakahimo.”

en: Jesus answered them, “ You faithless generation, how long will I be with you? How long will I put up with you? Bring him to me. ”
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Hin kawaray pagtoo niyo nga mga tawo! Tubtob san-o an akon pakigtampo ha iyo? Tubtob san-o an pag-ilob ko ha iyo? Dad-a ngadi ha akon an bata!”

en: They brought him. When the spirit saw Jesus, it immediately threw the boy into a fit. He fell on the ground and rolled around, foaming at the mouth.
war: Ngan gindara nira an bata ngadto kan Jesus. Han pakakita la kan Jesus han maraot nga espiritu, ginbuntog dayon an bata. Natumba ini ha tuna ngan nagpulilid nga nagbubura an baba.

en: Jesus asked his father, “ How long has this been going on? ” He said, “Since he was a child.
war: “Kakan-o pa masugad hiya hini?” nagpakiana hi Jesus han amay. “Tikang pa han iya pagkabata,” binmaton hiya.

en: It has often thrown him into a fire or into water trying to kill him. If you can do anything, help us! Show us compassion!”
war: “Makadamo na pag-iparataya hiya han espiritu pinaagi hin paglabogan ha iya ngadto ha kalayo ngan ha tubig. Kalooyi intawon kami ngan buligi kami kon makakahimo ka!”

en: Jesus said to him, “ ‘If you can do anything’? All things are possible for the one who has faith. ”
war: “Oo, kon ikaw ngahaw makakahimo!” nagsiring hi Jesus. “Nahihimo an ngatanan hin tawo nga may-ada pagtoo!”

en: At that the boy’s father cried out, “I have faith; help my lack of faith!”
war: Binmaton dayon an amay han bata, “Natoo ako, kundi kulang pa an akon pagtoo. Dugangi an akon pagtoo!”

en: Noticing that the crowd had surged together, Jesus spoke harshly to the unclean spirit, “ Mute and deaf spirit, I command you to come out of him and never enter him again. ”
war: Nakita ni Jesus nga nagtitikaharani ha ira an kadam-an, sanglit ginsugo niya an maraot nga espiritu, “Nakakapabungol ngan nakakapangula nga espiritu, nagsusugo ako ha imo, gumawas ka tikang han bata ngan ayaw na gud pagsulod ha iya!”

en: After screaming and shaking the boy horribly, the spirit came out. The boy seemed to be dead; in fact, several people said that he had died.
war: Ginmoliat an espiritu, ginbuntog an bata, ngan ginmawas an espiritu. Daw patay na an bata, sanglit nagsiring an ngatanan, “Patay na hiya!”

en: But Jesus took his hand, lifted him up, and he arose.
war: Kundi kinaptan ni Jesus an kamot han bata ngan ginbangon hiya, ngan tinmindog an bata.

en: After Jesus went into a house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we throw this spirit out?”
war: Pagsulod ni Jesus han balay, ginhilit hiya hin pagpakianhi han iya mga tinun-an, “Kay ano nga waray kami makapaguwa han espiritu?”

en: Jesus answered, “ Throwing this kind of spirit out requires prayer. ”
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Makakapagawas kamo hin sugad nga espiritu pinaagi la hin pag-ampo, waray na iba.”

en: From there Jesus and his followers went through Galilee, but he didn’t want anyone to know it.
war: Binmaya hira hadto nga dapit ngan naglatas ha Galilea. Diri karuyag ni Jesus nga may mahibaro kon hain hiya,

en: This was because he was teaching his disciples, “ The Human One will be delivered into human hands. They will kill him. Three days after he is killed he will rise up. ”
war: kay nagtututdo hiya han iya mga tinun-an. Nagsiring hiya, “Igtutubyan an Anak han Tawo ngadto han mga tawo nga magpapatay ha iya, kundi mababanhaw hiya katapos hin tulo ka adlaw.”

en: But they didn’t understand this kind of talk, and they were afraid to ask him.
war: Waray hira makasabot hini nga igintutdo niya, kundi nahadlok hira hin pagpakiana ha iya.

en: They entered Capernaum. When they had come into a house, he asked them, “ What were you arguing about during the journey? ”
war: Inmabot hira ha Capernaum. Pagsulod nira han balay nagpakiana hi Jesus han iya mga tinun-an, “Ano an ginkalantugian niyo dida ha dalan?”

en: They didn’t respond, since on the way they had been debating with each other about who was the greatest.
war: Kundi waray hira mag-aringasa, kay ginkalantugian nira kon hin-o ha ira an gilalabawi.

en: He sat down, called the Twelve, and said to them, “ Whoever wants to be first must be least of all and the servant of all. ”
war: Linmingkod hi Jesus, gintawag niya an dose nga mga tinun-an, ngan nagsiring ha ira, “Kon hin-o an karuyag magin syahan, kinahanglan magpaorhe hiya han ngatanan ngan magin surugoon han ngatanan.

en: Jesus reached for a little child, placed him among the Twelve, and embraced him. Then he said,
war: Kinmuha hiya hin gutiay nga bata ngan ginpatukdaw ha atubangan nira. Inagbayan niya an bata ngan nagsiring ha ira.

en: “ Whoever welcomes one of these children in my name welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me isn’t actually welcoming me but rather the one who sent me. ”
war: An bisan hin-o nga nakarawat han sugad hini nga gutiay nga bata ha akon ngaran nakarawat ha akon, ngan an bisan hin-o nga nakarawat ha akon nakarawat diri la ha akon, kundi han nagsugo liwat ha akon.”

en: John said to Jesus, “Teacher, we saw someone throwing demons out in your name, and we tried to stop him because he wasn’t following us.”
war: Nagsiring ha iya hi Juan, “Magturutdo, hinkit-an namon in tawo nga nagpapagawas hin mga yawa ha imo ngaran. Ginsaway namon hiya kay diri man hiya kaupod naton.”

en: Jesus replied, “ Don’t stop him. No one who does powerful acts in my name can quickly turn around and curse me.
war: Kundi binmaton hi Jesus, “Ayaw niyo pagdid-i hiya. Kay waray nagbubuhat hin milagro ha akon ngaran nga onina magpapakaraot ha akon.

en: Whoever isn’t against us is for us.
war: Kay naugop ha aton an diri nasupak ha aton.

en: I assure you that whoever gives you a cup of water to drink because you belong to Christ will certainly be rewarded.
war: Tigamni niyo ini: An magpainom ha iyo hin tubig tungod kay akon kamo, waray ruhaduha, makarawat hiya han iya balos.

en: “ As for whoever causes these little ones who believe in me to trip and fall into sin, it would be better for them to have a huge stone hung around their necks and to be thrown into the lake.
war: “Kon in usa ka tawo matinikangan hin kawad-i hin pagtoo ha akon hini nga gutiay nga kabataan, maupay pa nga higtan hiya hin bato ha liog ngan tunuron hiya ha dagat.

en: If your hand causes you to fall into sin, chop it off. It’s better for you to enter into life crippled than to go away with two hands into the fire of hell, which can’t be put out.
war: Sanglit kon an imo kamot an maginhinungdan han imo diri pagtoo ha akon, gabay nimo utdon ito. Maupay pa nga makadto ka ha langit nga pungkol kay nga sangkap ka hin duha nga kamot ngan mahulog ka ha impyerno, ngadto han diri napaparong nga kalayo. (

en: If your foot causes you to fall into sin, chop it off. It’s better for you to enter life lame than to be thrown into hell with two feet.
war: Diri napatay an ira mga ulod didto, ngan diri napaparong an kalayo.)

en: If your eye causes you to fall into sin, tear it out. It’s better for you to enter God’s kingdom with one eye than to be thrown into hell with two.
war: Kon an imo mga tiil an maginhinungdan han imo diri pagtoo ha akon, gabay nimo utdon ito! Maupay pa nga makadto ka ha langit nga utod an usa nimo nga tiil kay nga sangkap ka hin duha nga mga tiil ngan ilabog ha impyerno. (

en: That’s a place where worms don’t die and the fire never goes out .
war: Diri napatay an ira mga ulod didto, ngan diri napaparong an kalayo.)

en: Everyone will be salted with fire.
war: Ngan kon an imo mga mata an maginhinungdan han imo diri pagtoo ha akon, gabay nimo lukaton ito! Maupay pa nga masulod ka ha ginhadian han Dyos nga usa la an mata kay nga sangkap ka hin duha nga mga mata ngan ilabog ha impyerno.

en: Salt is good; but if salt loses its saltiness, how will it become salty again? Maintain salt among yourselves and keep peace with each other. ”
war: Diri napatay an ira mga ulod didto, ngan diri napaparong an kalayo.

en: Jesus left that place and went beyond the Jordan and into the region of Judea. Crowds gathered around him again and, as usual, he taught them.
war: Binmaya hi Jesus hadto nga dapit, kinmadto ha tuna han Judea, ngan tinmabok han Salog han Jordan. Kinmadto ngan nag-alirong ha iya in damo nga mga tawo, ngan gintutdoan niya hira sugad han iya nababatasan.

en: Some Pharisees came and, trying to test him, they asked, “Does the Law allow a man to divorce his wife?”
war: Hinmarani ha iya in mga Parisiyo ngan nagtalingoha hin pagbitik ha iya. Nagpakiana hira, “Itinutugot ba han aton Balaod an pakigbulag han lalake han iya asawa?”

en: Jesus answered, “ What did Moses command you? ”
war: Binmaton hi Jesus, “Ano an sugo ni Moises ha iyo?”

en: They said, “Moses allowed a man to write a divorce certificate and to divorce his wife.”
war: Binmaton hira, “Tinmugot hi Moises nga mabaya an lalake han iya asawa pinaagi hin pagsurat ha pagpasabot nga mabulag hiya.”

en: Jesus said to them, “ He wrote this commandment for you because of your unyielding hearts.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus ha ira, “Iginsurat ini nga sugo tungod ha iyo kay makuri man kamo pagtutdoan.

en: At the beginning of creation, God made them male and female .
war: Kundi tikang ha tinikangan han paghimoa han kalibutan, daan na iginsiring, ‘Naghimo ha ira an Dyos nga lalake ngan babaye.

en: Because of this, a man should leave his father and mother and be joined together with his wife,
war: Tungod hini mabaya an lalake han amay ug iroy niya ngan makikigtampo han iya asawa.

en: and the two will be one flesh. So they are no longer two but one flesh.
war: Ngan an duha mauusa na la.’ Sanglit diri na hira duduha, kundi uusa na la.

en: Therefore, humans must not pull apart what God has put together. ”
war: Kinahanglan diri pagbulagon hin tawo an gin-usa han Dyos.”

en: Inside the house, the disciples asked him again about this.
war: Han pagbalik nira ngadto han balay, nagpakiana an mga tinun-an kan Jesus mahitungod hini nga mga butang.

en: He said to them, “ Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her;
war: Nagsiring hiya ha ira, “An lalake nga mabulag han iya asawa ngan mangasawa hin iba nga babaye, nakakasala hin panlibog kontra han iya asawa.

en: and if a wife divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery. ”
war: Ha amo man nga paagi, an babaye nga mabulag han iya bana ngan pumaasawa hin iba nga lalake, nakakasala hin panlibog liwat.”

en: People were bringing children to Jesus so that he would bless them. But the disciples scolded them.
war: May nagdara hin kabataan ngadto kan Jesus basi agbayan ini hira niya, kundi ginsaway han mga tinun-an adto nga mga tawo.

en: When Jesus saw this, he grew angry and said to them, “ Allow the children to come to me. Don’t forbid them, because God’s kingdom belongs to people like these children.
war: Han pakakita ni Jesus hini, nasina hiya ngan nagsiring ha iya mga tinun-an, “Pabay-i niyo nga dumaop ha akon an kabataan! Ayaw niyo pagdid-i hira, kay sugad ha ira la an makakaangkon han Ginhadian han Dyos.

en: I assure you that whoever doesn’t welcome God’s kingdom like a child will never enter it. ”
war: Tigamni ini niyo: an bisan hin-o nga diri nakarawat han Ginhadian han Dyos sugad hin gutiay nga bata, diri gud makakasulod ngadto.”

en: Then he hugged the children and blessed them.
war: Ngan ginkugos ni Jesus an kabataan, gin-agbayan niya, ngan ginbendisyonan niya hira.

en: As Jesus continued down the road, a man ran up, knelt before him, and asked, “Good Teacher, what must I do to obtain eternal life?”
war: Han tilakat na hi Jesus, may tawo nga nagdalagan tipakadto ha iya, linmuhod ha iya atubangan ngan nagpakiana, “Maupay nga Magturutdo, ano an kinahanglan ko buhaton basi makarawat ko an kinabuhi nga dayon?”

en: Jesus replied, “ Why do you call me good? No one is good except the one God.
war: Nagpakiana hi Jesus, “Kay ano nga tinatawag mo ako nga maupay? Waray iba nga maupay kundi an Dyos la.

en: You know the commandments: Don’t commit murder. Don’t commit adultery. Don’t steal. Don’t give false testimony . Don’t cheat. Honor your father and mother . ”
war: Maaram ka man han mga sugo: ‘Diri ka magpatay; diri ka manlibog; tumahod ka han amay ug iroy nimo.’”

en: “Teacher,” he responded, “I’ve kept all of these things since I was a boy.”
war: Binmaton an tawo, “Magturutdo, gintuman ko ini ngatanan nga mga sugo tikang pa han akon kabata.”

en: Jesus looked at him carefully and loved him. He said, “ You are lacking one thing. Go, sell what you own, and give the money to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven. And come, follow me. ”
war: Tinutokan hiya ni Jesus inopdan hin gugma ngan ginsiring, “Usa na la nga butang an kinahanglan mo. Kadto na, igbaligya an ngatanan nga imo hiagi, ngan ipanhatag an kwarta ha mga pobre, ngan magkakamay-ada ka mga bahandi ha langit. Katapos, balik ngan sunod ha akon.”

en: But the man was dismayed at this statement and went away saddened, because he had many possessions.
war: Nagmasulob-on an nawong han tawo han pakabati niya hini, ngan linmakat hiya nga mabidoon, kay riko hiya hin duro.

en: Looking around, Jesus said to his disciples, “ It will be very hard for the wealthy to enter God’s kingdom! ”
war: Sinmiplat hi Jesus ha iya mga tinun-an ngan nagsiring ha ira, “Makuri gud para han mga riko hin pagsulod han Ginhadian han Dyos!”

en: His words startled the disciples, so Jesus told them again, “ Children, it’s difficult to enter God’s kingdom!
war: Nanhipausa an mga tinun-an hini nga mga pulong. Kundi nagpadayon hi Jesus hin pagsiring, “Mga anak ko, makuri gud an pagsulod han Ginhadian han Dyos!

en: It’s easier for a camel to squeeze through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter God’s kingdom. ”
war: Masarusayon pa para hin kamelyo hin pagsuhot ha taranogan hin dagom kay hin riko hin pagsulod han Ginhadian han Dyos.”

en: They were shocked even more and said to each other, “Then who can be saved?”
war: Dinmugang hin paghipausa an mga tinun-an, sanglit may hin pakiana ha ira, “Hin-o man ngay-an an matatalwas?”

en: Jesus looked at them carefully and said, “ It’s impossible with human beings, but not with God. All things are possible for God. ”
war: Tinutokan hira hin maupay ni Jesus ngan binmaton, “Diri ini nahihimo hin tawo, kundi diri ini makuri para han Dyos. Nahihimo han Dyos an ngatanan nga mga butang.”

en: Peter said to him, “Look, we’ve left everything and followed you.”
war: Niyan nagyakan hi Pedro, “Kitaa, ginbayaan namon an ngatanan, ngan sinmunod kami ha imo.”

en: Jesus said, “ I assure you that anyone who has left house, brothers, sisters, mother, father, children, or farms because of me and because of the good news
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Nasiring ako ha iyo, bisan hin-o nga nabaya hin balay o kabugtoan, iroy, amay, mga anak, o mga uma, tungod ha akon ngan han Maupay nga Sumat,

en: will receive one hundred times as much now in this life—houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and farms (with harassment)—and in the coming age, eternal life.
war: makarawat hiya hin labaw pa kadamo nga balos dinhe hini nga kinabuhi. Makarawat hiya hin kapin usa ka gatos ka pilo nga mga balay, kabugtoan, mga iroy, mga anak, ngan mga uma—ngan upod manliwat in mga pagtimaraot. Ngan makarawat hiya han kinabuhi nga dayon ha umarabot nga panahon.

en: But many who are first will be last. And many who are last will be first. ”
war: Kundi damo an mga nahiuna yana nga mauorhe, ngan damo an mga naorhe yana nga mauuna.”

en: Jesus and his disciples were on the road, going up to Jerusalem, with Jesus in the lead. The disciples were amazed while the others following behind were afraid. Taking the Twelve aside again, he told them what was about to happen to him.
war: Nakada na hira ha dalan nga tipasagka ngadto ha Jerusalem. Nag-una hi Jesus han mga tinun-an nga pinagungulba ngan ginsusunod liwat han mga tawo nga puno hin kahadlok. Iginlain na liwat ni Jesus an dose nga mga tinun-an, ngan naghimangraw han mga butang nga mahinanabo ha iya.

en: “ Look! ” he said. “ We’re going up to Jerusalem. The Human One will be handed over to the chief priests and the legal experts. They will condemn him to death and hand him over to the Gentiles.
war: Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Pamati, makadto kita yana ha Jerusalem. Igtutubyan an Anak han Tawo ngadto han mga puno han kapadian ngan mga magturutdo han Balaod. Paghuhukman hiya nira nga patayon ngan igtutubyan ha mga Hentil.

en: They will ridicule him, spit on him, torture him, and kill him. After three days, he will rise up. ”
war: Pagbibiaybiayon hiya nira, paglulud-an, paglalatobon ngan pagpapatayon, ngan mababanhaw hiya katapos hin tulo ka adlaw.”

en: James and John, Zebedee’s sons, came to Jesus and said, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we ask.”
war: Hinmarani kan Jesus hira Santiago ug Juan nga mga anak ni Sebedeo, ngan naghangyo, “Magturutdo, may-ada namon hinahangyo ha imo.”

en: “ What do you want me to do for you? ” he asked.
war: “Ano an karuyag niyo nga buhaton ko ha iyo?” nagpakiana hi Jesus.

en: They said, “Allow one of us to sit on your right and the other on your left when you enter your glory.”
war: Binmaton hira, “Kon lumingkod ka na ha imo trono didto han imo harangdon nga Ginhadian, tugoti kami hin paglingkod upod ha imo, usa ha tuo ngan usa ha wala.”

en: Jesus replied, “ You don’t know what you’re asking! Can you drink the cup I drink or receive the baptism I receive? ”
war: “Diri kamo maaram han pinangangaro niyo,” nagbaton hi Jesus. “Makakainom ba kamo han kupa nga kinahanglan imnon ko? Makakagpabunyag ba kamo sugad han paagi nga kinahanglan ibunyag ha akon?”

en: “We can,” they answered. Jesus said, “ You will drink the cup I drink and receive the baptism I receive,
war: “Oo, makakahimo kami,” binmaton hira. Nagsiring hi Jesus, “Mainom gudman kamo han kinahanglan imnon ko, ngan pagbubunyagan kamo sugad han paagi nga kinahanglan ibunyag ha akon.

en: but to sit at my right or left hand isn’t mine to give. It belongs to those for whom it has been prepared. ”
war: Kundi waray ako katungod hin pagpili han malingkod ha akon tuo ngan ha akon wala. An Dyos la an mahatag hini nga mga lingkoran ngadto han iya gin-aandaman hito nga mga lingkoran.”

en: Now when the other ten disciples heard about this, they became angry with James and John.
war: Han pakabati la hini han napulo nga mga tinun-an, nagkasisina hira kanda Santiago ug Juan.

en: Jesus called them over and said, “ You know that the ones who are considered the rulers by the Gentiles show off their authority over them and their high-ranking officials order them around.
war: Sanglit gintawag hira ngatanan ni Jesus ngan nagsiring ha ira, “Maaram kamo nga may gahom ha mga tawo an kinikilala nga mga punoan han mga Hentil, ngan naghahadi ha ira an ira mga pangulo.

en: But that’s not the way it will be with you. Whoever wants to be great among you will be your servant.
war: Kundi diri ini amo an angay ha iyo. Kon may-ada ha iyo karuyag magin gamhanan, kinahanglan magin surugoon hiya han iba.

en: Whoever wants to be first among you will be the slave of all,
war: Ngan kon may-ada ha iyo karuyag magin syahan, kinahanglan magin oripon hiya han ngatanan.

en: for the Human One didn’t come to be served but rather to serve and to give his life to liberate many people. ”
war: Kay bisan ngani an Anak han Tawo waray kumanhi hin pagpasirbe, kundi kinmanhi hiya hin pagsirbe ngan hin paghatag han iya kinabuhi hin pagtubos hin damo nga mga tawo.”

en: Jesus and his followers came into Jericho. As Jesus was leaving Jericho, together with his disciples and a sizable crowd, a blind beggar named Bartimaeus, Timaeus’ son, was sitting beside the road.
war: Inmabot hi Jesus ha Jerico upod an iya mga tinun-an ngan hin damo nga mga tawo. Han nagtitigawas na hira han bungto, may buta nga ginngangaranan kan Bartimeo, anak ni Timeo, nga nalingkod hin pakilimos didto ha ligid han dalan.

en: When he heard that Jesus of Nazareth was there, he began to shout, “Jesus, Son of David, show me mercy!”
war: Han paghibaro niya nga hi Jesus nga taga-Nazaret an nalabay, ginmoliat hiya, “Jesus, Anak ni David, kalooyi gad ako!”

en: Many scolded him, telling him to be quiet, but he shouted even louder, “Son of David, show me mercy!”
war: Ginsaway hiya hin damo nga mga tawo ngan ginpahilom hiya. Kundi dinmugang lugod hiya hin paggoliat, “Anak ni David, kalooyi gad ako!”

en: Jesus stopped and said, “ Call him forward. ” They called the blind man, “Be encouraged! Get up! He’s calling you.”
